title: From hydrological laws to catchment models: A process-based model matches deep-learning accuracy on three continents
title_zh: 从水文学定律到流域模型：一个基于过程的模型在三大洲上达到深度学习的精度

paragraphs.en: Dooge asked whether hydrology has laws at the catchment scale. We ask whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can match the accuracy of neural networks that outperform process-based models on the same inputs. Three laws constrain a lumped catchment model. Conservation makes it a flux-connected storage network, dissipation fixes the sign of every flux and aggregation determines how the unresolved composition enters the fluxes, through effective laws over threshold distributions and a memory of the forcing. These laws admit four kinds of refinement. A parsimonious model under them, CaRT (11 parameters per catchment), is refined in a loop assisted by AI agents. Each refinement addresses an observed deficit through a hypothesis from the literature. The result, CaRT + , has fourteen states, 35 parameters per catchment and no daily neural network. Most refinements follow from aggregation over thresholds or from variables that carry no water but modulate fluxes. On 602 British and 593 US gauged catchments, single CaRT + models reach median Nash–Sutcliffe efficiencies of 0.863 and 0.765 in held-out years. A stateful LSTM reaches 0.869 and 0.751 and an entity-aware LSTM 0.862 and 0.754, while three-seed LSTM ensembles remain ahead of the CaRT + ensemble by 0.003–0.012 in median paired NSE. On 505 drier Australian gauged catchments unused in development, single CaRT + models reach 0.778 against 0.762 and 0.753 for the two LSTMs. The results suggest that catchment-scale laws exist as laws of form, with the constitutive families shared and only their parameters learned.
paragraphs.zh: Dooge 曾追问：水文在流域尺度上是否存在定律。 我们要问的是：一个在物理定律约束下构建的低维系统，能否在相同输入上达到那些超越过程模型的神经网络的精度。 有三条定律约束一个集总式流域模型。 守恒使其成为流量相互连接的蓄量网络，耗散确定了每条流量的符号，而聚合决定了未被解析的成分如何通过阈值分布上的有效定律和强迫的记忆进入流量。 这些定律容许四类细化。 在这些定律下构建的简约模型 CaRT（每个流域 11 个参数），在一个由 AI 智能体辅助的循环中被逐步细化。 每次细化都通过一个来自文献的假设来应对一个观测到的缺陷。 最终结果 CaRT+ 拥有十四个状态变量、每个流域 35 个参数，且不使用任何逐日神经网络。 大多数细化源自对阈值的聚合，或源自那些不携带水分但调制流量的变量。 在 602 个英国实测流域和 593 个美国实测流域上，单一 CaRT+ 模型在留出年份的中位 Nash–Sutcliffe 效率分别达到 0.863 和 0.765。 带状态的 LSTM 达到 0.869 和 0.751，实体感知 LSTM 达到 0.862 和 0.754，而三种子 LSTM 集成在中位配对 NSE 上仍领先 CaRT+ 集成 0.003–0.012。 在开发中未使用的 505 个较为干旱的澳大利亚实测流域上，单一 CaRT+ 模型达到 0.778，而两个 LSTM 分别为 0.762 和 0.753。 这些结果表明，流域尺度的定律以形式定律的形式存在，其本构族是共通的，需要学习的只是它们的参数。

paragraphs.en: Predicting how much water a river carries after rain is a long-standing problem in hydrology. The physics of water moving through soil and over hillslopes is well understood at small scales, yet no equally clear description exists for a whole catchment, where these processes combine over varied soils, slopes and vegetation. Researchers have long debated whether laws exist at the catchment scale at all. The debate sharpened when deep-learning models, trained only on rainfall, temperature and a few catchment properties, began to predict streamflow much better than models built from physical processes, which suggests that those models miss something. This paper derives three laws for catchment models. Water must be conserved, flow must run down gradients and lose energy, and when varied land is averaged into a few stores, the variability that is lost reappears as a memory of past weather, which a few additional variables can carry. These laws decide what a catchment model may look like and how it may be improved. Within these constraints, AI agents helped construct and test refinements of a simple model. The resulting model, with no neural network inside, matches deep learning on about 1900 catchments in Britain, the United States and Australia.
paragraphs.zh: 预测河流在降雨后携带多少水量，是水文学中一个由来已久的问题。 水在土壤中运动并沿山坡流动的物理机制在小尺度上已被充分理解，然而对于整个流域——这些过程在不同土壤、坡度和植被上综合作用的场所——尚不存在同样清晰的描述。 研究人员长期以来一直在争论，流域尺度上究竟是否存在规律。 当仅用降雨、气温和少量流域属性训练的深度学习模型开始比基于物理过程构建的模型更好地预测径流时，这场争论变得更加尖锐，这表明那些模型遗漏了某些东西。 本文推导出三条流域模型定律。 水量必须守恒，水流必须沿梯度向下流动并损失能量，而当把多变的地表平均为少数几个水库时，所丢失的变异性会以对过去天气的记忆形式重新出现，这种记忆可以由少数几个附加变量来承载。 这些定律决定了流域模型可能的形式以及改进的方向。 在这些约束条件下，智能体帮助构建并检验了一个简单模型的多种改进。 最终所得模型内部不含任何神经网络，却在英国、美国和澳大利亚约1900个流域上达到了与深度学习相当的表现。

paragraphs.en: Conservation, dissipation and aggregation fix the structure of a lumped catchment model and define four admissible ways to refine it.
paragraphs.zh: 守恒、耗散与集聚确定了集总式流域模型的结构，并定义了四种可行的细化方式。

paragraphs.zh: 低维模型的大多数改进都源于阈值聚合，或源于由不携带水分的变量所调制的通量。

paragraphs.en: One structure with 35 parameters per catchment matches the single-model median NSE of two same-input LSTMs on three continents.
paragraphs.zh: 一个包含 35 个参数的结构（每个流域 35 个参数）在三大洲上达到了两个相同输入的 LSTM 的单模型中位 NSE。

paragraphs.en: Predictions of daily streamflow are essential for flood-risk assessment and water-resources planning. The processes that generate streamflow are understood in detail at the scale of a soil column or a hillslope, yet models built from these processes have not matched the predictive accuracy of neural networks that represent none of them explicitly [ Lees et al., 2022 ] . Are processes missing from our understanding, or are we missing the laws by which known processes combine at the catchment scale?
paragraphs.zh: 日径流的预测对于洪水风险评估和水资源规划至关重要。 产生径流的过程在土壤柱或山坡尺度上已被详细理解，然而基于这些过程构建的模型的预测精度却始终不如完全不显式表示这些过程的神经网络 [ Lees et al., 2022 ] 。 究竟是我们的理解中缺失了某些过程，还是我们缺失了已知过程在流域尺度上组合的规律？

sents.en: Predictions of daily streamflow are essential for flood-risk assessment and water-resources planning.
sents.zh: 日径流的预测对于洪水风险评估和水资源规划至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Findings of the last decade frame this question. Large-sample datasets such as CAMELS and CAMELS-GB [ Addor et al., 2017 , Newman et al., 2015 , Coxon et al., 2020 , Addor et al., 2020 , Kratzert et al., 2023 ] made it possible to test rainfall–runoff models on hundreds of catchments at once. On these samples deep-learning models trained jointly across catchments outperform conceptual and process-based models (PBMs) by a wide margin [ Kratzert et al., 2018 , Kratzert et al., 2019a , Kratzert et al., 2019b , Lees et al., 2021 , Mai et al., 2022 , Nearing et al., 2024 ] . These models use nothing beyond daily catchment-mean forcing and a handful of static attributes, and Nearing et al. [2021] concluded that large-sample observations contain more information about catchment behaviour than hydrological theory has used. Attempts to locate the missing ingredient in a relaxed water balance [ Frame et al., 2022 , Frame et al., 2023 ] or the training protocol [ Kratzert et al., 2024 ] account for small parts of the gap, and the gap is not an artefact of the metric [ Gauch et al., 2023 ] . A mass-conserving LSTM comes within 0.02 in median NSE of the LSTM [ Hoedt et al., 2021 ] . Differentiable models, in which neural networks supply the parameters of a conceptual structure [ Tsai et al., 2021 , Shen et al., 2023 , Song et al., 2025 ] , have approached the accuracy of the LSTM [ Feng et al., 2022 , Feng et al., 2023 ] , as have neural ODEs in which networks replace the fluxes of such a structure [ Höge et al., 2022 ] . On CAMELS-US, a differentiable HBV comes within 0.02 NSE of the LSTM [ Feng et al., 2022 ] , but that model is sixteen copies of HBV run in parallel and averaged, and most of the gain comes from the mixture. Daily parameters from the network add only 0.018 in median NSE to it [ Feng et al., 2022 ] , and sixteen copies with static parameters from a multilayer perceptron score 0.71 where one copy scores 0.63 [ Poudel and Steinschneider, 2026 ] . However, a mixture of sixteen models is no longer a low-dimensional structure. The networks that parameterise such hybrids fit deliberately damaged structures almost as well [ Acuña Espinoza et al., 2024 ] . On CAMELS-GB the conceptual constraint adds little to what the network has to predict and can make the prediction harder [ Álvarez Chaves et al., 2026 ] . Such hybrids show that the inputs carry the information but not which processes a single structure would need to extract it [ Kirchner, 2006 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 过去十年的研究结果为这一问题提供了背景。 像 CAMELS 和 CAMELS-GB 这样的大样本数据集 [ Addor et al., 2017 , Newman et al., 2015 , Coxon et al., 2020 , Addor et al., 2020 , Kratzert et al., 2023 ] 使得在数百个流域上同时检验降雨–径流模型成为可能。 在这些样本上，跨流域联合训练的深度学习模型以明显优势优于概念性模型和基于过程的模型（PBMs）[ Kratzert et al., 2018 , Kratzert et al., 2019a , Kratzert et al., 2019b , Lees et al., 2021 , Mai et al., 2022 , Nearing et al., 2024 ] 。 这些模型仅使用日尺度的流域平均强迫数据和少量静态属性，而 Nearing et al. [2021] 得出结论：大样本观测所包含的关于流域行为的信息，比水文学理论所利用的更多。 试图在放宽的水量平衡 [ Frame et al., 2022 , Frame et al., 2023 ] 或训练方案 [ Kratzert et al., 2024 ] 中寻找缺失要素的尝试只能解释差距的一小部分，且这一差距并非指标的假象 [ Gauch et al., 2023 ] 。 一个保持质量守恒的 LSTM 在中位 NSE 上与 LSTM 相差仅 0.02 [ Hoedt et al., 2021 ] 。 可微分模型——即用神经网络为概念性结构提供参数 [ Tsai et al., 2021 , Shen et al., 2023 , Song et al., 2025 ] ——已接近 LSTM 的精度 [ Feng et al., 2022 , Feng et al., 2023 ] ，用网络替代此类结构中通量的神经常微分方程也是如此 [ Höge et al., 2022 ] 。 在 CAMELS-US 上，可微分 HBV 与 LSTM 的 NSE 相差仅 0.02 [ Feng et al., 2022 ] ，但该模型是十六个并行运行并取平均的 HBV 副本，且大部分增益来自这种混合。 来自网络的日尺度参数仅为其在中位 NSE 上增加 0.018 [ Feng et al., 2022 ] ，而使用多层感知机给出的静态参数的十六个副本可得 0.71 分，单个副本只得 0.63 分 [ Poudel and Steinschneider, 2026 ] 。 然而，十六个模型的混合已不再是低维结构。 为此类混合模型参数化的网络在拟合被刻意破坏的结构时表现几乎同样好 [ Acuña Espinoza et al., 2024 ] 。 在 CAMELS-GB 上，概念性约束对网络本须预测的内容几乎没有什么补充，反而可能使预测更加困难 [ Álvarez Chaves et al., 2026 ] 。 这类混合模型表明，输入中携带了信息，但并不能表明单一结构需要哪些过程来提取这些信息 [ Kirchner, 2006 ] 。

sents.en: The networks that parameterise such hybrids fit deliberately damaged structures almost as well [ Acuña Espinoza et al., 2024 ] .

sents.en: On CAMELS-GB the conceptual constraint adds little to what the network has to predict and can make the prediction harder [ Álvarez Chaves et al., 2026 ] .
sents.zh: 在 CAMELS-GB 上，概念性约束对网络本须预测的内容几乎没有什么补充，反而可能使预测更加困难 [ Álvarez Chaves et al., 2026 ] 。

sents.en: Such hybrids show that the inputs carry the information but not which processes a single structure would need to extract it [ Kirchner, 2006 ] .
sents.zh: 这类混合模型表明，输入中携带了信息，但并不能表明单一结构需要哪些过程来提取这些信息 [ Kirchner, 2006 ] 。

paragraphs.en: These findings suggest that whatever current PBMs miss is a function of the inputs they already receive, and that a flexible parameterisation can supply it. It is open whether one fixed, low-dimensional structure with static parameters can supply it and what the structure must then contain. This points to the form of the laws that map storage and forcing to fluxes, and revives the old question of whether there are hydrological laws at the catchment scale [ Dooge, 1986 , Sivapalan et al., 2003 , Sivapalan, 2005 , McDonnell et al., 2007 , Blöschl et al., 2019 ] or whether every catchment is unique [ Beven, 2000 , Beven, 2020 ] . Kirchner [2009] showed that some catchments behave as first-order dynamical systems, whereas the balance equations of representative elementary watersheds need closure relations that are nonlinear, hysteretic and scale dependent [ Reggiani et al., 1998 , Reggiani et al., 1999 , Beven, 2006 ] . Clark et al. [2008] , Fenicia et al. [2011] , Knoben et al. [2019] developed modular frameworks assemble conceptual models from interchangeable stores and fluxes. Stepwise improvement guided by diagnostics [ Fenicia et al., 2008 ] , genetic programming over such components [ Matin et al., 2026 ] and mass-conserving networks trained for parsimony [ Wang and Gupta, 2025 ] could be used to search model structures within the assemblies. Agents built on large language models have been proposed to assist this search [ Eythorsson and Clark, 2025 ] . However, which assemblies are admissible, and which component is needed for a given deficit, remain open.

paragraphs.en: We therefore take up the question of Dooge [1986] , and his search for simplicity [ Dooge, 1997 , Dooge, 2005 ] , in a form that large samples of catchments can test. We ask whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can predict daily streamflow as accurately as a neural network trained on the same inputs. We use the neural network as a measure of the information in the inputs. If such a system exists, the laws that produce it are candidates for the catchment-scale laws Dooge looked for. If it does not, either the laws are incomplete or the catchment response has no low-dimensional form. This work provides evidence of the existence of such a low-dimensional system. Section 2 states three laws, conservation, dissipation and aggregation, from which the admissible refinements of a lumped structure follow as a corollary. The aggregation law turns local threshold laws into exact effective laws and makes unresolved heterogeneity appear as memory of the forcing that decays with the catchment’s own relaxation times. Section 3 presents a parsimonious model consistent with these laws, a mass-conserving structure with six rain–runoff parameters and five snow parameters (CaRT), and Section 4 refines it iteratively. A deficit is diagnosed from the observations, and a refinement is derived from a stated fine-scale assumption through the operations admitted by the laws, in most cases nesting the model it refines. It is implemented as an exact daily law and kept if paired comparisons on a development split (Section 4.3 ) show an improvement overall, or in some classes of catchments without a loss overall. The loop then starts again on the refined model, with AI agents assisting it under the author’s instructions and the constraints of the laws. Removing each group of refinements from the final model and retraining the model measures what the group contributes. The result is CaRT + , a single model for both continents without any daily network.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们接续 Dooge [1986] 提出的问题以及他对简单性的探索 [ Dooge, 1997 , Dooge, 2005 ]，以一种可供大量流域样本检验的形式展开。 我们要问的是：在物理定律下构建的低维系统，能否像在相同输入上训练的神经网络一样准确地预测日径流。 我们将神经网络用作衡量输入中所含信息的标尺。 如果这样的系统存在，那么产生它的定律便是 Dooge 所寻找的流域尺度定律的候选者。 如果它不存在，那么要么这些定律不完整，要么流域响应不具有低维形式。 这项工作为这种低维系统的存在提供了证据。 第 2 节陈述三条定律——守恒、耗散与聚合——集总结构的可行细化作为推论随之而来。 聚合定律将局部阈值定律转化为精确的有效定律，并使未解决的异质性表现为随流域自身松弛时间衰减的强迫记忆。 第 3 节给出一个与这些定律一致的简约模型，即具有六个降雨–径流参数和五个积雪参数的质量守恒结构（CaRT），第 4 节则对其进行迭代细化。 从观测中诊断出缺陷，再依据一个明确陈述的细尺度假设、通过这些定律所允许的运算推导出细化，在大多数情况下是将被细化的模型嵌套其中。 每项细化都以精确的日尺度定律实现，并且当在开发集（第 4.3 节）上的成对比较显示总体改进，或在某些类别的流域中改进而无总体损失时予以保留。 随后该循环在细化后的模型上重新开始，由智能体在作者的指令和定律的约束下予以辅助。 从最终模型中逐一移除每组细化并重新训练模型，以衡量该组的贡献。 其结果是 CaRT + ，一个适用于两个大陆、不含任何日尺度神经网络的单一模型。

paragraphs.en: Section 5 evaluates the models on 671 CAMELS-GB and 671 CAMELS-US catchments under one protocol and tests the transfer to 561 catchments of CAMELS-AUS, which were not used in model development. Training uses 1989–2008 and model selection 2009–2010, while the test period 2011–2019 was not used to fit the parameters or to select checkpoints. In addition, 10 % of the catchments of each continent are held out from training. The comparison includes HBV regionalised in the same way as CaRT, the differentiable HBV of Feng et al. [2022] , a stateful LSTM and an entity-aware LSTM (EA-LSTM) trained on the same inputs. paragraphs.en: This section states what mathematical form a lumped daily catchment model must satisfy. It then shows how such a model is obtained from local hydrological mechanisms by aggregation and how it can be refined to include missing details. We show that effective catchment-scale relations between states and fluxes emerge from the aggregation of established local mechanisms under conservation. These effective relations are conditioned by the distribution, connectivity and interactions of heterogeneous elements and may therefore be nonlinear and scale dependent, and may carry memory. What is universal is the set of principles that produce these relations, namely the hydrological laws defined below.
paragraphs.zh: 本节阐述集总式日尺度流域模型必须满足的数学形式。 随后说明如何通过对局部水文机制进行聚合来获得此类模型，以及如何对其进行细化以纳入缺失的细节。 我们表明，流域尺度上状态与通量之间的有效关系是在守恒条件下对已有局部机制进行聚合而涌现出来的。 这些有效关系受异质性要素的分布、连通性及其相互作用的制约，因此可能是非线性的、依赖尺度的，并可能带有记忆性。 具有普适性的是产生这些关系的那套原理，即下文定义的水文定律。

paragraphs.en: Definitions (hydrological law, constitutive family, constitutive relation). A hydrological law is a statement about catchment-scale storages and fluxes that (i) holds for every catchment; (ii) follows from a physical principle; and (iii) constrains the admissible form of a model. Within the forms a law admits, a constitutive family is one functional form chosen under a stated fine-scale assumption, such as a Pareto distribution of storage capacities or a power-law release, and can be shared by many catchments. The constitutive relation of a catchment is the member of the family selected by catchment parameters, such as soil capacity and the release-law exponent, and must come from data.
paragraphs.zh: 定义（水文学定律、本构族、本构关系）。 水文学定律是关于流域尺度储量与通量的陈述，它（i）适用于每一个流域；（ii）源自某条物理原理；（iii）约束模型的可采纳形式。 在定律所允许的形式范围内，本构族是在某一明确陈述的细尺度假设下选定的一个函数形式，例如储水容量的帕累托分布或幂律释水，并且可以被许多流域共享。 某一流域的本构关系是由流域参数（如土壤容量和释水定律指数）从该族中选出的成员，并且必须来自数据。

paragraphs.en: The laws are universal by construction, but whether the constitutive families are shared and how the parameters vary are empirical questions. Three laws of this kind and one corollary are stated below, and Table 1 lists the form each statement imposes on a model and the choices left to the constitutive family and to data.
paragraphs.zh: 这些定律在构造上是普适的，但各构成族是否共享以及参数如何变化则是经验性问题。 下面陈述了三条此类定律及一条推论，表 1 列出了每条陈述赋予模型的形式，以及留给构成族和数据的选择。

paragraphs.en: Here 𝒒 \bm{q} contains the net internal fluxes with prescribed reference directions, and 𝑩 \bm{B} is their incidence matrix, in which each column has − 1 -1 at the source volume and + 1 +1 at the receiving volume. The vectors 𝒑 \bm{p} , 𝒆 \bm{e} and 𝒐 \bm{o} hold, for each volume, the precipitation it receives, its evaporation (including transpiration and sublimation) and its outflow to the outlet, all non-negative. The vector 𝒋 ext \bm{j}_{\rm ext} holds the other exchanges of each volume across the catchment boundary, such as regional groundwater flow, positive into the volume. Each boundary flux is assigned to one volume, although boundary fluxes can also be represented by an augmented incidence matrix that includes the atmosphere, the outlet and the exterior as boundary nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 此处 𝒒 \bm{q} 包含具有规定参考方向的净内部通量，𝑩 \bm{B} 是它们的关联矩阵，其中每一列在源体积处为 − 1 -1，在接收体积处为 + 1 +1。 向量 𝒑 \bm{p}、𝒆 \bm{e} 和 𝒐 \bm{o} 对每个体积分别保存其所接收的降水、其蒸发（包括蒸腾和升华）以及其流向出口的出流，均为非负值。 向量 𝒋 ext \bm{j}_{\rm ext} 保存每个体积跨越流域边界的其他交换，例如区域地下水流动，以流入该体积为正。 每个边界通量被分配给一个体积，尽管边界通量也可以通过增广关联矩阵来表示，该矩阵将大气、出口和外部作为边界节点包含在内。

paragraphs.en: Conservation fixes this balance structure but does not give a closure for the internal fluxes. A lumped model represents them as 𝒒 = 𝒒 ⁡ ( 𝒙 , 𝒖 , 𝝌 ) \bm{q}=\bm{q}(\bm{x},\bm{u},\bm{\chi}) , where 𝒖 \bm{u} is the forcing and 𝝌 \bm{\chi} denotes conditional variables, such as connectivity or vegetation activity, that affect the fluxes without contributing to water storage. paragraphs.zh: 集总式流域模型是一个储能向量，满足 𝐱 ˙ = 𝐁 ​ 𝐪 + 𝐩 − 𝐞 − 𝐨 + 𝐣 ext \dot{\bm{x}}=\bm{B}\bm{q}+\bm{p}-\bm{e}-\bm{o}+\bm{j}_{\rm ext} ，以及 𝟏 ⊤ ​ 𝐁 = 𝟎 ⊤ \bm{1}^{\!\top}\bm{B}=\bm{0}^{\!\top} 。

paragraphs.en: The state is the set of stores, and each internal flux removes water from one store and adds it to another (each column of 𝑩 \bm{B} sums to zero), so water is conserved whatever the flux laws are. A model is changed only by changing, adding or removing fluxes and stores.
paragraphs.zh: 状态是各库（store）的集合，每个内部通量从一个库移除水并将其添加到另一个库（𝑩 \bm{B} 的每一列之和为零），因此无论通量定律如何，水量都是守恒的。 模型只能通过更改、添加或移除通量和库来改变。

paragraphs.en: Water in the pores and in the channels obeys the Navier–Stokes equations, under which the free energy of the water in any fixed region changes by the work done at its boundary minus a viscous dissipation that is never negative. In the pores the momentum relaxes in much less than a second, and on hillslopes and in channels in minutes to hours, both fast compared with the daily step of lumped models. Averaging Stokes flow over the pores then gives Darcy’s law, 𝒒 = − 𝑲 ∇ H \bm{q}=-\bm{K}\nabla H with 𝑲 \bm{K} symmetric and positive definite [ Tartar, 1980 , Allaire, 1989 , Hornung, 1997 ] . On hillslopes and in channels the Saint-Venant equations reduce to the kinematic or diffusive wave at small Froude number [ Lighthill and Whitham, 1955 , Chen et al., 1994 ] . In both cases the flux follows the gradient of the head H H , in the kinematic wave through its bed-slope part alone. The finest partition is a modelling level bounded by two scales. Its units must be larger than the representative elementary volume, so that Darcy’s law or the Saint-Venant equations hold for them [ Bear, 1972 ] . They must also be small enough for the head within a unit to even out faster than the forcing changes, ℓ ≪ D ​ T \ell\ll\sqrt{D\,T} , with ℓ \ell the size of the unit in the direction considered and T T the time scale of the forcing. The hydraulic diffusivity D D is the conductivity divided by the change of storage per unit change of head, and ℓ 2 / D \ell^{2}/D is the time over which the head within a unit evens out. For daily forcing this upper bound is about a decimetre to a metre vertically in an unsaturated soil of moderate wetness, metres to tens of metres laterally in an unconfined sandy aquifer and kilometres along a channel. We take the finest partition to be K-orthogonal, with the line between the centres of two neighbours normal to their interface in the metric of 𝑲 \bm{K} , as a Voronoi partition is for isotropic 𝑲 \bm{K} . The flux across the interface between two volumes is then approximated by a conductance times the difference of their heads. This two-point flux of finite volumes is consistent on such a partition and converges to the local flux as the partition is refined, while on other partitions it also depends on the heads of further neighbours. The distributed system of Section 2.2 is this fine model, and the decompositions below are exact for it.
paragraphs.zh: 孔隙中和沟道中的水遵循 Navier–Stokes 方程，据此，任一固定区域内水的自由能的变化等于在其边界上所做的功减去一个永不小于零的黏性耗散。 在孔隙中，动量在远小于一秒的时间内弛豫；在山坡上和沟道中则在数分钟到数小时内弛豫，两者相对于集总模型的日步长而言都是快速的。 对孔隙上的 Stokes 流取平均即得 Darcy 定律 𝒒 = − 𝑲 ∇ H \bm{q}=-\bm{K}\nabla H，其中 𝑲 \bm{K} 对称且正定 [ Tartar, 1980 , Allaire, 1989 , Hornung, 1997 ] 。 在山坡上和沟道中，当 Froude 数较小时，Saint-Venant 方程简化为运动波或扩散波 [ Lighthill and Whitham, 1955 , Chen et al., 1994 ] 。 在这两种情形下，通量都遵循水头 H H 的梯度；在运动波中则仅通过其坡度部分来遵循。 最细的划分是一个由两个尺度界定的建模层级。 其单元必须大于代表性基本体积，从而使 Darcy 定律或 Saint-Venant 方程对它们成立 [ Bear, 1972 ] 。 它们还必须足够小，使得单元内的水头能在强迫变化之前更快地趋于均匀，即 ℓ ≪ D ​ T \ell\ll\sqrt{D\,T}，其中 ℓ \ell 为单元在所考虑方向上的尺寸，T T 为强迫的时间尺度。 水力扩散率 D D 等于水力传导度除以单位水头变化所引起的储水量变化，而 ℓ 2 / D \ell^{2}/D 是单元内水头趋于均匀所需的时间。 对于日强迫，这一上限在中等湿度的非饱和土壤中垂向约为十分之一米到一米，在无承压砂质含水层中侧向为数米到数十米，沿沟道则为数千米。 我们取最细划分为 K-正交的，即两个相邻单元中心之间的连线在 𝑲 \bm{K} 度量下垂直于它们的界面，正如各向同性 𝑲 \bm{K} 情形下的 Voronoi 划分那样。 于是，两个体积之间界面上的通量近似为电导乘以它们水头之差。 这种有限体积的两点通量格式在这样的划分上是相容的，并随划分细化而收敛于局部通量；而在其他划分上，它还依赖于更远邻居的水头。 第 2.2 节的分布式系统就是这个精细模型，下文的分解对它而言是精确的。

sents.en: This two-point flux of finite volumes is consistent on such a partition and converges to the local flux as the partition is refined, while on other partitions it also depends on the heads of further neighbours.

paragraphs.en: A flux law may depend on the states of both volumes it connects and on conditional variables. The flux laws of this paper have a further property beyond the sign fixed by ( 2 ). A flux out of a volume does not decrease as the storage of that volume increases and does not increase as the storage of the receiving volume increases. This monotonicity is constitutive. It holds where the conductance at each interface is taken from the source and does not decrease with the storage of the source, as the conductivity of unsaturated soil grows with its water content. It restricts the exchange of Section 4.2 to a loss and a constant inflow and, under the locality, drainage and coupling conditions of Appendix A.1 , lets the memory of initial states fade. A flux law reduces to a single-state storage–discharge relation q = f ⁡ ( x i ) q=f(x_{i}) only if the downstream head is fixed and the upstream head and conductance are functions of x i x_{i} alone. The single-state reservoir, which underlies almost all conceptual models, is therefore conservation plus a one-state hydraulic closure.
paragraphs.zh: 通量定律可能取决于其所连接的两个体积的状态以及条件变量。 本文的通量定律除了由式 ( 2 ) 固定的符号之外，还具有一个进一步的性质。 流出某个体积的通量不会随该体积蓄量的增加而减小，也不会随接收体积蓄量的增加而增大。 这种单调性是构成性的。 该性质在每个界面处的传导率取自源体积、且不随源体积蓄量增加而减小的情形下成立，正如非饱和土壤的导水率随其含水量增长一样。 它将 4.2 节的交换限制为损失和恒定入流，并在附录 A.1 的局域性、排水和耦合条件下，使初始状态的记忆逐渐消退。 通量定律仅在下游水头固定、且上游水头与传导率都只是 x i x_{i} 的函数时，才退化为单状态蓄量–泄流关系 q = f ⁡ ( x i ) q=f(x_{i}) 。 因此，几乎构成所有概念性模型基础的单状态水库，就是守恒性再加上一个单状态的水力学闭合。

paragraphs.en: A direct way to reduce ℛ \mathcal{R} is to explicitly represent part of the fine states by splitting the lumped stores. Alternatively, ℛ \mathcal{R} can be reduced by aggregation of local thresholds, which removes it where the threshold distribution is resolved, or represented by memory (Section 2.3 , Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 降低 ℛ \mathcal{R} 的一个直接方法是通过拆分归并后的存储库，显式地表示部分精细状态。 或者，可以通过聚合局部阈值来降低 ℛ \mathcal{R}，即在该阈值分布被解析的地方将其消除，或用记忆来表示它（第 2.3 节，附录 A）。

sents.en: Alternatively, ℛ \mathcal{R} can be reduced by aggregation of local thresholds, which removes it where the threshold distribution is resolved, or represented by memory (Section 2.3 , Appendix A ).
sents.zh: 或者，可以通过聚合局部阈值来降低 ℛ \mathcal{R}，即在该阈值分布被解析的地方将其消除，或用记忆来表示它（第 2.3 节，附录 A）。

paragraphs.en: Part of ℛ \mathcal{R} is not an effect of the composition of the stores. The forcing 𝒖 \bm{u} is a catchment mean, and the fine state also responds to how the day’s rain and melt are spread over the catchment, which neither the aggregates nor their history determine. Fluxes that people control, such as abstractions, discharges and reservoir releases, are boundary fluxes in Law 1 that the forcing does not drive, and they enter ℛ \mathcal{R} too. These parts form a residual that no lumped structure recovers and that remains after the three ways above have reduced the rest of ℛ \mathcal{R} .
paragraphs.zh: ℛ \mathcal{R} 的一部分并不是储量的组合所产生的效应。 强迫项 𝒖 \bm{u} 是流域均值，而精细状态还会响应当日的降雨和融雪在流域上的分布方式，这既不由聚合量决定，也不由其历史决定。 人们控制的通量，例如取水、排水和水库泄流，是定律 1 中不由强迫项驱动的边界通量，它们同样进入 ℛ \mathcal{R} 。 这些部分构成一个残差，任何集总式结构都无法还原它，并且在上述三种方式将 ℛ \mathcal{R} 的其余部分削减之后，它仍然保留下来。

sents.en: The forcing 𝒖 \bm{u} is a catchment mean, and the fine state also responds to how the day’s rain and melt are spread over the catchment, which neither the aggregates nor their history determine.
sents.zh: 强迫项 𝒖 \bm{u} 是流域均值，而精细状态还会响应当日的降雨和融雪在流域上的分布方式，这既不由聚合量决定，也不由其历史决定。

sents.en: Fluxes that people control, such as abstractions, discharges and reservoir releases, are boundary fluxes in Law 1 that the forcing does not drive, and they enter ℛ \mathcal{R} too.
sents.zh: 人们控制的通量，例如取水、排水和水库泄流，是定律 1 中不由强迫项驱动的边界通量，它们同样进入 ℛ \mathcal{R} 。

sents.en: These parts form a residual that no lumped structure recovers and that remains after the three ways above have reduced the rest of ℛ \mathcal{R} .
sents.zh: 这些部分构成一个残差，任何集总式结构都无法还原它，并且在上述三种方式将 ℛ \mathcal{R} 的其余部分削减之后，它仍然保留下来。

paragraphs.en: The other threshold laws of this paper are the same integral with different driving variables v v , which are the rain for the infiltration excess, the quick store for the release exponent (Section 4.2 ), the wetness for the connected fraction of the hillslope (Appendix C ) and the total storage along the path for units that spill into one another (Section 2.3 ). Once the units cease to share v v , the aggregate depends on how they came to differ, and Section 2.3 shows that this dependence is a memory of the forcing.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的其他阈值定律是同一个积分，只是驱动变量 v v 不同：对超渗产流而言是降雨，对释放指数而言是快速蓄水量（第 4.2 节），对坡面连通比例而言是湿度（附录 C），对相互溢流的单元而言则是沿路径的总蓄水量（第 2.3 节）。 一旦各单元不再共享 v v，聚合结果就取决于它们如何产生差异，第 2.3 节表明这种依赖关系是对强迫的记忆。

paragraphs.en: The expansion is about the arithmetic means. Where the units share one relation between potential and storage and differ only in their conductances, the reference state puts every unit at the mean storage, the terms in Var ⁡ ( s ) \Var(s) and Cov ⁡ ( s , κ ) \Cov(s,\kappa) are Δ ​ 𝑭 \Delta\bm{F} and the term in Var ⁡ ( κ ) \Var(\kappa) belongs to 𝑭 0 \bm{F}_{0} . Where the properties enter the potential, the reference state has a spread of its own, and Δ ​ 𝑭 \Delta\bm{F} is the change of these terms from their values at the reference state. This correction can still be large although it is of second order. Two units with storages s ¯ ​ ( 1 ± ε ) \bar{s}(1\pm\varepsilon) and f ∝ s 5 f\propto s^{5} release 1 + 10 ​ ε 2 + 5 ​ ε 4 1+10\varepsilon^{2}+5\varepsilon^{4} times the single-store flow, 41 % more for ε = 0.2 \varepsilon=0.2 . Heterogeneity thus makes the mean outflow depend on both the mean storage and the spread of the storages. But the spread is not a function of the current mean. Both integrals, ( 8 ) and ( 10 ), depend on the distribution of the units at the given moment, which the aggregates do not fix, and Section 2.3 treats how this distribution depends on the history.
paragraphs.zh: 该展开是关于算术平均值的。 当各单元共享同一个势–储量关系、仅电导不同时，参考态使每个单元都处于平均储量，Var(s) 和 Cov(s,κ) 中的项属于 Δ𝑭，而 Var(κ) 中的项属于 𝑭₀。 当这些属性进入势函数时，参考态自身也有一个离散度，Δ𝑭 就是这些项相对于其在参考态处取值的变化量。 这个修正虽然只是二阶量，但仍可能很大。 两个储量分别为 s̄(1±ε)、且 f ∝ s⁵ 的单元，其出流为单一储量出流的 1+10ε²+5ε⁴ 倍，当 ε=0.2 时要多出 41%。 因此，非均匀性使得平均出流同时依赖于平均储量和储量的离散度。 但该离散度并非当前平均值的函数。 两个积分（8）和（10）都依赖于各单元在给定时刻的分布，而聚集区并不能确定这一分布；第 2.3 节将讨论该分布如何依赖于历史。

paragraphs.en: Eliminating the composition from the equations leaves a functional of the history of the aggregates and the forcing, plus the contribution of the initial composition, which fades where all water leaves through paths that respond to storage and the variables that modulate the fluxes do not feed back on the water that drives them (Appendix A.1 , Eq. ( 20 )). This elimination underlies the Mori–Zwanzig projection [ Mori, 1965 , Zwanzig, 1973 , Chorin et al., 2002 ] . A lumped model can therefore keep the composition as extra states or replace it by a memory of the history of the aggregates and the forcing, and the two are equivalent. The memory takes different forms for threshold and smooth laws and for units in parallel and in series.
paragraphs.zh: 将组分从方程中消去后，剩下一个依赖于聚合体历史与强迫的泛函，再加上初始组分的贡献；该初始组分的贡献在所有水都经由响应于蓄水量的路径流出、且调制通量的变量不会反馈于驱动它们的水的情形下会逐渐消失（附录 A.1，式 (20)）。 这种消去法是 Mori–Zwanzig 投影方法的基础 [ Mori, 1965 , Zwanzig, 1973 , Chorin et al., 2002 ]。 因此，集总模型既可以保留组分作为额外的状态变量，也可以用聚合体历史与强迫的记忆来替代它，两者是等价的。 对于阈值型和平滑型规律，以及对于并联和串联的单元，记忆会呈现不同的形式。

sents.en: A lumped model can therefore keep the composition as extra states or replace it by a memory of the history of the aggregates and the forcing, and the two are equivalent.

sents.en: The memory takes different forms for threshold and smooth laws and for units in parallel and in series.

paragraphs.en: Since z z grows with P P , the connected fraction is a function of z z for a given F d F_{d} . The storage fixes only the mean deficit, d ¯ = c ¯ − z \bar{d}=\bar{c}-z , and the flux depends on the whole distribution. Filling and drying change this distribution in different ways. Rain lowers each deficit until it reaches zero, d i → max ⁡ ( d i − P , 0 ) d_{i}\to\max(d_{i}-P,0) , and erases the differences among the units that fill. Uniform evaporation E E raises each deficit until the unit is empty, d i → min ⁡ ( d i + E , c i ) d_{i}\to\min(d_{i}+E,c_{i}) , and keeps the differences among the units that still hold water. From empty, F d = F c F_{d}=F_{c} , and the storage follows the integral ( 9 ). After drying by E E from full, every unit that kept water has the deficit E E , and these units reconnect together when z z returns to its value before drying. The same storage thus corresponds to different deficit distributions, and to different fluxes, after a wet and after a dry spell. Along a path a unit connects once it and every unit below it are full. With immediate spill and uniform rain from empty, the outflow is the rain on this connected part, Q = p ​ F c ​ ( z ) Q=p\,F_{c}(z) , where c c is now the total storage z z at which a unit connects. The distribution of c c is set by the order of the capacities along the path, since small capacities upstream merge into the thresholds of the larger ones below them [ Shook and Pomeroy, 2011 , Tromp-van Meerveld and McDonnell, 2006 ] . After drying, the connected fraction depends on the deficits along the path in the same way. The deficit distribution is therefore the composition that the stores do not resolve. With losses that do not depend on the state of the unit and no outflow between empty and full, each unit is a stop operator of the accumulated net forcing. The deficit distribution of a store is the superposition of these operators, a Prandtl–Ishlinskii hysteresis operator of the forcing [ O’Kane and Flynn, 2007 , Brokate and Sprekels, 1996 ] . The state depends only on the path of the accumulated forcing and on its turning points, so the memory has no time scale. An event that fills or empties all units erases it. A lumped model can carry this memory as the deficit distribution or as the current accumulated forcing and the turning points that generate it (Appendix A.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Thresholds can also carry a memory that relaxes. Where the units share a driving variable that the stores do not resolve, or lateral exchange brings them to share it (Appendix C ), that variable has its own balance with a drainage term. The flux keeps the sign of the local law and can start from zero. In CaRT + the hillslope wetness θ \theta shifts the connection thresholds of the hillslope units, and the near-surface wetness scales the infiltration capacities (Appendix C ). Where the integral is a fraction bounded away from zero acting on a positive flux, the result is a multiplier of that flux, as for the connected fraction A ≥ A min A\geq A_{\min} that multiplies the release.

paragraphs.en: For units in parallel as defined in Section 2.2 , inputs create the spread in ( 10 ) (units that receive more, or drain more slowly, pull ahead), while drainage removes it (the wetter units drain faster). The current spread therefore remembers the inputs of the recent past, over the time drainage takes to remove it (moment equations in Appendix A.1 ). A lumped model that represents the correction keeps the spread as an extra state or as a memory of the forcing. For a conditional variable in parallel the same holds, with the contraction of its own balance in place of drainage, as for the wetness in ( 39 ). Where the properties differ, the term in Cov ⁡ ( s , κ ) \Cov(s,\kappa) is linear in the imbalance of the storages, and this term has an exact description in the simplest case of two heterogeneous reservoirs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于第2.2节所定义的并联单元，输入造成式(10)中的离散度（接收较多或排水较慢的单元会超前），而排水则消除它（较湿的单元排水较快）。 因此当前的离散度记住近期过去的输入，持续时间为排水消除它所需的时间（矩方程见附录A.1）。 表示该修正的集总模型将离散度作为一个额外的状态，或作为强迫的记忆加以保留。 对于并联的条件变量，同样的结论也成立，只是以其自身平衡的收缩代替排水，正如式(39)中的湿度那样。 当性质不同时，Cov(s,κ)项与储水量的失衡呈线性关系，在两个非均质水库的最简单情形下，这一项有精确的描述。

If both units start with the same storage, h h starts at zero, and the linear equation for h h makes it a weighted average of the past values of W W . An initial imbalance adds a transient that is forgotten after a few residence times. paragraphs.en: When the units drain into one another, w i = 0 w_{i}=0 for all but the last, and the composition is the position of the water along the path. This composition arises even for identical units. Under steady input every store passes the input on, the total storage is z = T ​ p z=Tp with T T the mean travel time, and the outflow is z / T z/T . This quasi-steady closure reads the outflow from the total storage, but the outflow is set by the last store alone. After a rise of the input the new water is still upstream, so z z has increased while the outflow has not, and the outflow falls below z / T z/T . After a fall the upstream stores empty first and the outflow stays above it. For input that varies slowly compared with T T , the outflow of n n identical stores falls below z / T z/T by the fraction n − 1 2 ​ n ​ T ​ p ˙ / p \frac{n-1}{2n}\,T\dot{p}/p (Appendix A.2 ). The memory of units in series is therefore a memory of the changes of the input. It is present for identical units, whereas the memory of units in parallel is not driven when the units are identical and fades as their initial differences decay, and a lumped model of a chain has to keep the water in transit.

paragraphs.en: The water in transit can be kept as stores, one for each unit, for any flux laws. For linear, time-invariant units it can also be kept as a convolution. The outflow is then exactly the convolution q = h ∗ p q=h*p of the input with the travel-time distribution h h of the network, the distribution of the time that water takes from the input to the outlet, which has mean T T and is also the response of the outflow to a unit pulse of input. The kernel is causal, non-negative and of unit mass. Unit mass conserves water (Law 1 ), with the water in transit as a store, and a non-negative kernel keeps the sign of the flux (Law 2 ). A chain of n n identical linear stores has a gamma kernel [ Nash, 1957 ] . Where the network is not known, a kernel family with few parameters approximates h h , as the unit hydrographs of Section 3 do with one parameter.
paragraphs.zh: 对于任何通量定律，输运过程中的水都可以作为蓄水体保存，每个单元一个。 对于线性时不变单元，它也可以以卷积的形式保存。 此时出流正好是输入与网络汇流时间分布 h h 的卷积 q = h ∗ p q=h*p，该分布是水从输入到出口所需时间的分布，其均值为 T T，同时也是出流对单位脉冲输入的响应。 该核是因果的、非负的且质量为一。 单位质量守恒水量（定律 1），输运中的水作为一个蓄水体，而非负的核保持通量的符号（定律 2）。 由 n n 个相同线性蓄水体组成的链具有 gamma 核 [Nash, 1957]。 在网络未知的情况下，可用具有少量参数的核族来近似 h h，正如第 3 节的单位线用一个参数所做的那样。

paragraphs.en: The composition itself is a set of states that carries ℛ \mathcal{R} exactly except for the spatial heterogeneity of forcing and human influence. A state needs to carry a difference in composition only while that difference can still change the future of the aggregates. Under the monotonicity of Section 2.1 and the drainage and coupling conditions of Appendix A.1 , this influence fades. Every flux is driven by a potential difference, so a unit loses more water when its potential (head) is higher than that of its neighbours, and differences between units shrink at a rate set by how fast the losses grow with storage and by the conductance of the exchange between units (Appendix A.1 ). In catchments these rates fall into a few separated time scales, hours for the redistribution of water within an event, days to weeks for soils and hillslopes and months to years for groundwater. A difference that relaxes within the day follows the current state and forcing after a short transient and enters the effective drift of the slower states, so only the slower differences that the forcing drives need a state. Where units in parallel share the forcing, the contraction also keeps their spread small, since inputs pull them apart only through their differences in properties, and for smooth laws the low moments of the spread approximate its effect. Where the rate of a unit does not depend on its storage between its bounds, Law 2 gives no contraction. A turning point of the accumulated forcing then stays in the memory until the forcing passes it, and an event that fills or empties all units erases all of them. In Section 5 , one state for each conditional variable and the water in transit are enough, and Appendix A.2 gives the conditions under which so few states keep the error small. Table 2 lists the states that remain for each local structure.
paragraphs.zh: 组合本身是一个状态集合，除了强迫和人类影响的空间异质性外，它完全承载 ℛ \mathcal{R}。 只有当组成差异仍能改变聚合体的未来时，状态才需要承载这种差异。 在第 2.1 节的单调性以及附录 A.1 的排水与耦合条件下，这种影响会衰减。 每个通量都由势差驱动，因此当一个单元的势（水头）高于其相邻单元时，它会损失更多水分，且单元间差异的缩小速率由损失随蓄水量的增长速度以及单元间交换的导水率决定（附录 A.1）。 在流域中，这些速率分为几个分离的时间尺度：单次事件内水分再分配为数小时，土壤和山坡为数天至数周，地下水为数月至数年。 在一天内松弛的差异会在短暂瞬变后跟随当前状态与强迫，并进入较慢状态的有效漂移，因此只有强迫驱动的较慢差异才需要状态来承载。 当并联单元共享强迫时，收缩性也能使其离散保持很小，因为输入仅通过它们在性质上的差异将其拉开，而对于光滑的规律，离散的低阶矩即可近似其影响。 当某单元的速率在其上下界之间不依赖于其蓄水量时，定律 2 不产生收缩。 于是，累积强迫的转折点会保留在记忆中，直到强迫越过该点，而使所有单元充满或排空的事件会抹去所有转折点。 在第 5 节中，每个条件变量各一个状态加上输移中的水量就足够了，附录 A.2 给出了如此少的状态能使误差保持很小的条件。 表 2 列出了每个局部结构所保留的状态。

paragraphs.en: The derivation above starts from the fine system, but conceptual models are usually built the other way, from a few stores to which detail is added where a closure fails. Laws 1–3 admit four kinds of refinement. Two change the network and two change a flux law, and they can be combined.

paragraphs.en: Adding a connection (b) is an extension for which no such 𝑲 \bm{K} exists. A new volume, such as a snowpack on the precipitation or depressions on the path of direct runoff, combines the two. Its fluxes that map onto old ones split a volume, and the others are new connections.

paragraphs.en: Modulating the coefficients of a flux law (d) by the forcing or by conditional variables also leaves 𝑩 \bm{B} unchanged, since the conditional variables carry no water. By Law 2 the modulated flux must keep the sign of the potential difference, so a modulation is written as a multiplier, q = q 0 ​ M q=q_{0}M with M ≥ 0 M\geq 0 , which does not change the sign of the flux and keeps it zero when its store is empty. Where the modulated flux stays positive wherever q 0 q_{0} is, M = e m M=e^{m} , with m m a function of the states, the forcing and the conditional variables. A modulation that moves a threshold changes where the flux vanishes, and it belongs to the threshold distribution. Writing a lumped flux as a conductance times the difference of the lumped potentials is itself a closure. Where an exchange runs in different directions between different units, the conditional mean ( 7 ) need not have this form. The model then keeps the form and accepts the difference from ( 7 ) as a structural error, which, unlike the part of ℛ \mathcal{R} due to the composition, need not have zero mean for given aggregates and forcing. In return, the lumped model keeps the sign structure of the fine system for any values of its parameters, with no outflow from an empty store. paragraphs.en: By Laws 1–3, a lumped model is refined in four ways: (a) split a volume, with 𝚷 ′ ​ 𝐁 ′ = 𝐁 ​ 𝐊 \bm{\Pi}^{\prime}\bm{B}^{\prime}=\bm{B}\bm{K} ; (b) add a connection, a flux between two volumes that exchanged no water before or a flux between a volume and the boundary; (c) change the form of a flux law; (d) modulate the coefficients of a flux law (its conductance, its demand or its threshold distribution) by the forcing or by conditional variables 𝛘 \bm{\chi} , which are states that carry no water and leave 𝐁 \bm{B} unchanged. Operations (a) and (b) change the network and (c) changes the form of a flux law, all within Law 1 , with the sign of each new flux fixed by Law 2 , and (d) keeps the sign of the law it modulates. The memory of Law 3 can enter through three of them, as a chain of stores (a), as a convolution kernel (c), or as a multiplier or a shift of a threshold distribution driven by conditional variables (d). Each such refinement conserves water by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 依据定律 1–3，一个集总模型可以通过四种方式精细化：(a) 拆分一个体积，使得 𝚷′𝐁′=𝐁𝐊；(b) 增加一个连接，即两个此前没有水量交换的体积之间的通量，或一个体积与边界之间的通量；(c) 改变某个通量定律的形式；(d) 通过强迫或条件变量 𝛘 来调制通量定律的系数（其导通率、需求或阈值分布），这些条件变量是不携带水量且不改变 𝐁 的状态。 操作 (a) 和 (b) 改变网络，操作 (c) 改变某个通量定律的形式，这些均在定律 1 范围之内，且每个新通量的符号由定律 2 确定；操作 (d) 则保持其所调制的定律的符号不变。 定律 3 的记忆可以通过其中三种方式引入：作为一系列储水体（a），作为卷积核（c），或作为由条件变量驱动的阈值分布的乘子或平移（d）。 每一种这样的精细化都在构造上保证水量守恒。

paragraphs.en: We now write a parsimonious model consistent with Laws 1 – 3 . For a catchment represented by soil, fast-response and slow-response stores, Laws 1 and 2 require four classes of constitutive law: the partition of rain and the evaporation of soil water, drainage from the soil to groundwater, quick release and groundwater release. They also require a routing kernel for the water in transit to the outlet [ Rodríguez-Iturbe and Valdés, 1979 , Rinaldo et al., 1991 ] . We add the GR4J exchange with the exterior, restricted to losses, to increase accuracy. The model, CaRT (Capacity–Residence-Time model), has exactly one store for each class that needs a state (the soil, the quick path and the groundwater) and uses one parameter per law and one routing scale. It descends from the GR4J family [ Perrin et al., 2003 , Santos et al., 2018 ] but differs in the connection matrix and in the decoupling of parameters (Figure 1 , Table 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在写出一个与定律1–3一致的简约模型。 对于一个由土壤、快速响应和慢速响应蓄水体组成的流域，定律1和定律2要求四类本构关系：降雨的划分与土壤水的蒸发、从土壤到地下水的排水、快速释放以及地下水释放。 它们还需要一个汇流核来处理传输中的水到达出口的过程 [ Rodríguez-Iturbe and Valdés, 1979 , Rinaldo et al., 1991 ] 。 我们加入GR4J与外部的交换（仅限于水量损失），以提高精度。 该模型，CaRT（容量–滞留时间模型），对每个需要状态量的类别（土壤、快速路径和地下水）恰好各有一个蓄水体，并且每条定律使用一个参数，外加一个汇流尺度。 它源自GR4J模型家族 [ Perrin et al., 2003 , Santos et al., 2018 ] ，但在连接矩阵和参数解耦方面有所不同（图1，表3）。

paragraphs.en: On all three continents the liquid input P P comes from a degree-day snow store, a volume inserted on the precipitation path (operation a) that loses water to the atmosphere through sublimation (operation b). Because the composition of the snowpack across elevation is an O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) heterogeneity with a threshold, the store is split (operation a) into five elevation bands k k with temperatures T k = T + Γ ⁡ ( h ¯ − h k ) T_{k}=T+\Gamma(\bar{h}-h_{k}) . In band k k precipitation falls as snow, SFCF ​ P \mathrm{SFCF}\,P , when T k < T T T_{k}<T_{T} , and melt is min ⁡ ( N k , CFMAX ​ ( T k − T T ) + ) \min(N_{k},\mathrm{CFMAX}\,(T_{k}-T_{T})_{+}) . Sublimation u k = min ⁡ ( κ s ​ E , N k ) u_{k}=\min(\kappa_{s}E,N_{k}) removes snow to the atmosphere at a fraction κ s \kappa_{s} of the potential evaporation, which on the prairies represents sublimation losses from blowing snow [ Pomeroy et al., 1993 ] . This gives five parameters per catchment, T T T_{T} , CFMAX, SFCF, Γ \Gamma and κ s \kappa_{s} . The snowfall correction SFCF (between 0.5 and 1.5) multiplies the snowfall and is therefore a correction of the input. It changes the precipitation by a median of less than 0.1 % on CAMELS-GB and CAMELS-US, but by up to about ± 30 % \pm 30\,\% in individual CAMELS-US basins. The bands are equal-area on CAMELS-GB, whereas on CAMELS-US they are built from the 100 m elevation bands of the dataset and are generally not equal-area (Supporting Information S1.1).

paragraphs.en: Each process of CaRT is controlled by one parameter (Table 3 ): C C the partition and evaporation, K p K_{p} the soil drainage, X 3 X_{3} the quick release, τ \tau the groundwater release, X 4 X_{4} the routing kernel and X 2 X_{2} the exchange. The snow store adds five parameters, giving 11 per catchment. The catchment parameters are given by a static network with three hidden layers of 128 units, taking standardised catchment attributes as inputs (Supporting Information S1.7). It is trained jointly on all training catchments with the mean of 1 − NSE 1-\mathrm{NSE} as loss, and the same network predicts the parameters of catchments held out from training.

paragraphs.en: Law 3 and Corollary 1 say how CaRT may be refined, and we identify in a loop from the observations where it fails and what a refinement needs. A deficit is diagnosed by conditioning the residual on inputs and model states (Section 4.1 ), and a refinement is then derived with one admissible operation (Corollary 1 ). Each refinement has one of five origins (Table 4 ) and is exact when it aggregates a fine-scale assumption without approximation and asymptotic when the aggregate holds only in a limit. It is postulated when its form, together with any new state and its balance, is chosen by analogy with a known law. It is physical when it takes the form of a known physical law and heuristic when only the expected sign and bounds of its form are specified. Each refinement nests the model it refines where a natural limit exists (Section 4.2 ). Where no such limit exists, as for the Pareto partition and the viscosity term, it is assessed by the paired comparison alone. The refinement is kept if paired multi-seed comparisons on a development split show that it improves the model overall, or improves it in some classes of catchments without degrading it overall. The diagnosis is then repeated on the new model (Section 4.3 ). All models use the static attribute network of Section 3.2 for their per-catchment parameters and follow a common training protocol (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 定律3与推论1说明了CaRT可以如何被细化，我们在循环中从观察结果里找出它在哪里失效以及需要怎样的细化。 缺陷通过将残差以输入和模型状态为条件进行诊断（第4.1节），然后用一个可允许操作推导出细化（推论1）。 每个细化都有五种来源之一（表4），当它在无近似的情况下聚合一个细尺度假设时是精确的，而当该聚合仅在极限情况下成立时是渐近的。 当其形式连同任何新状态及其平衡是通过与已知定律类比而选取时，它是假设性的。 当它采取已知物理定律的形式时是物理性的，而当只规定其形式的预期符号和界限时是启发式的。 在存在自然极限之处，每个细化都嵌套了它所细化的模型（第4.2节）。 在不存在此类极限之处，例如Pareto划分和黏性项，则仅通过成对比较来评估。 如果在开发集上的成对多种子比较表明该细化整体上改进了模型，或在某些类别的流域中改进了模型而没有造成整体退化，则保留该细化。 然后在新模型上重复诊断（第4.3节）。 所有模型均使用第3.2节的静态属性网络来生成其各流域参数，并遵循统一的训练协议（附录D）。

paragraphs.en: We condition the residual Q obs − Q sim Q_{\rm obs}-Q_{\rm sim} on input quantities and model states, namely season, antecedent wetness, event rain depth, air temperature and the class of catchment (aridity, snow fraction, baseflow index). A conditional bias became a structural target when it appeared in the training period as well as the development period and was reproduced across training seeds. It also had to be predictable out of sample from the inputs, which we assessed with a per-catchment linear corrector of the residual, fitted on the training period and applied to the development period.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将残差 Q obs − Q sim Q_{\rm obs}-Q_{\rm sim} 以输入量和模型状态为条件，即季节、前期湿润程度、场次降雨量、气温以及流域类别（干旱度、降雪比例、基流指数）。 当某一条件性偏差同时出现在训练期与开发期，并且在不同训练随机种子下均可复现时，它就成为了一个结构性目标。 它还必须能够从输入中样本外预测，我们通过一个逐流域的残差线性校正器来评估这一点，该校正器在训练期拟合，并应用于开发期。

paragraphs.en: the sensitivity of melt timing to air temperature, from the shift of the spring flow centroid per degree of spring warming between years and between periods.
paragraphs.zh: 春季融雪时间对气温的敏感性，即每升温一摄氏度春季径流质心在年际间和时期之间的偏移量。

paragraphs.en: We located each deficit by continent and class of catchment. On both continents the error of the quick flow depended on antecedent wetness and on the season, and large events had approximately correct volumes but flatter peaks than observed. On CAMELS-US the quick-flow recession was slower than observed, and the rain-fed basins had a seasonal phase error and recessions that did not steepen with the evaporative demand. Flow was overestimated in the prairie basins, as were low flows in the dry basins, and snowmelt was too sensitive to air temperature. On CAMELS-GB, once connectivity had been added to the quick release, runoff from small events was overestimated and the event runoff ratio rose too slowly with rain depth. Flow was overestimated in summer in the high-baseflow catchments, and the spring-fed chalk and limestone streams lacked water that reaches them from beyond their divide.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按大洲和流域类型对每一项亏缺进行了定位。 在两个大洲上，快速径流的误差取决于前期湿度和季节，大事件的总量大致正确，但洪峰比实测更平缓。 在 CAMELS-US 上，快速径流的消退比实测更慢，雨水补给的流域存在季节性相位误差，且其消退过程未随蒸发需求增大而变陡。 草原流域的径流被高估，干旱流域的低流量也被高估，并且融雪对气温过于敏感。 在 CAMELS-GB 上，一旦将连通性加入快速释放过程，小事件的径流被高估，且事件径流系数随降雨深度的上升过慢。 高基流流域在夏季径流被高估，而由泉水补给的白垩和石灰岩河流缺少来自其分水岭之外的水量。

paragraphs.en: Each refinement below starts from a deficit diagnosed as in Section 4.1 on the model before it, takes a fine-scale hypothesis from the literature and derives its catchment-scale law with one admissible operation (Corollary 1 ). Where a parameter limit of the refinement recovers the model before it, that limit is given (Table 4 ), and a single static attribute network supplies all parameters. Figure 2 shows the resulting structure, and Table 4 lists the refinements and states which parts are exact aggregates and which are postulated. The connection matrix is in Appendix E , while Supporting Information S2 and S1 provide the derivation of each refinement and the daily update used in the implementation.

paragraphs.en: The quick-flow recession of CaRT was slower than observed on CAMELS-US, and on both continents the event-scale error depended on antecedent wetness, with quick flow under-simulated after dry spells and over-simulated after wet spells. Field studies and syntheses describe hillslopes that release water to the channel only once their wetness exceeds a threshold, with thresholds that vary from place to place, so that the connected fraction of the hillslope grows with wetness [ Western et al., 2001 , Tromp-van Meerveld and McDonnell, 2006 , Bracken and Croke, 2007 , Jencso et al., 2009 , Penna et al., 2011 ] . paragraphs.en: Linearised about its mean, θ \theta is an exponential moving average of net rain and demand, weighted by the mean wetness, with a time constant set by the catchment and its mean forcing (Appendix C ). paragraphs.en: On both continents large events had about the right volume but flatter peaks than observed, and quick flow was overestimated in winter and underestimated in summer, errors that we attribute to the release law. Aggregating the GR4J release a ​ ( R − x ) + 5 a(R-x)_{+}^{5} over depth thresholds x x with F x ∝ x k F_{x}\propto x^{k} at small depth, the integral ( 8 ), gives the exponent 5 + k 5+k within the power-law range, with k k the small-depth power of the threshold distribution. The release q r = a f ​ e m ​ R 5 ​ ( R / X 3 ) k q_{r}=a_{f}e^{m}R^{5}(R/X_{3})^{k} with k ≥ 0 k\geq 0 steepens at high storage and sharpens the peaks. The hydraulic conductivity of the quick-flow pathways is inversely proportional to the viscosity of water, K = κ ​ ρ ​ g / μ K=\kappa\rho g/\mu with κ \kappa the intrinsic permeability, so the log-multiplier gains − ln ⁡ [ μ ⁡ ( T ) / μ ⁡ ( 20 °C ) ] -\ln[\mu(T)/\mu($20\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolCelsius}$)] without free parameters [ Constantz, 1982 , Huber et al., 2009 ] . Air temperature stands in for water temperature and is clamped at 0 °C 0\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolCelsius} . Seasonally frozen soil reduces infiltration and the conductivity of shallow subsurface paths, with effects on runoff that depend on soil, snow and climate [ Shanley and Chalmers, 1999 , Stähli et al., 1999 , Bayard et al., 2005 , Iwata et al., 2010 , Ala-Aho et al., 2021 ] . In the model, frost raises the thresholds of the quick release by the frozen depth. We represent this rise by a storage-independent step of size a F ≥ 0 a_{F}\geq 0 in the log-multiplier, − a F ​ sig ⁡ ( ( T F − T ) / s F ) -a_{F}\operatorname{sig}((T_{F}-T)/s_{F}) , so that frost can only suppress the release. Here T T is the air temperature and T F T_{F} , s F s_{F} are global constants (learned near 0 °C 0\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolCelsius} and 2.3 °C 2.3\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolCelsius} ).
paragraphs.zh: 在两块大陆上，大型事件的总量大致正确，但峰值比观测结果更平缓，且快速径流在冬季被高估、夏季被低估，我们将这些误差归因于释放律。 将 GR4J 释放项 a(R−x)₊⁵ 对深度阈值 x 进行聚合，其中在小深度处 Fₓ ∝ xᵏ，通过积分 (8)，在幂律范围内得到指数 5+k，其中 k 是阈值分布的小深度幂。 释放项 qᵣ = a_f e^m R⁵ (R/X₃)^k（其中 k ≥ 0）在高储水量时变陡，并使峰值更尖锐。 快速流路径的水力传导度与水的黏度成反比，即 K = κρg/μ，其中 κ 为固有渗透率，因此对数乘子获得 −ln[μ(T)/μ(20 °C)]，且不含自由参数 [Constantz, 1982, Huber et al., 2009]。 气温被用来代替水温，并被限制在不低于 0 °C。 季节性冻土会降低入渗和浅层地下路径的传导度，其对径流的影响取决于土壤、积雪和气候 [Shanley and Chalmers, 1999, Stähli et al., 1999, Bayard et al., 2005, Iwata et al., 2010, Ala-Aho et al., 2021]。 在模型中，霜冻会按冻结深度提高快速释放的阈值。 我们用对数乘子中一个大小为 a_F ≥ 0 的、与储水量无关的阶跃 −a_F sig((T_F−T)/s_F) 来表示这一抬升，从而使霜冻只能抑制释放。 其中 T 为气温，T_F 和 s_F 为全局常数（学习到的值分别接近 0 °C 和 2.3 °C）。

paragraphs.en: On both continents the runoff ratio of events after dry spells was underestimated, as was that of small events in the arid basins of CAMELS-US. The model needed a part of the catchment that responds to each rainfall event regardless of hillslope state. This is the variable source area, a saturated zone next to the channel with an extent that varies with wetness [ Hewlett and Hibbert, 1967 , Dunne and Black, 1970 , Freeze, 1972 , Beven and Kirkby, 1979 ] . A fraction w w of the soil volume next to the channel is therefore given a small capacity C z C_{z} and a water table close to the surface, with storage governed by Z ˙ = P n ​ ( 1 − z 2 ) − E n ​ z ​ ( 2 − z ) − Z / τ z \dot{Z}=P_{n}(1-z^{2})-E_{n}z(2-z)-Z/\tau_{z} , z = Z / C z z=Z/C_{z} . Saturation excess P n ​ z 2 P_{n}z^{2} is routed as direct runoff, and drainage Z / τ z Z/\tau_{z} goes straight to the outlet. The limit w → 0 w\to 0 recovers CaRT, and the limiting cases of this family include an impervious area, a linear interflow store and the variable source area. The zone’s flux laws are postulated by analogy with the production store.

paragraphs.en: On CAMELS-GB, once the release was connected, runoff from small events was overestimated. The first millimetres of each event are held by canopy, litter and the top soil and returned to the atmosphere at the demand rate by interception and stage-one soil evaporation [ Rutter et al., 1971 , Ritchie, 1972 ] . We represent these processes by splitting the soil volume into a thin surface layer U U and the root zone S S below it. The layer receives the liquid input, evaporates at the demand rate, passes on water exceeding the capacity C u C_{u} and drains the rest linearly with time constant τ u \tau_{u} . Overflow and drainage enter the root zone with the remaining demand. Merging U U and S S recovers the columns of CaRT, and τ u → 0 \tau_{u}\to 0 recovers the CaRT same-day interception min ⁡ ( P , E ) \min(P,E) exactly once the layer is empty (from the second day on) [ Ficchì et al., 2019 , cf. the interception store of] .
paragraphs.zh: 在 CAMELS-GB 上，一旦接通了释放（release），小事件的径流就会被高估。 每个事件最初的几毫米水分被冠层、枯落物和表层土壤截留，并由截留蒸发和第一阶段土壤蒸发以需求速率返还到大气中 [ Rutter et al., 1971 , Ritchie, 1972 ] 。 我们通过将土壤体积划分为一个薄表层 U U 和其下方的根区 S S 来表示这些过程。 该薄表层接收液态输入，以需求速率蒸发，将超过容量 C u C_{u} 的水分向下传递，并使其余水分以时间常数 τ u \tau_{u} 线性排水。 溢流和排水在剩余需求的作用下进入根区。 合并 U U 与 S S 即可恢复 CaRT 的土柱结构，而 τ u → 0 \tau_{u}\to 0 则恰好恢复 CaRT 的当日截留 min ⁡ ( P , E ) \min(P,E) ——在该薄表层排空之后（从第二天起） [ Ficchì et al., 2019 , cf. the interception store of ] 。

paragraphs.en: On CAMELS-GB the event runoff ratio rose too slowly with rain depth. Where storage capacities and infiltration capacities are distributed within the catchment, saturation excess [ Moore, 1985 , Zhao, 1992 ] and infiltration excess [ Horton, 1933 , Philip, 1957 , Hawkins and Cundy, 1987 ] grow gradually with rain depth. Section 2.2 derives exact expressions for both aggregates when rain is uniform over the catchment and the day. The root-zone partition η = s 2 \eta=s^{2} is replaced by the Pareto aggregate ( 9 ) with shape b b , a different member of the same class that does not nest η = s 2 \eta=s^{2} . Infiltration excess over exponentially distributed capacities, i e = P n − F ( 1 − e − P n / F ) i_{e}=P_{n}-F(1-e^{-P_{n}/F}) , is taken off the water that leaves the surface layer and routed with the direct runoff. This excess is the integral ( 8 ) over the capacities and is exact for rain uniform in space and in time within the day. The mean capacity falls with a near-surface wetness ω \omega shared by the catchment, and because ω \omega scales all local capacities alike, the aggregate stays exact (Appendix C ). The wetness ω \omega is an exponential moving average of the water leaving the surface layer with a time constant of 3 days, which is the exact daily solution of a linear balance driven by that water. The scale function in F = P ∗ e − g F ω / ω ¯ F=P^{*}e^{-g_{F}\omega/\bar{\omega}} is heuristic, with ω ¯ \bar{\omega} the scale of ω \omega , and this construction is an example of how memory effects enter the threshold distribution function.

We made the evaporative demand follow the seasonal activity of vegetation, which lags air temperature [ Chuine, 2000 ] , and added groundwater uptake by riparian vegetation [ Loheide et al., 2005 ] . The demand becomes E dem = PET ⁡ [ 1 − κ ⁡ ( 1 − v ) ] E_{\rm dem}=\mathrm{PET}[1-\kappa(1-v)] , where the vegetation-activity variable v v is a conditional variable that relaxes towards sig ⁡ ( ( T − T v ) / s v ) \operatorname{sig}((T-T_{v})/s_{v}) with time constant τ v \tau_{v} . paragraphs.en: GR4J sends a fixed 10 % of direct runoff past the quick store. However, under the connectivity hypothesis above, surface runoff reaches the channel only from connected units. On a connected unit it reaches the channel directly with probability γ \gamma and otherwise infiltrates into the unit’s quick-flow layer, while on a disconnected unit it re-infiltrates downslope. If runoff production is independent of the connection thresholds, the bypass fraction aggregates exactly to α t = γ ​ A ​ ( θ t ) \alpha_{t}=\gamma A(\theta_{t}) for hillslope runoff and to γ \gamma for the near-stream zone, which is always connected. In CaRT + the runoff of all sources is mixed in the depressions, and γ ​ A ​ ( θ t ) \gamma A(\theta_{t}) is applied to the whole spill. The values A ≡ 1 A\equiv 1 and γ = 0.1 \gamma=0.1 recover the GR4J split, so the constant is replaced by one parameter and this connected fraction now controls both the release and the routing of quick flow. Because A A is shared with the release, this limit recovers the previous model where its release is fully connected.

paragraphs.en: Streamflow was overestimated in the low-relief prairie basins of CAMELS-US, most in autumn, in the low flows and in the events of winter and spring. In such landscapes surface depressions fill before they spill, and much of the catchment does not contribute to streamflow until they are full [ Shook and Pomeroy, 2011 ] . Direct runoff therefore first fills depressions with capacities that follow a Pareto distribution. The exact spill is calculated by applying the aggregation ( 9 ) to depression capacities, each of which spills to the flow path on its own. The stored water seeps to the groundwater store and evaporates at a fraction of the remaining demand, a fraction that falls as the depressions empty. A vanishing mean capacity recovers the model without depressions.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CAMELS-US 的低起伏草原流域中，径流被高估了，主要在秋季、在低流量时以及冬季和春季的洪水事件中。 在这类景观中，地表洼地会先蓄满然后才溢流，并且在洼地蓄满之前，流域的大部分区域对径流没有贡献 [ Shook and Pomeroy, 2011 ] 。 因此，直接径流首先填蓄那些容量服从 Pareto 分布的洼地。 精确的溢流通过对洼地容量应用聚合式 ( 9 ) 来计算，其中每个洼地各自独立地溢流到其流路上。 蓄存的水以剩余需求的一定比例下渗到地下水储库并蒸发，该比例随洼地排空而下降。 当平均容量趋于零时，即可恢复为没有洼地的模型。

paragraphs.en: The spring-fed chalk and limestone streams of CAMELS-GB receive groundwater from beyond their topographic divide, and some, such as Costa Beck, carry more water than falls on their catchment. CaRT cannot supply this water because the exchange is restricted to losses. Law 2 admits an inflow across the boundary only down a head difference. For a flux that does not decrease as the head difference increases and an exterior of fixed head, the exchange is j ext = L ⁡ [ H ext − g ⁡ ( R / X 3 ) ] j_{\rm ext}=L\,[H_{\rm ext}-g(R/X_{3})] , g ⁡ ( r ) = r 3.5 g(r)=r^{3.5} , with a conductance L ≥ 0 L\geq 0 , and the exchange of CaRT is the case H ext = 0 H_{\rm ext}=0 , X 2 = − L X_{2}=-L . A positive exterior head adds a constant inflow J = L ​ H ext J=LH_{\rm ext} , so the store gains water when it is low and loses it when it is high, with a stable equilibrium in between. This adds to the exchange of GR4J the threshold at which the exchange changes sign, as in GR5J and GR6J [ Pushpalatha et al., 2011 ] . paragraphs.en: CaRT + extends the network of CaRT with operations (a) and (b) of Corollary 1 . Splitting volumes adds a surface layer above the root zone, a near-stream zone beside it and surface depressions on the path of direct runoff. New boundary fluxes connect stores to the atmosphere and the outlet through groundwater uptake, the evaporation of the depressions and the drainage of the near-stream zone. Operations (c) and (d) change the laws on this network, and most of these changes take their form from one of two constructions (Figure 2 , Table 4 ). Threshold aggregation (Law 3 ) gives one formula, ( 8 ), for the saturation excess of the root zone, the infiltration excess, the release exponent, the fill-and-spill of the depressions, the transmission loss of the channel and the connected fraction of the hillslope. Already in CaRT, this formula produces the quadratic groundwater law. Variables that carry no water modulate the fluxes (operation d). Hillslope wetness, near-surface wetness and vegetation activity follow the forcing with lags set by their own time constants, which is the memory form of Law 3 . Of the memory forms of Table 2 , CaRT + realises the water in transit of the unit hydrographs and the shared driving variables θ \theta , ω \omega and v v . However, the turning points of units that fill and spill, such as the root zone and the depressions, are not represented. The variables θ \theta , ω \omega and v v , together with the connected fraction, the groundwater head, the viscosity of water and frost, enter only as multipliers of four flux coefficients, those of the quick release, the bypass, the infiltration capacity and the evaporative demand. Law 2 fixes the directions, so that the exchange is a loss plus an inflow from a fixed exterior head, and the threshold shifts and the frost step act one way. The evaporation of the stores and the groundwater uptake are bounded by the demand.
paragraphs.zh: CaRT + 在 CaRT 的网络上扩展了推论 1 的运算 (a) 和 (b)。 划分水量单元会在根区上方增加一个地表层，其旁增加一个近河带，并在直接径流路径上增加地表洼地。 新的边界通量通过地下水补给、洼地蒸发和近河带排水，把各蓄水体与大气和出口连接起来。 运算 (c) 和 (d) 改变了该网络上的定律，这些改变大多采取两种构造之一的形式（图 2，表 4）。 阈值聚合（定律 3）给出了一个公式（8），用于描述根区的饱和超渗、入渗超渗、释放指数、洼地的填充-溢流、河道的传输损失以及山坡的连通比例。 早在 CaRT 中，该公式就产生了二次地下水定律。 不携带水的变量对通量起调制作用（运算 d）。 山坡湿度、近地表湿度和植被活动跟随强迫变化，并带有由其自身时间常数决定的滞后，这就是定律 3 的记忆形式。 在表 2 的记忆形式中，CaRT + 实现了单位线的水量在途以及共享的驱动变量 θ \theta、ω \omega 和 v v。 然而，发生填充与溢流的单元（如根区和洼地）的转折点并未被表示出来。 变量 θ \theta、ω \omega 和 v v，连同连通比例、地下水水头、水的黏度和霜冻，仅作为四个通量系数的乘子出现，即快速释放、旁路、入渗能力和蒸发需求这四个系数。 定律 2 固定了方向，使得交换成为一项损失加上来自固定外部水头的入流，且阈值偏移和霜冻阶跃只单向起作用。 各蓄水体的蒸发和地下水补给都受需求量的约束。

paragraphs.en: The state of CaRT + has fourteen variables, eleven of which are water stores: five snow bands, the surface layer, root zone, near-stream zone, depressions, quick store and groundwater store. The three conditional variables are hillslope wetness, near-surface wetness and vegetation activity, while the unit hydrographs hold additional water in transit. CaRT + has 35 parameters per catchment and seven global constants, one value per dataset for the frost step, the connection thresholds and the vegetation activity (Supporting Information S1). The per-catchment parameters are regionalised by one static network that takes 21 (CAMELS-GB) or 27 (CAMELS-US, CAMELS-AUS) standardised catchment attributes as inputs. The network is trained jointly on the training catchments of a dataset and applied unchanged to the held-out catchments.

sents.en: The three conditional variables are hillslope wetness, near-surface wetness and vegetation activity, while the unit hydrographs hold additional water in transit.
sents.zh: 三个条件变量是山坡湿度、近地表湿度和植被活动，而单位线则在输送过程中额外持有水量。

sents.en: CaRT + has 35 parameters per catchment and seven global constants, one value per dataset for the frost step, the connection thresholds and the vegetation activity (Supporting Information S1).

paragraphs.en: Because the laws restrict the candidates, we ran the refinement as an iterative loop with the help of AI agents. Figure 3 shows the loop, and Figure 4 shows where the laws enter it. A deficit is diagnosed on the observations (Section 4.1 ) and attributed to a store or flux and to the variable that conditions it. A refinement is derived with one admissible operation (Corollary 1 ) and, where the deficit depends on history, with a closure of Law 3 , nesting the previous model where a limit exists. The refinement is then trained with several seeds and compared catchment by catchment on development splits with the model it refines. On CAMELS-US, training runs from October 1980 to September 1995 and development from October 1995 to September 2010, and the corresponding periods on CAMELS-GB are 1989–1999 and 2000–2010, all before the test period 2011–2019 of Section 5 . The refinement is kept if it improves the model overall, or in some classes of catchments without degrading it overall, and the diagnosis is repeated.
paragraphs.zh: 由于这些定律对候选方案构成了限制，我们在 AI 智能体的辅助下将细化过程设计为一个迭代循环。 图 3 展示了该循环，图 4 展示了这些定律在循环中的切入点。 首先在观测数据上诊断出亏损（第 4.1 节），并将其归因于某个状态变量或通量，以及对其起条件作用的变量。 然后通过一个可采纳的运算推导出细化（推论 1），当亏损依赖于历史时，再结合定律 3 的闭合，在极限存在的情况下将先前的模型嵌套其中。 随后使用多个随机种子对细化模型进行训练，并在开发集上逐流域地与它所细化的模型进行比较。 在 CAMELS-US 上，训练期为 1980 年 10 月至 1995 年 9 月，开发期为 1995 年 10 月至 2010 年 9 月；CAMELS-GB 上的对应时段为 1989–1999 年和 2000–2010 年，均早于第 5 节的 2011–2019 年测试期。 如果细化模型在整体上优于原模型，或者在某些类型的流域上有所改进而不降低整体性能，则予以保留，并重复诊断过程。

sents.en: Because the laws restrict the candidates, we ran the refinement as an iterative loop with the help of AI agents.
sents.zh: 由于这些定律对候选方案构成了限制，我们在 AI 智能体的辅助下将细化过程设计为一个迭代循环。

sents.en: Figure 3 shows the loop, and Figure 4 shows where the laws enter it.
sents.zh: 图 3 展示了该循环，图 4 展示了这些定律在循环中的切入点。

sents.en: On CAMELS-US, training runs from October 1980 to September 1995 and development from October 1995 to September 2010, and the corresponding periods on CAMELS-GB are 1989–1999 and 2000–2010, all before the test period 2011–2019 of Section 5 .
sents.zh: 在 CAMELS-US 上，训练期为 1980 年 10 月至 1995 年 9 月，开发期为 1995 年 10 月至 2010 年 9 月；CAMELS-GB 上的对应时段为 1989–1999 年和 2000–2010 年，均早于第 5 节的 2011–2019 年测试期。

sents.en: The refinement is kept if it improves the model overall, or in some classes of catchments without degrading it overall, and the diagnosis is repeated.
sents.zh: 如果细化模型在整体上优于原模型，或者在某些类型的流域上有所改进而不降低整体性能，则予以保留，并重复诊断过程。

paragraphs.en: The loop was executed by AI agents (Claude Code from Anthropic and Codex from OpenAI) under the author’s instructions and the constraints of Laws 1 – 3 . The agents mainly shortened each cycle, so that a diagnosed deficit became a verified, trained candidate within hours and more admissible hypotheses could be tried. The author guided the search throughout and often redirected the agents on the basis of an understanding of the processes.
paragraphs.zh: 该循环由AI智能体（Anthropic的Claude Code和OpenAI的Codex）在作者的指示以及定律1–3的约束下执行。 智能体主要缩短了每个周期，使得诊断出的缺陷能在数小时内成为经过验证和训练的候选方案，从而可以尝试更多可采纳的假设。 作者在整个搜索过程中进行引导，并经常基于对过程的理解来重新指导智能体。

paragraphs.en: All models on the three continents are trained on 1989-01-01 to 2008-12-31 with a spin-up period (details in Appendix D ), and checkpoints or epochs are selected on the median NSE over 2009–2010. The models are evaluated on the held-out period 2011-01-01 to 2019-12-31, which was not used to fit the parameters or to select checkpoints or epochs. One structural choice, the snow store of CAMELS-GB, was first adopted after results for this period had been seen and was confirmed afterwards on the development split. The other structural choices of Section 4 were made on the development splits, and the seed-averaging analysis of Section 5.2 uses the test period after the structure was fixed. On each continent 10 % of the catchments are held out from training and selection altogether and predicted from their attributes alone ( ungauged ), while the remaining catchments are gauged . All regional models are trained with three seeds. Each metric is computed for each seed and catchment and averaged over the seeds, after which we report the median of this seed-mean metric over catchments. Differences between models are tested using the paired per-catchment difference, with 95 % bootstrap intervals for the median paired difference (resampling catchments only, with seeds held fixed). Comparisons of single models set one trained structure against another, and the metrics of the three-seed ensemble (mean of the simulations) are reported alongside.
paragraphs.zh: 三大洲的所有模型均在 1989-01-01 至 2008-12-31 上训练并包含预热期（细节见附录 D），检查点或轮次根据 2009–2010 年的中位 NSE 选取。 模型在留出的 2011-01-01 至 2019-12-31 时段上进行评估，该时段既未用于拟合参数，也未用于选择检查点或轮次。 有一个结构性选择，即 CAMELS-GB 的积雪储量，是在看到该时段的结果之后才首次采用的，随后在开发集上得到了确认。 第 4 节的其他结构性选择均在开发集上做出，而第 5.2 节的种子平均分析则在结构确定之后使用测试时段。 在每个大洲上，10% 的流域完全从训练和选择中留出，仅根据其属性进行预测（无实测数据），其余流域为有实测数据的流域。 所有区域模型均使用三个种子进行训练。 每个指标针对每个种子和流域分别计算，并对种子取平均，随后我们报告该种子平均指标在流域上的中位数。 模型之间的差异通过成对的逐流域差值进行检验，并给出中位成对差值的 95% 自助法区间（仅对流域进行重采样，种子保持不变）。 单一模型之间的比较是将一个训练后的结构与其他结构进行对比，同时一并报告三种子集合（模拟结果的均值）的指标。

paragraphs.en: Daily catchment-mean precipitation, air temperature, potential evapotranspiration with interception correction and specific discharge are available for the 671 catchments of CAMELS-GB [ Coxon et al., 2020 ] , with discharge after September 2015 taken from the extended series. The data also include 21 static attributes (area, elevation, soil texture, porosity, conductivity and depth, land cover, reservoir capacity, climate indices). Five band elevations are used by the conceptual models in their snow store and supplied to the LSTMs as attributes. The ungauged set is 67 catchments of CAMELS-GB, most of which have short discharge records before 2009 and 64 of which have at least one year of test data.
paragraphs.zh: CAMELS-GB [ Coxon et al., 2020 ] 的671个流域提供了日均流域平均降水量、气温、经截留校正的潜在蒸散发和比流量，其中2015年9月之后的流量取自延长的序列。 数据还包括21个静态属性（面积、高程、土壤质地、孔隙度、导水率和深度、土地覆盖、水库库容、气候指数）。 五个高程分带被概念模型用于其积雪储量，并作为属性提供给LSTM。 未测流集合为CAMELS-GB的67个流域，其中大多数在2009年之前只有较短的流量记录，64个流域至少有一年的测试数据。

paragraphs.en: We use the 671 CAMELS basins [ Newman et al., 2015 , Addor et al., 2017 ] with the 27 static attributes of Kratzert et al. [2019b] and the five band elevations, which are used as described for CAMELS-GB. The forcing is Daymet version 4 [ Thornton et al., 2021 ] , averaged over the CAMELS basin polygons for 1980–2019, with potential evaporation from the Priestley–Taylor equation [ Priestley and Taylor, 1972 ] . Discharge is taken from the CAMELS record to 2014 and extended to 2019 from the USGS National Water Information System. Version 4 is used because in the version distributed with CAMELS most of a day’s rain is recorded on the following day (Appendix D ). The ungauged set is 68 basins (10 %) drawn at random within strata of snow fraction and aridity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 671 个 CAMELS 流域 [ Newman et al., 2015 , Addor et al., 2017 ] ，以及 Kratzert et al. 的 27 个静态属性。 [2019b] 以及五个高程带，其使用方式如针对 CAMELS-GB 所描述的那样。 气象强迫数据为 Daymet 第 4 版 [ Thornton et al., 2021 ] ，在 1980–2019 年期间对 CAMELS 流域多边形取平均，潜在蒸发由 Priestley–Taylor 方程计算 [ Priestley and Taylor, 1972 ] 。 径流数据取自 CAMELS 记录至 2014 年，并从美国地质调查局国家水信息系统（USGS National Water Information System）延伸至 2019 年。 之所以使用第 4 版，是因为随 CAMELS 分发的版本中，一天的大部分降雨被记录在次日（附录 D ）。 未设站集合为 68 个流域（10%），按降雪比例和干旱度分层随机抽取。

paragraphs.en: To test the transfer to a continent that played no part in development, we add the 561 catchments of CAMELS-AUS version 2 [ Fowler et al., 2025 ] that have at least one year of discharge in 1989–2008. Precipitation and air temperature are those of the Australian Gridded Climate Data and potential evapotranspiration is the Morton wet-environment estimate of SILO, all as distributed with the dataset, for 1980–2019. The 27 static attributes cover the same climate, topographic, land-cover, soil and geological properties as the CAMELS-US set, with the seasonal amplitude of net primary productivity in place of that of leaf area. Band elevations are not provided with the dataset and are drawn from a normal hypsometry centred on the mean elevation of each catchment and truncated at its lowest and highest elevation. The ungauged set is 56 catchments (10 %) drawn at random within strata of aridity and elevation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验模型向一个未参与训练过程的大陆的迁移能力，我们加入 CAMELS-AUS 第 2 版 [ Fowler et al., 2025 ] 中在 1989–2008 年间至少有一年径流数据的 561 个流域。 降水和气温采用澳大利亚网格化气候数据（Australian Gridded Climate Data），潜在蒸散发采用 SILO 的 Morton 湿环境估算值，均使用数据集随附的 1980–2019 年数据。 这 27 个静态属性涵盖与 CAMELS-US 属性集相同的气候、地形、土地覆盖、土壤和地质特性，只是以净初级生产力的季节振幅替代叶面积指数的季节振幅。 数据集未提供各高程带的高程值，因此以每个流域的平均高程为中心、以该流域最低和最高高程为截断范围，从正态高程分布中抽取。 未设站集为 56 个流域（10%），在干旱度和高程的分层内随机抽取。
