sents.en: Band elevations are not provided with the dataset and are drawn from a normal hypsometry centred on the mean elevation of each catchment and truncated at its lowest and highest elevation.
sents.zh: 数据集未提供各高程带的高程值，因此以每个流域的平均高程为中心、以该流域最低和最高高程为截断范围，从正态高程分布中抽取。

sents.en: The ungauged set is 56 catchments (10 %) drawn at random within strata of aridity and elevation.
sents.zh: 未设站集为 56 个流域（10%），在干旱度和高程的分层内随机抽取。

paragraphs.en: HBV : the HBV-light structure [ Bergström, 1995 , Seibert and Vis, 2012 ] with its snow routine on the same five elevation bands, 15 parameters per catchment, implemented as differentiable kernels and regionalised exactly as CaRT, with static parameters and a single component.
paragraphs.zh: HBV：采用 HBV-light 结构 [ Bergström, 1995 , Seibert and Vis, 2012 ]，其在相同的五个高程带上使用积雪程序，每个流域 15 个参数，以可微核实现，并且其区域化方式与 CaRT 完全相同，采用静态参数和单一组件。

paragraphs.en: dHBV : the differentiable HBV of Feng et al. [2022] , re-implemented on our data. It has sixteen parallel HBV components with daily β \beta and β ET \beta_{\rm ET} , whose parameters come from an LSTM that takes the forcing and attributes as inputs. The original minimises a combination of root-mean-square errors and uses Hargreaves potential evaporation. Here the model is trained with the NSE loss and receives the same potential evaporation as the other models.
paragraphs.zh: dHBV：Feng 等人的可微分 HBV 模型。 [2022]，在我们的数据上重新实现。 它包含十六个并行的 HBV 组件，具有逐日的 β \beta 和 β ET \beta_{\rm ET}，其参数来自一个以驱动数据和属性为输入的 LSTM。 原始模型最小化均方根误差的组合，并使用 Hargreaves 潜在蒸散发。 这里该模型使用 NSE 损失进行训练，并接收与其他模型相同的潜在蒸散发。

sents.en: dHBV : the differentiable HBV of Feng et al.
sents.zh: dHBV：Feng 等人的可微分 HBV 模型。

sents.en: [2022] , re-implemented on our data.
sents.zh: [2022]，在我们的数据上重新实现。

sents.en: It has sixteen parallel HBV components with daily β \beta and β ET \beta_{\rm ET} , whose parameters come from an LSTM that takes the forcing and attributes as inputs.
sents.zh: 它包含十六个并行的 HBV 组件，具有逐日的 β \beta 和 β ET \beta_{\rm ET}，其参数来自一个以驱动数据和属性为输入的 LSTM。

sents.en: The original minimises a combination of root-mean-square errors and uses Hargreaves potential evaporation.
sents.zh: 原始模型最小化均方根误差的组合，并使用 Hargreaves 潜在蒸散发。

sents.en: Here the model is trained with the NSE loss and receives the same potential evaporation as the other models.
sents.zh: 这里该模型使用 NSE 损失进行训练，并接收与其他模型相同的潜在蒸散发。

paragraphs.en: LSTM : a stateful LSTM (256 units) that takes the daily precipitation, mean air temperature and potential evaporation and the same static attributes as inputs, run continuously over the record and trained by truncated back-propagation through time on all three continents (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: LSTM：一个有状态的 LSTM（256 个单元），以日降水量、平均气温和潜在蒸散发以及相同的静态属性作为输入，在整个记录时段内连续运行，并通过时间截断反向传播在三个大洲上进行训练（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: EA-LSTM : the entity-aware LSTM of Kratzert et al. [2019b] , in which the static attributes set the input gate, with the inputs of the stateful LSTM and otherwise the configuration of that paper, except for the length of the input sequences (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: EA-LSTM：即 Kratzert 等人的实体感知 LSTM。 [2019b]，其中静态属性用于设置输入门，输入来自有状态的 LSTM，其余配置沿用该论文，仅输入序列长度不同（见附录 D）。

sents.en: EA-LSTM : the entity-aware LSTM of Kratzert et al.
sents.zh: EA-LSTM：即 Kratzert 等人的实体感知 LSTM。

sents.en: [2019b] , in which the static attributes set the input gate, with the inputs of the stateful LSTM and otherwise the configuration of that paper, except for the length of the input sequences (Appendix D ).
sents.zh: [2019b]，其中静态属性用于设置输入门，输入来自有状态的 LSTM，其余配置沿用该论文，仅输入序列长度不同（见附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: CaRT, HBV and CaRT + are trained for 5000 iterations with the same optimiser (Appendix D ), while dHBV and the two LSTMs use their own schedules, and every model keeps the checkpoint or epoch with the highest median NSE over the selection period. The metrics include NSE, KGE [ Gupta et al., 2009 ] , NSE of log flow, the flow-duration-curve biases FHV and FLV [ Yilmaz et al., 2008 ] , the volume bias of the low-flow segment (the lowest 30 % of the flow-duration curve) and the number of catchments with NSE < 0 <0 . We also report medians over classes of catchments (by baseflow index and snow fraction on CAMELS-GB and by snow fraction and aridity on CAMELS-US).
paragraphs.zh: CaRT、HBV 和 CaRT + 使用相同的优化器训练 5000 次迭代（附录 D），而 dHBV 和两个 LSTM 使用各自的调度方案，且每个模型保留在选择期内中位数 NSE 最高的检查点或轮次。 评估指标包括 NSE、KGE [ Gupta et al., 2009 ]、对数流量的 NSE、流量历时曲线偏差 FHV 和 FLV [ Yilmaz et al., 2008 ]、低流量段（流量历时曲线最低的 30 %）的体积偏差，以及 NSE < 0 <0 的流域数量。 我们还报告了流域类别上的中位数（在 CAMELS-GB 上按基流指数和降雪比例划分，在 CAMELS-US 上按降雪比例和干旱程度划分）。

sents.en: CaRT, HBV and CaRT + are trained for 5000 iterations with the same optimiser (Appendix D ), while dHBV and the two LSTMs use their own schedules, and every model keeps the checkpoint or epoch with the highest median NSE over the selection period.
sents.zh: CaRT、HBV 和 CaRT + 使用相同的优化器训练 5000 次迭代（附录 D），而 dHBV 和两个 LSTM 使用各自的调度方案，且每个模型保留在选择期内中位数 NSE 最高的检查点或轮次。

sents.en: The metrics include NSE, KGE [ Gupta et al., 2009 ] , NSE of log flow, the flow-duration-curve biases FHV and FLV [ Yilmaz et al., 2008 ] , the volume bias of the low-flow segment (the lowest 30 % of the flow-duration curve) and the number of catchments with NSE < 0 <0 .
sents.zh: 评估指标包括 NSE、KGE [ Gupta et al., 2009 ]、对数流量的 NSE、流量历时曲线偏差 FHV 和 FLV [ Yilmaz et al., 2008 ]、低流量段（流量历时曲线最低的 30 %）的体积偏差，以及 NSE < 0 <0 的流域数量。

sents.en: We also report medians over classes of catchments (by baseflow index and snow fraction on CAMELS-GB and by snow fraction and aridity on CAMELS-US).
sents.zh: 我们还报告了流域类别上的中位数（在 CAMELS-GB 上按基流指数和降雪比例划分，在 CAMELS-US 上按降雪比例和干旱程度划分）。

paragraphs.en: We first compare single models, averaging each catchment metric over the three seeds, to isolate the effect of structure, with the three-seed ensembles reported alongside (Tables 5 – 7 , Figure 5 ). As a single model, CaRT + matches the two LSTMs on both continents. It is behind the stateful LSTM by 0.004 [0.003, 0.006] in paired NSE on CAMELS-GB and ahead of it by 0.008 [0.004, 0.011] on CAMELS-US, and within 0.001 of the EA-LSTM on both. It improves on every process-based benchmark (CaRT, dHBV and HBV) by 0.015–0.031 on CAMELS-GB and 0.031–0.056 on CAMELS-US, while the stateful LSTM keeps a lead in the NSE of log flow (0.013 and 0.017). On CAMELS-GB CaRT + has no gauged catchment with a negative NSE and reproduces the shape of the low-flow segment better than the LSTMs (FLV − 16 % -16\,\% against − 28 -28 and − 19 % -19\,\% ). On CAMELS-US its weaknesses are the lower tail of the NSE distribution and the dry season, with NSE below zero in 21 gauged basins (17 and 13 for the LSTMs). CaRT + overestimates low-flow volume by 30 % (17 and 45 % for the stateful LSTM and the EA-LSTM).
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先比较单一模型，将每个流域的指标在三颗种子上取平均，以分离结构带来的影响，并同时报告三种子集成模型的结果（表5–7、图5）。 作为单一模型，CaRT+ 在两个大陆上都可与两个 LSTM 相媲美。 在 CAMELS-GB 上，其配对 NSE 落后有状态 LSTM 0.004 [0.003, 0.006]，在 CAMELS-US 上领先 0.008 [0.004, 0.011]，且在两者上与 EA-LSTM 的差距均在 0.001 以内。 在 CAMELS-GB 上，它比每个基于过程的基准模型（CaRT、dHBV 和 HBV）提高 0.015–0.031，在 CAMELS-US 上提高 0.031–0.056，而有状态 LSTM 在对数流量的 NSE 上保持领先（分别为 0.013 和 0.017）。 在 CAMELS-GB 上，CaRT+ 没有任何实测流域的 NSE 为负，并且比两个 LSTM 更好地复现了低流量段的形状（FLV 为 −16% 对 −28% 和 −19%）。 在 CAMELS-US 上，其弱点在于 NSE 分布的下尾和干季，有 21 个实测流域的 NSE 低于零（两个 LSTM 分别为 17 个和 13 个）。 CaRT+ 将低流量体积高估了 30%（有状态 LSTM 和 EA-LSTM 分别为 17% 和 45%）。

paragraphs.en: Averaging three seeds changes the order, with paired NSE gains of 0.009 (CAMELS-GB) and 0.027 (CAMELS-US) in the median catchment for the stateful LSTM, against 0.007 and 0.016 for the EA-LSTM and 0.002 and 0.006 for CaRT + . The ensembles of the stateful LSTM and the EA-LSTM lead the CaRT + ensemble by 0.011 and 0.003 on CAMELS-GB and by 0.012 and 0.008 on CAMELS-US (Table 7 ). In each catchment the gain of an ensemble in NSE equals the time-mean spread of its members divided by the variance of the observed flow [ Krogh and Vedelsby, 1995 ] , and it vanishes when the members agree. The spread of the CaRT + seeds is about a quarter of that of the stateful LSTM. A smaller share of this spread falls on the days above the observed 95 % flow quantile (32 and 53 %, against 57 and 69 % for the stateful LSTM; Table 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对三个随机种子取平均会改变排序：有状态 LSTM 在中位数流域的配对 NSE 增益为 0.009（CAMELS-GB）和 0.027（CAMELS-US），而 EA-LSTM 为 0.007 和 0.016，CaRT + 为 0.002 和 0.006。 有状态 LSTM 与 EA-LSTM 的集成在 CAMELS-GB 上分别领先 CaRT + 集成 0.011 和 0.003，在 CAMELS-US 上分别领先 0.012 和 0.008（表 7）。 在每个流域中，集成的 NSE 增益等于其成员的时间平均离散度除以观测流量的方差 [ Krogh and Vedelsby, 1995 ]，当各成员意见一致时该增益趋于零。 CaRT + 种子的离散度约为有状态 LSTM 的四分之一。 该离散度中落在观测流量 95% 分位数以上天数的比例较小（32% 和 53%，而有状态 LSTM 为 57% 和 69%；表 9）。

paragraphs.en: On CAMELS-GB the class medians of the single CaRT + and the stateful LSTM differ by at most 0.003 in three of the four classes (Table 8 ). In the groundwater-fed catchments the median of the LSTM is higher by 0.008, although the refinements raised the NSE of CaRT + most there. On CAMELS-US the class medians of CaRT + exceed those of the stateful LSTM in every class, by 0.008 in the humid to 0.032 in the arid basins, and fall below those of the EA-LSTM in the snow-dominated and arid basins. On the maps (Figures 6 and 7 ) the differences are small almost everywhere on CAMELS-GB. On CAMELS-US they are clustered, with the LSTMs ahead in the semi-arid northern Great Plains and Texas and CaRT + in the upper Midwest and the east. The held-out catchments are discussed in Section 5.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在 CAMELS-GB 上，单一 CaRT+ 与有状态 LSTM 的类别中位数在四个类别中的三个里相差不超过 0.003（表 8）。 在地下水补给的流域中，LSTM 的中位数高出 0.008，尽管改进在那里最大幅度地提升了 CaRT+ 的 NSE。 在 CAMELS-US 上，CaRT+ 的类别中位数在所有类别中都超过有状态 LSTM，从湿润流域的 0.008 到干旱流域的 0.032，而在雪主导流域和干旱流域则低于 EA-LSTM。 在地图（图 6 和图 7）上，CAMELS-GB 上几乎处处差异都很小。 在 CAMELS-US 上，差异呈聚集分布，LSTM 在半干旱的北部大平原和得克萨斯州领先，而 CaRT+ 在中西部上游和东部领先。 留出的流域将在 5.5 节中讨论。

paragraphs.en: The refinements of CaRT + form five groups by the process they act on:
paragraphs.zh: CaRT + 的改进按其作用的流程分为五组：

paragraphs.en: Runoff generation: surface layer, Pareto partition, infiltration excess, depression storage and near-stream zone.
paragraphs.zh: 产流机制：表层、帕累托分区、超渗产流、洼地蓄水与近河带。

paragraphs.en: Quick release: connected release with its exponent, viscosity and frost, connected bypass and groundwater-controlled connectivity.
paragraphs.zh: 快速释放：与其指数、黏度和霜冻相连的释放，相连的旁路以及由地下水控制的连通性。

paragraphs.en: Evaporation: vegetation demand and groundwater uptake.
paragraphs.zh: 蒸发：植被需水与地下水汲取。

paragraphs.en: Exchange with the exterior: exterior inflow and channel transmission loss.
paragraphs.zh: 与外部的交换：外部流入与通道传输损耗。

paragraphs.en: These groups also reflect dependencies among their constituent refinements. To test a group’s effect on the model performance, the model was retrained with one group removed and the others retained. The NSE of each catchment is averaged over the seeds before the paired differences are calculated (Table 10 and, by class, Figure 8 ). The classes are groundwater-fed (BFI ≥ 0.65 \geq 0.65 ), flashy (BFI < 0.5 <0.5 ) and snow-affected ( f snow ≥ 0.04 f_{\rm snow}\geq 0.04 ) catchments on CAMELS-GB, and snow-dominated ( f snow ≥ 0.3 f_{\rm snow}\geq 0.3 ), arid (PET/P > 1.1 >1.1 ) and humid (PET/P ≤ 0.7 \leq 0.7 , f snow < 0.3 f_{\rm snow}<0.3 ) basins on CAMELS-US.
paragraphs.zh: 这些组还反映了其组成细化项之间的依赖关系。 为了检验某一组对模型性能的影响，在移除该组并保留其他组的情况下对模型进行了重新训练。 在计算配对差值之前，每个流域的 NSE 先在各随机种子上取平均（表 10，以及按类别划分的图 8）。 在 CAMELS-GB 上，这些类别为地下水补给型（BFI ≥ 0.65）、暴流型（BFI < 0.5）和受融雪影响型（f_snow ≥ 0.04）流域；在 CAMELS-US 上，这些类别为雪主导型（f_snow ≥ 0.3）、干旱型（PET/P > 1.1）和湿润型（PET/P ≤ 0.7 且 f_snow < 0.3）流域。

sents.en: These groups also reflect dependencies among their constituent refinements.
sents.zh: 这些组还反映了其组成细化项之间的依赖关系。

sents.en: The classes are groundwater-fed (BFI ≥ 0.65 \geq 0.65 ), flashy (BFI < 0.5 <0.5 ) and snow-affected ( f snow ≥ 0.04 f_{\rm snow}\geq 0.04 ) catchments on CAMELS-GB, and snow-dominated ( f snow ≥ 0.3 f_{\rm snow}\geq 0.3 ), arid (PET/P > 1.1 >1.1 ) and humid (PET/P ≤ 0.7 \leq 0.7 , f snow < 0.3 f_{\rm snow}<0.3 ) basins on CAMELS-US.

Evaporation adds 0.0010 [0.0005, 0.0015], while exchange with the exterior and the melt energy term leave the median unchanged. paragraphs.en: Three of the five groups of refinements (runoff generation, quick release and evaporation) raise the median NSE on at least one of the continents. The exchange and snow groups leave the medians unchanged and act in particular catchments. The melt energy term adds 0.006 [0.000, 0.012] in the 175 arid basins of CAMELS-US. The five median contributions sum to 0.011 on CAMELS-GB and 0.021 on CAMELS-US, less than the gains over CaRT. Each contribution is measured with the other four groups present, so where two groups improve the same catchments, each is credited only with the part that the others do not replace.

paragraphs.en: Figures 9 and 10 show one water year in six gauged catchments per continent for seed 0 of each model, the seed that was also used to select the catchments. Four are the catchments at the median NSE of CaRT + in each of four classes (those of Figure 8 and an intermediate class). The other two are the catchments with the largest advantage of CaRT + over the stateful LSTM and of the stateful LSTM over CaRT + . In the class-median catchments the models follow the observed flow closely and differ mainly in the peaks, and only in the arid Bear Creek does no model exceed 0.5. On CAMELS-GB the largest advantage of CaRT + is at Hebden Beck, where the LSTM produces spurious winter peaks (NSE − 6.8 -6.8 ). The largest advantage of the LSTM is at the Wye at Hedsor, a chalk stream where both conceptual models overestimate the late-winter rise. Its flow may be controlled by an aquifer head that is not among the inputs. On CAMELS-US the two extreme basins differ in kind. At Flat Creek all three LSTM seeds fail over the held-out period (NSE 0.07, 0.05 and 0.30), while the three CaRT + seeds agree (0.66–0.70). At the Big Sioux River the result depends on the seed. The displayed CaRT + seed and one other overestimate the autumn and spring events and miss the June peaks, a pattern also seen in one LSTM seed.
paragraphs.zh: 图9和图10展示了每个大洲六个有实测数据的流域在某一个水文年的情况，对应各模型的种子0，即用于筛选流域的那个种子。 其中有四个流域是CaRT + 在四个类别（即图8中的类别和一个中间类别）中各自NSE位于中位数的流域。 另外两个流域分别是CaRT + 相对于有状态LSTM优势最大的流域，以及有状态LSTM相对于CaRT + 优势最大的流域。 在类别中位数流域中，各模型紧贴实测流量，差异主要出现在洪峰处，且只有在干旱的Bear Creek流域，没有任何模型超过0.5。 在CAMELS-GB上，CaRT + 优势最大的是Hebden Beck流域，LSTM在该处产生了虚假的冬季洪峰（NSE −6.8）。 LSTM优势最大的是Hedsor处的Wye流域，这是一条白垩溪流，两个概念性模型都高估了冬末的上涨。 其流量可能受某个不在输入之列的含水层水头控制。 在CAMELS-US上，两个极端流域的情况在性质上不同。 在Flat Creek流域，三个LSTM种子在留存期上全部失败（NSE分别为0.07、0.05和0.30），而三个CaRT + 种子的结果一致（0.66–0.70）。 在Big Sioux River流域，结果取决于种子。 所展示的CaRT + 种子与另一个种子高估了秋季和春季的事件，并漏掉了6月的洪峰，这一模式也出现在一个LSTM种子中。

paragraphs.en: The catchments held out from training test the map from attributes to parameters. On the 64 held-out catchments of CAMELS-GB with test data, the median NSE is 0.755 for the single CaRT + , against 0.723 and 0.714 for the stateful LSTM and the EA-LSTM. However, the paired differences, − 0.002 -0.002 [ − 0.010 -0.010 , + 0.010 +0.010 ] and + 0.004 +0.004 [ − 0.011 -0.011 , + 0.020 +0.020 ], include zero, as do those of the ensembles (Table 7 ). On CAMELS-US the paired difference with the stateful LSTM also includes zero (0.674 against 0.719; − 0.003 -0.003 [ − 0.034 -0.034 , + 0.020 +0.020 ]), and CaRT + is behind the EA-LSTM (0.722; − 0.031 -0.031 [ − 0.055 -0.055 , − 0.010 -0.010 ]). Both LSTM ensembles are ahead of the CaRT + ensemble (0.754 and 0.749 against 0.689). Figure 11 compares the 68 held-out basins of CAMELS-US one by one and Table 11 summarises them by class. The deficit is largest in the 22 arid basins (PET/P > 1.1 >1.1 ), where CaRT + is behind the EA-LSTM by 0.112 [0.053, 0.326] and consistent with no difference from the stateful LSTM ( − 0.145 -0.145 [ − 0.319 -0.319 , + 0.043 +0.043 ]). In the other 46 basins it is within 0.002 of the stateful LSTM ( + 0.002 +0.002 [ − 0.007 -0.007 , + 0.025 +0.025 ]) and 0.013 [0.006, 0.031] behind the EA-LSTM. In the arid basins the three seeds of each model spread widely, often over more than 0.5 in NSE, because flow is zero on most days and a few peaks dominate the score.

paragraphs.en: Five held-out basins have an NSE below − 1 -1 for at least one model. They are Blackwater Creek, FL ( − 35 -35 for CaRT + , − 17 -17 and − 14 -14 for the two LSTMs), Castle Creek, SD ( − 16 -16 , − 1.7 -1.7 , − 9.0 -9.0 ), Vernon Creek, UT ( − 14 -14 , − 22 -22 , − 3.3 -3.3 ), Beaver Creek, OR ( − 1.8 -1.8 , − 1.2 -1.2 , − 0.1 -0.1 ) and Firesteel Creek, SD ( − 1.7 -1.7 , + 0.3 +0.3 , + 0.4 +0.4 ). The nine held-out basins in which CaRT + has a negative NSE share a low runoff ratio in the training period (median 0.10, against 0.37 for the other held-out basins). Their runoff ratio is also lower than that of the gauged basins nearest to them in attribute space (median 0.18), and they lie farther from any gauged basin in attribute space (2.0 against 1.3 standard deviations). The attributes supplied to the network do not reveal that most of their rain leaves without reaching the gauge, and a model that conserves water must then send the surplus to the outlet. Decomposing NSE into correlation, amplitude ratio and bias shows two forms of the resulting failure. In basins with near-zero flow on most days, simulated peaks are several times too large (amplitude ratios of 6.2 at Blackwater Creek and 4.3 at Vernon Creek, against 4.4 and 4.9 for the LSTM, which fails there too). In the karst basin of Castle Creek, in the Black Hills, the simulated volume is 2.7 times the observed one (1.5 times for the LSTM), because the loss to the aquifer is not predicted. This tendency is also visible among the gauged basins. In the 68 gauged basins with a runoff ratio below 0.12 in the training period, the runoff ratio of their nearest neighbours in attribute space is 0.09 against 0.06 observed, and CaRT + overestimates their volume by 13 % against 3 % elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 五个留出流域至少有一个模型的 NSE 低于 −1。 它们是：佛罗里达州 Blackwater Creek（CaRT+ 为 −35，两个 LSTM 分别为 −17 和 −14）、南达科他州 Castle Creek（−16、−1.7、−9.0）、犹他州 Vernon Creek（−14、−22、−3.3）、俄勒冈州 Beaver Creek（−1.8、−1.2、−0.1）以及南达科他州 Firesteel Creek（−1.7、+0.3、+0.4）。 在 CaRT+ 的 NSE 为负的九个留出流域中，它们在训练期的径流系数都很低（中位数为 0.10，而其他留出流域为 0.37）。 它们的径流系数也低于属性空间中距离它们最近的已测流域（中位数为 0.18），并且它们在属性空间中距离任何已测流域都更远（2.0 个标准差，而其他为 1.3 个标准差）。 提供给网络的属性并未揭示其大部分降雨未经到达测站便流失了，于是节水模型必须把多余的水送往出口断面。 将 NSE 分解为相关系数、振幅比和偏差，可以看到由此导致的两种失效形式。 在大多数日子流量接近于零的流域中，模拟的峰值偏大数倍（Blackwater Creek 的振幅比为 6.2，Vernon Creek 为 4.3，而 LSTM 分别为 4.4 和 4.9，它在这两处也失效了）。 在布莱克丘的 Castle Creek 岩溶流域，模拟水量是观测水量的 2.7 倍（LSTM 为 1.5 倍），因为对含水层的渗漏损失未能被预测出来。 这种倾向在已测流域中也同样可见。 在训练期径流系数低于 0.12 的 68 个已测流域中，它们在属性空间中最近邻流域的径流系数为 0.09，而观测值为 0.06；CaRT+ 对其水量的高估达 13%，而在其他流域仅为 3%。

sents.en: Five held-out basins have an NSE below − 1 -1 for at least one model.
sents.zh: 五个留出流域至少有一个模型的 NSE 低于 −1。

sents.en: They are Blackwater Creek, FL ( − 35 -35 for CaRT + , − 17 -17 and − 14 -14 for the two LSTMs), Castle Creek, SD ( − 16 -16 , − 1.7 -1.7 , − 9.0 -9.0 ), Vernon Creek, UT ( − 14 -14 , − 22 -22 , − 3.3 -3.3 ), Beaver Creek, OR ( − 1.8 -1.8 , − 1.2 -1.2 , − 0.1 -0.1 ) and Firesteel Creek, SD ( − 1.7 -1.7 , + 0.3 +0.3 , + 0.4 +0.4 ).
sents.zh: 它们是：佛罗里达州 Blackwater Creek（CaRT+ 为 −35，两个 LSTM 分别为 −17 和 −14）、南达科他州 Castle Creek（−16、−1.7、−9.0）、犹他州 Vernon Creek（−14、−22、−3.3）、俄勒冈州 Beaver Creek（−1.8、−1.2、−0.1）以及南达科他州 Firesteel Creek（−1.7、+0.3、+0.4）。

sents.en: The nine held-out basins in which CaRT + has a negative NSE share a low runoff ratio in the training period (median 0.10, against 0.37 for the other held-out basins).
sents.zh: 在 CaRT+ 的 NSE 为负的九个留出流域中，它们在训练期的径流系数都很低（中位数为 0.10，而其他留出流域为 0.37）。

sents.en: Their runoff ratio is also lower than that of the gauged basins nearest to them in attribute space (median 0.18), and they lie farther from any gauged basin in attribute space (2.0 against 1.3 standard deviations).
sents.zh: 它们的径流系数也低于属性空间中距离它们最近的已测流域（中位数为 0.18），并且它们在属性空间中距离任何已测流域都更远（2.0 个标准差，而其他为 1.3 个标准差）。

sents.en: The attributes supplied to the network do not reveal that most of their rain leaves without reaching the gauge, and a model that conserves water must then send the surplus to the outlet.
sents.zh: 提供给网络的属性并未揭示其大部分降雨未经到达测站便流失了，于是节水模型必须把多余的水送往出口断面。

sents.en: Decomposing NSE into correlation, amplitude ratio and bias shows two forms of the resulting failure.
sents.zh: 将 NSE 分解为相关系数、振幅比和偏差，可以看到由此导致的两种失效形式。

sents.en: In basins with near-zero flow on most days, simulated peaks are several times too large (amplitude ratios of 6.2 at Blackwater Creek and 4.3 at Vernon Creek, against 4.4 and 4.9 for the LSTM, which fails there too).
sents.zh: 在大多数日子流量接近于零的流域中，模拟的峰值偏大数倍（Blackwater Creek 的振幅比为 6.2，Vernon Creek 为 4.3，而 LSTM 分别为 4.4 和 4.9，它在这两处也失效了）。

sents.en: In the karst basin of Castle Creek, in the Black Hills, the simulated volume is 2.7 times the observed one (1.5 times for the LSTM), because the loss to the aquifer is not predicted.
sents.zh: 在布莱克丘的 Castle Creek 岩溶流域，模拟水量是观测水量的 2.7 倍（LSTM 为 1.5 倍），因为对含水层的渗漏损失未能被预测出来。

sents.en: This tendency is also visible among the gauged basins.
sents.zh: 这种倾向在已测流域中也同样可见。

sents.en: In the 68 gauged basins with a runoff ratio below 0.12 in the training period, the runoff ratio of their nearest neighbours in attribute space is 0.09 against 0.06 observed, and CaRT + overestimates their volume by 13 % against 3 % elsewhere.
sents.zh: 在训练期径流系数低于 0.12 的 68 个已测流域中，它们在属性空间中最近邻流域的径流系数为 0.09，而观测值为 0.06；CaRT+ 对其水量的高估达 13%，而在其他流域仅为 3%。

paragraphs.en: There is a second cause in all held-out basins. For each basin the attribute network returns one set of parameters, and the model simulates the single hydrograph of that set. Both models are trained on the squared error, whose minimum for given attributes and forcing lies at the conditional mean of the flow, and the mean of several hydrographs is smoother than any of them. The LSTM outputs the flow itself and can return this mean for basins that cannot be distinguished by their attributes. However, CaRT + returns a hydrograph of its own family, and since its response is nonlinear the mean of several of its hydrographs lies outside that family. The average is reached only by averaging the flows of several parameter sets. We therefore perturb the standardised attributes of each basin with Gaussian noise of standard deviation σ \sigma , run CaRT + once for each of 32 draws with the trained network of each seed, and average the flows (Table 12 ). Every member conserves water, and the average is the outflow of 32 equal units in parallel, which is the aggregate of Section 2.3 with the uncertainty of the map as its heterogeneity. Training perturbs the attributes in the same way with σ = 0.1 \sigma=0.1 . If the deficit comes from this single parameter set, four things follow. The held-out score rises with σ \sigma well beyond 0.1, and the gain is largest where the deficit is. At larger σ \sigma the gauged score falls, because there the flow has pinned the parameters. The failing basins, whose failure comes from a missing loss, stay where they are. On CAMELS-US all four hold, the third from σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 and the fourth in most failing basins. The held-out median rises from 0.674 to 0.696 at σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 and 0.704 at σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 and falls at larger σ \sigma . At σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 , 79 % of the basins improve (paired + 0.019 +0.019 [ + 0.012 +0.012 , + 0.027 +0.027 ]), and the paired gain in the median arid basin is 0.08 at σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 and 0.15 at σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 , against 0.01 in the other 46. It comes through the correlation and the bias, which move from 0.76 to 0.79 and from 0.21 to 0.18 standard deviations in the median arid basin at σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 , while the amplitude ratio stays near 0.9. The average removes peaks that the members place on different days.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有留出的流域中都存在第二个原因。 对每个流域，属性网络返回一组参数，模型模拟该组参数的单条流量过程线。 两个模型都以平方误差训练，其对于给定属性和强迫输入的最小值位于流量的条件均值处，而多条流量过程线的均值比其中任何一条都更平滑。 LSTM 输出流量本身，因此对于那些无法通过属性区分的流域，它可以返回这个均值。 然而，CaRT + 返回的是其自身函数族中的一条流量过程线，由于其响应是非线性的，多条这样的流量过程线的均值会落在该函数族之外。 只有对多组参数的流量取平均，才能达到这个均值。 因此，我们用标准差为 σ \sigma 的高斯噪声扰动每个流域的标准化属性，对每个种子用训练好的网络对 32 次抽样各运行一次 CaRT +，并对流量取平均（表 12）。 每个成员都保持水量守恒，平均值相当于 32 个并联的等值单元的出流，即第 2.3 节的聚合形式，其中以映射的不确定性作为其异质性。 训练时以相同方式扰动属性，σ = 0.1 \sigma=0.1 。 如果亏损来自这单组参数，则会有四件事成立。 留出集分数随 σ \sigma 上升，远超过 0.1，且增益在亏损最大的地方最大。 在更大的 σ \sigma 下，有观测的分数下降，因为在那里流量已经钉住了参数。 失败的流域，其失败源于损失项的缺失，位置保持不变。 在 CAMELS-US 上，这四点全部成立，第三点从 σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 起，第四点在大多数失败流域中成立。 留出集中位数在 σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 时从 0.674 升至 0.696，在 σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 时升至 0.704，在更大的 σ \sigma 下则下降。 在 σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 时，79 % 的流域得到改善（成对 + 0.019 +0.019 [ + 0.012 +0.012 , + 0.027 +0.027 ]），中位干旱流域的成对增益在 σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 时为 0.08，在 σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 时为 0.15，而其余 46 个流域仅为 0.01。 改善来自相关性和偏差：在 σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 时，中位干旱流域中相关性从 0.76 升至 0.79，偏差从 0.21 个标准差降至 0.18 个标准差，而振幅比保持在 0.9 附近。 平均化消除了各成员放置在不同日期的峰值。

sents.zh: 在所有留出的流域中都存在第二个原因。

sents.zh: 留出集中位数在 σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 时从 0.674 升至 0.696，在 σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 时升至 0.704，在更大的 σ \sigma 下则下降。

It comes through the correlation and the bias, which move from 0.76 to 0.79 and from 0.21 to 0.18 standard deviations in the median arid basin at σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 , while the amplitude ratio stays near 0.9.
sents.zh: 改善来自相关性和偏差：在 σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 时，中位干旱流域中相关性从 0.76 升至 0.79，偏差从 0.21 个标准差降至 0.18 个标准差，而振幅比保持在 0.9 附近。

sents.zh: 平均化消除了各成员放置在不同日期的峰值。

paragraphs.en: At σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 the paired differences with both LSTMs include zero ( + 0.012 +0.012 [ − 0.021 -0.021 , + 0.030 +0.030 ] and − 0.007 -0.007 [ − 0.020 -0.020 , + 0.002 +0.002 ]). On the gauged basins the same average stays above the baseline up to σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 , where it gains 0.006, but loses 0.017 at σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 and 0.046 at σ = 0.7 \sigma=0.7 . Six of the nine failing basins stay below zero at every σ \sigma . On CAMELS-GB, where the single CaRT + already matches the LSTMs, the held-out median stays within 0.01 of 0.755 up to σ = 0.7 \sigma=0.7 . In the 22 held-out groundwater-fed catchments, in which all three models score 0.43, the median rises to 0.59 at σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 , while in the other 42 it falls by 0.02. The gauged median falls from 0.863 to 0.830 at σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 . The deficit on held-out basins is therefore a property of the map from attributes to parameters, which is too certain where the attributes constrain the response weakly. For prediction, σ \sigma would be set on pseudo-ungauged basins within the training set.
paragraphs.zh: 在 σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 时，与两个 LSTM 的成对差值均包含零（ + 0.012 +0.012 [ − 0.021 -0.021 , + 0.030 +0.030 ] 和 − 0.007 -0.007 [ − 0.020 -0.020 , + 0.002 +0.002 ]）。 在有率定数据的流域上，该平均值在 σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 之前一直高于基线，此时领先 0.006，但在 σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 时落后 0.017，在 σ = 0.7 \sigma=0.7 时落后 0.046。 九个未达标流域中有六个在所有 σ \sigma 下都低于零。 在 CAMELS-GB 上，单个 CaRT + 已经能与 LSTM 相当，其留出中位数在 σ = 0.7 \sigma=0.7 之前保持在 0.755 的 0.01 范围内。 在 22 个留出的地下水补给流域中，三个模型的得分均为 0.43，其中位数在 σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 时升至 0.59，而在其余 42 个流域中则下降 0.02。 有率定数据的中位数在 σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 时从 0.863 降至 0.830。 因此，留出流域上的欠缺是属性到参数映射的一种特性，该映射在属性对响应约束较弱的地方过于确信。 对于预测，σ \sigma 应在训练集内的伪无率定流域上设定。

paragraphs.en: CAMELS-AUS tests whether the structure holds beyond the two continents on which it was built. No refinement was derived or selected on Australian data, and the catchments were added after the structure was fixed. They are drier than those of the other two datasets, with PET/P above 2 in 92 of the 505 gauged catchments. In 332 of the 505 gauged catchments the flow falls below 0.01 mm d -1 on at least 5 % of the test days, and for most of them the driest test years are 2018 and 2019. All models are trained with the configuration of CAMELS-US. In the driest catchments the infiltration capacity of CaRT + underflowed in single precision and made the gradients undefined, so the infiltration capacity is bounded below by 10 − 4 10^{-4} mm d -1 .
paragraphs.zh: CAMELS-AUS 检验该结构能否在构建它所用的两个大洲之外依然成立。 没有基于澳大利亚数据推导或选择任何细化，且这些流域是在结构确定之后才加入的。 它们比其他两个数据集的流域更干旱，505 个有观测的流域中有 92 个的 PET/P 高于 2。 在 505 个有观测的流域中，有 332 个在至少 5% 的测试日里径流低于 0.01 mm d -1，且其中大多数流域最干旱的测试年份是 2018 年和 2019 年。 所有模型均采用 CAMELS-US 的配置进行训练。 在最干旱的流域中，CaRT + 的入渗能力在单精度下发生下溢并导致梯度未定义，因此入渗能力的下界被限定为 10 − 4 10^{-4} mm d -1。

sents.en: All models are trained with the configuration of CAMELS-US.
sents.zh: 所有模型均采用 CAMELS-US 的配置进行训练。

sents.en: In the driest catchments the infiltration capacity of CaRT + underflowed in single precision and made the gradients undefined, so the infiltration capacity is bounded below by 10 − 4 10^{-4} mm d -1 .
sents.zh: 在最干旱的流域中，CaRT + 的入渗能力在单精度下发生下溢并导致梯度未定义，因此入渗能力的下界被限定为 10 − 4 10^{-4} mm d -1。

paragraphs.en: On the gauged catchments the structure keeps its accuracy (Table 13 and Figure 12 ), and as a single model CaRT + has the highest median NSE there, ahead of the stateful LSTM by 0.009 [0.003, 0.015] in the paired median (Table 13 b). In the paired median the refinements derived for Britain and the United States raise NSE over CaRT by 0.020, against 0.015 and 0.031 on those continents (Table 7 ). They raise NSE of log flow by 0.14 against 0.023 and 0.084, so their largest effect here is at low flow.

paragraphs.en: The models differ most in dry years. In the test years in which a catchment received less than its lower quartile of annual precipitation (mostly 2018 and 2019), the other conceptual models deliver one and a half to two and a half times the observed flow in the median catchment. CaRT + delivers 17 % too much (59 % for CaRT), and its dry-year NSE is higher than that of CaRT by 0.125 [0.094, 0.160]. Only the stateful LSTM stays closer to the observed volume, and it leads CaRT + in these years by 0.036 [0.019, 0.051] in NSE. The same holds for the cessation of flow. In the 332 gauged catchments with no flow on at least 5 % of the test days, the other conceptual models underestimate the share of days without flow by 24 to 43 percentage points, CaRT + by 5 and the stateful LSTM by 4. In the 92 arid catchments (PET/P > 2 >2 ) CaRT + has the highest KGE of all models over the whole test period, + 0.044 +0.044 [ + 0.003 +0.003 , + 0.078 +0.078 ] against the stateful LSTM.
paragraphs.zh: 各模型在干旱年份的差异最大。 在流域年降水量低于其下四分位数的检验年份（大多为 2018 年和 2019 年），其他概念性模型在中位数流域模拟的流量是观测流量的 1.5 至 2.5 倍。 CaRT + 多出 17%（CaRT 为 59%），且其干旱年份的 NSE 比 CaRT 高 0.125 [0.094, 0.160]。 只有带状态的 LSTM 更接近观测水量，且在这些年份其 NSE 比 CaRT + 高 0.036 [0.019, 0.051]。 断流情形也是如此。 在 332 个至少有 5% 检验日无径流的已测流域中，其他概念性模型将无径流天数的比例低估了 24 至 43 个百分点，CaRT + 低估了 5 个百分点，带状态的 LSTM 低估了 4 个百分点。 在 92 个干旱流域（PET/P > 2）中，CaRT + 在整个检验期内拥有所有模型中最高的 KGE，比带状态的 LSTM 高 +0.044 [+0.003, +0.078]。

paragraphs.en: To the accuracy of a single trained neural network, they can. As a single model CaRT + matches a stateful LSTM and an EA-LSTM trained on the same inputs on CAMELS-GB and CAMELS-US (paired differences in median NSE between − 0.004 -0.004 and + 0.008 +0.008 ). On the gauged Australian catchments, whose data played no part in deriving the structure, it is ahead of both by 0.009 and 0.014. This suggests that the structure of CaRT + can extract enough information from the inputs to reach the accuracy of a single LSTM. All the assumptions on which the model is based were proposed in earlier work, including the probability-distributed store [ Moore, 1985 ] , infiltration excess [ Horton, 1933 ] , the variable source area [ Dunne and Black, 1970 ] , interception [ Rutter et al., 1971 ] , depression storage [ Shook and Pomeroy, 2011 ] , the exchange of the GR models [ Perrin et al., 2003 ] and the memory left by unresolved heterogeneity [ Mori, 1965 , Harman et al., 2009 ] . Known processes, assembled under the laws, therefore suffice to reach that accuracy. What is needed is the aggregation of the fine-scale assumptions into catchment-scale flux relations. The remaining gaps are in the three-seed ensembles, in the low flows and in held-out catchments, largest in the arid ones, where the map from attributes to parameters limits the prediction (Section 5.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在单个经训练的神经网络的精度上，它们可以做到。 作为单一模型，CaRT+ 在 CAMELS-GB 和 CAMELS-US 上与使用相同输入训练的有状态 LSTM 和 EA-LSTM 相当（NSE 中位数的成对差异介于 −0.004 与 +0.008 之间）。 在经观测的澳大利亚流域上（其数据未参与结构推导），它比两者分别领先 0.009 和 0.014。 这表明 CaRT+ 的结构能够从输入中提取足够的信息，以达到单个 LSTM 的精度。 该模型所依据的所有假设均已在早期工作中提出，包括概率分布式蓄水体 [Moore, 1985]、超渗产流 [Horton, 1933]、变动源区 [Dunne and Black, 1970]、截留 [Rutter et al., 1971]、洼地蓄水 [Shook and Pomeroy, 2011]、GR 模型的交换项 [Perrin et al., 2003]，以及未解析异质性留下的记忆 [Mori, 1965, Harman et al., 2009]。 因此，在定律之下组装起来的已知过程，足以达到那样的精度。 所需要的，是将细尺度假设聚合为流域尺度的通量关系。 剩余的差距存在于三种子的集成中、低流量中以及留出的流域中，其中在干旱流域差距最大，因为在这些流域，从属性到参数的映射限制了预测（第 5.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: The results support the existence of laws of form, since one structure built under the three laws performs well for 1342 catchments on two continents. The same structure carries over to 561 Australian catchments that played no part in its derivation and lie in a climate drier than either. It keeps the flow of their dry years closer to the observations than the other conceptual models. A structure built under the laws thus describes daily catchment dynamics as a dissipative network of stores whose fluxes follow from aggregated local laws and carry a memory of the unresolved composition. The best-known candidate for a catchment-scale law, the relation between the long-term evaporative ratio and the aridity index [ Budyko, 1974 , Fu, 1981 , Zhang et al., 2001 ] , is a law of response, a regularity in what catchments do on average. The laws here constrain the dynamical system that produces the response, and the two kinds are complementary.
paragraphs.zh: 结果支持了形态律的存在，因为由这三条定律构建的一个结构在两大洲的1342个流域上表现良好。 同一结构可延展至561个澳大利亚流域，这些流域在其推导过程中未参与，且气候比上述两者都更干旱。 在枯水年份，它使其径流过程比其他概念性模型更贴近观测结果。 因此，依据这些定律构建的结构将流域的动态过程描述为一个耗散的蓄水单元网络，其通量由聚合的局部定律导出，并携带对未解析组成的记忆。 流域尺度定律最著名的候选者——长期蒸发比与干旱指数之间的关系[Budyko, 1974, Fu, 1981, Zhang et al., 2001]——是一条响应定律，即流域平均行为的一种规律性。 本文的定律约束的是产生该响应的动力学系统，二者是互补的。

What differs between catchments is the parameters, which one network maps from the catchment attributes, and this is where the uniqueness of place resides [ Beven, 2000 ] .

paragraphs.en: To the question of Dooge [1986] , whether there are laws at the catchment scale, our answer from this sample is that there are laws constraining what a catchment model can be and defining its admissible topologies. The laws leave open the regularities in the map from catchment attributes to parameters, which data-driven methods working under the laws are well placed to find.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 Dooge [1986] 提出的问题——是否存在流域尺度上的定律，我们从这一样本得出的回答是：确实存在一些定律，它们约束流域模型可能是什么样，并界定其可容许的拓扑结构。 这些定律并未涵盖从流域属性到参数的映射中的规律性，而在这些定律框架下工作的数据驱动方法恰好适合去发现这些规律。

paragraphs.en: Several lines of work that have run separately can be read through the three laws, of which the conceptual models in use are the most relevant. The probability-distributed store [ Moore, 1985 ] and the partition of GR4J [ Perrin et al., 2003 ] are both aggregates of a local threshold law over a distribution of thresholds (Section 2.2 ), and the two models differ only in the distribution they assume. The release exponent of the quick store follows in the same way. Depth thresholds that follow a power law turn the local law of GR4J into a release proportional to R 5 + k R^{5+k} , so the exponent is a property of the threshold distribution. Law 2 also constrains the structure of these models, for instance in the exchange term of GR4J, which has a branch in which the store gains water as it fills. Under Law 2 that branch is inadmissible, and under the monotonicity of Section 2.1 the admissible exchange is a loss together with an inflow driven by an exterior head (Section 4.2 ). The storage–discharge relation of Kirchner [2009] , in which a catchment behaves as a first-order dynamical system, has its place under the same law. The relation holds when the downstream head is fixed and both the head and the conductance depend on one store alone. Appendix A.2 adds the cases in which the eliminated composition leaves no memory, so that one state suffices.
paragraphs.zh: 多条各自独立发展的研究脉络可以通过这三条定律来解读，其中正在使用的概念模型最为相关。 概率分布式水库 [Moore, 1985] 与 GR4J 的分区 [Perrin et al., 2003] 都是局部阈值定律在阈值分布上的聚合（第 2.2 节），两个模型的区别仅在于它们假设的分布不同。 快速水库的出流指数也以同样的方式得到。 服从幂律的深度阈值使 GR4J 的局部定律变成正比于 R 5 + k R^{5+k} 的出流，因此该指数是阈值分布的性质。 定律 2 还约束了这些模型的结构，例如 GR4J 的交换项，其中有一个分支是水库在充满过程中获得水量。 在定律 2 下该分支是不可接受的，而在第 2.1 节的单调性下，可接受的交换是一项损失加上由外部水头驱动的入流（第 4.2 节）。 Kirchner [2009] 的蓄量–出流关系，即流域表现为一阶动力系统，也归属于同一定律之下。 该关系在下游水头固定、且水头与导水率都仅依赖于单一水库时成立。 附录 A.2 补充了消去组合后不留下记忆的情形，此时一个状态即可 suffice（即一个状态就足够）。

sents.en: Several lines of work that have run separately can be read through the three laws, of which the conceptual models in use are the most relevant.
sents.zh: 多条各自独立发展的研究脉络可以通过这三条定律来解读，其中正在使用的概念模型最为相关。

sents.en: The probability-distributed store [ Moore, 1985 ] and the partition of GR4J [ Perrin et al., 2003 ] are both aggregates of a local threshold law over a distribution of thresholds (Section 2.2 ), and the two models differ only in the distribution they assume.
sents.zh: 概率分布式水库 [Moore, 1985] 与 GR4J 的分区 [Perrin et al., 2003] 都是局部阈值定律在阈值分布上的聚合（第 2.2 节），两个模型的区别仅在于它们假设的分布不同。

sents.en: The release exponent of the quick store follows in the same way.
sents.zh: 快速水库的出流指数也以同样的方式得到。

sents.en: Depth thresholds that follow a power law turn the local law of GR4J into a release proportional to R 5 + k R^{5+k} , so the exponent is a property of the threshold distribution.
sents.zh: 服从幂律的深度阈值使 GR4J 的局部定律变成正比于 R 5 + k R^{5+k} 的出流，因此该指数是阈值分布的性质。

sents.en: Law 2 also constrains the structure of these models, for instance in the exchange term of GR4J, which has a branch in which the store gains water as it fills.

paragraphs.en: Where the units lie in series, the memory of the composition takes the form that the theory of travel times describes. For linear units it is the convolution of the input with the travel-time distribution of the network, so the travel-time distribution and the lag of the hydrograph come from one derivation. The same memory can be kept as a chain of stores [ Nash, 1957 ] , exactly where the kernel is that of a chain, while GR4J uses travel-time kernels of finite length with one parameter. Units that fill and spill carry a memory of another kind, the one behind hillslope connectivity and the hysteresis seen between events. Their deficits follow the turning points of the accumulated forcing, and their superposition is a Prandtl–Ishlinskii operator [ O’Kane and Flynn, 2007 , Brokate and Sprekels, 1996 ] . This memory has no time scale, and an event that fills or empties every unit erases it.
paragraphs.zh: 当各单元串联时，组合体的记忆呈现出旅行时理论所描述的形式。 对于线性单元，它是输入与网络旅行时分布的卷积，因此旅行时分布与水文过程的滞后来自同一次推导。 同样的记忆也可以保存为一串蓄水库 [ Nash, 1957 ]，其核恰好是链式核，而 GR4J 则使用具有单参数的有限长度旅行时核。 充满后溢出的单元带有另一种记忆，即坡面连通性以及事件之间滞回现象背后的那种记忆。 它们的亏缺沿累积强迫的转折点变化，其叠加是一个 Prandtl–Ishlinskii 算子 [ O’Kane and Flynn, 2007 , Brokate and Sprekels, 1996 ] 。 这种记忆没有时间尺度，一次使每个单元充满或清空的事件就能将其抹去。

paragraphs.en: These memories are what the closure relations of the representative elementary watershed were missing. Its balance equations [ Reggiani et al., 1998 , Reggiani et al., 1999 ] left the closure relations open, and the search for them stopped at the finding that they are nonlinear, hysteretic and scale dependent [ Beven, 2006 ] . Law 3 starts from the result of Appendix A that the exact elimination of the unresolved composition leaves the lumped stores with a memory of the forcing. The closure then becomes a construction that gives, for a stated fine-scale assumption, the states that carry the memory and the way they enter the fluxes. Table 2 lists the outcome for the local structures considered here.
paragraphs.zh: 这些记忆正是代表性基本流域的闭合关系所缺失的内容。 其平衡方程 [ Reggiani et al., 1998 , Reggiani et al., 1999 ] 将闭合关系留作未定，而对闭合关系的探索止于发现它们是非线性、具有滞后性且依赖于尺度 [ Beven, 2006 ] 。 定律 3 从附录 A 的结果出发，即对未解析成分的精确消去会使集总水库保留对强迫的记忆。 这样，闭合关系便成为一种构造：对于给定的细尺度假设，它给出承载记忆的状态以及这些状态进入通量的方式。 表 2 列出了本文所考虑的局部结构的结果。

paragraphs.en: Modular frameworks combine interchangeable stores and fluxes [ Clark et al., 2008 , Fenicia et al., 2011 , Knoben et al., 2019 ] without a rule for which combinations are admissible. Corollary 1 supplies that rule as four operations, with each refinement nesting the model it refines where a natural limit exists. The three laws thus give a concise and unified account of these theories, each of which was developed on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 模块化框架将可互换的存储和通量组合起来 [ Clark et al., 2008 , Fenicia et al., 2011 , Knoben et al., 2019 ]，但没有规则规定哪些组合是可采纳的。 推论 1 以四种运算的形式给出了这一规则，其中每次细化都将被细化的模型嵌套在内，并存在一个自然的极限。 因此，这三条定律为这些各自独立发展的理论提供了一个简洁而统一的解释。

paragraphs.en: With the laws, processes that earlier models treated empirically or did not consider can also be built into a model, as we show for two terms of CaRT + . In earlier models the connected fraction of a catchment is a function of the root-zone storage, and it splits the rain into runoff and infiltration [ Moore, 1985 , Gao et al., 2019 ] . Our diagnosis showed that the error in the quick flow depended on how wet the catchment had been in the preceding days, information that the stores of CaRT do not carry. By Law 3 , an unresolved wetness of this kind enters the model as a conditional variable with a balance of its own, which we obtained by eliminating the wetness of the individual hillslope units (Appendix C ). In CaRT + the connected fraction depends on this wetness and multiplies the release of the quick store. The vegetation demand is the second example, for which indices of foliar phenology already use a running mean of a temperature response [ Jolly et al., 2005 ] . In the rain-fed basins of CAMELS-US the spring flow had a phase error that followed the greening of the vegetation. In CaRT + the form of this lag follows from an assumption about vegetation patches. If the patches become active and dormant at a common rate, each when the temperature crosses its own threshold, the area-averaged activity is exactly an exponential moving average of a logistic function of temperature. The threshold, its width and the time constant are then constants shared by all catchments of a dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 有了这些定律，早期模型以经验方式处理或未予考虑的过程也能被纳入模型，正如我们对 CaRT + 的两个项所展示的那样。 在早期模型中，流域的连通比例是根区蓄水量的函数，它将降雨划分为径流和入渗 [ Moore, 1985, Gao et al., 2019 ] 。 我们的诊断表明，快速径流的误差取决于流域前几天的湿润程度，而这一信息是 CaRT 的蓄水体所不携带的。 依据定律 3，这类未解析的湿润度作为一个具有自身水量平衡的条件变量进入模型，我们通过消去各坡面单元的湿润度得到该变量（附录 C ）。 在 CaRT + 中，连通比例取决于这一湿润度，并与快速蓄水体的释放量相乘。 植被需水是第二个例子，针对它的叶片物候指数已采用温度响应的滑动平均值 [ Jolly et al., 2005 ] 。 在 CAMELS-US 的雨养流域中，春季径流存在一个随植被变绿而变化的相位误差。 在 CaRT + 中，这一滞后的形式源自对植被斑块的假设。 若各斑块在温度各自越过自身阈值时以相同的速率在活跃与休眠之间转换，则面积平均活跃度恰好是温度的逻辑斯蒂函数的指数移动平均。 该阈值、其宽度以及时间常数则是数据集中所有流域共有的常数。

paragraphs.en: The results show that a closure of the stated form suffices for daily streamflow. However, the physical reality of the individual processes needs further evidence. Additional observations, such as soil moisture, groundwater levels and evaporation, are needed to constrain the internal states and fluxes. The learned parameters must also be checked against independent estimates of the properties they stand for, such as the soil water capacity, the depression storage and the conductivity of the quick-flow pathways. The static attributes alone do not distinguish catchments with different types of response, and the resulting prediction errors in ungauged catchments can be reduced by perturbing the attributes and averaging the simulated flows. The closed law is an average over the states that the forcing of the training period visits, so it depends on that climate. Under a lasting change of climate or land use the distribution of the composition moves and the closure with it. This is one possible source of the changed response of catchments after long droughts. The Australian catchments, drier than any used in development, test how far the learned closure carries to another climate. CaRT and CaRT + are daily lumped models. But the laws are not tied to the daily step, since Laws 1 and 3 do not depend on the time step and Law 2 holds at shorter steps as long as inertia remains negligible. Where inertia matters, as may happen for channel flow at hourly steps, a flux needs a momentum state, and the dissipation law becomes an energy balance that includes the kinetic energy.
paragraphs.zh: 结果表明，所述形式的闭合关系足以用于日径流。 然而，单个过程的物理真实性还需要进一步的证据。 需要额外的观测资料，如土壤湿度、地下水位和蒸发，来约束内部状态和通量。 还必须将学习到的参数与其所代表属性的独立估计值进行核对，例如土壤持水能力、洼地蓄水容积以及快速流路径的导水率。 仅凭静态属性无法区分具有不同响应类型的流域，而通过对属性进行扰动并平均模拟流量，可以减少无资料流域的预测误差。 闭合律是对训练期强迫所经历状态的平均，因此它依赖于该气候。 在气候或土地利用发生持续变化时，该组合的分布会发生移动，闭合关系也随之移动。 这是长期干旱后流域响应发生变化的一个可能来源。 澳大利亚流域比开发中使用的任何流域都更为干旱，它们检验了所学到的闭合关系能延伸到另一种气候的程度。 CaRT 和 CaRT + 是日集总式模型。 但这些定律并不受限于日步长，因为定律 1 和定律 3 不依赖于时间步长，而定律 2 在惯性仍可忽略的条件下在更短步长上也成立。 在惯性起作用的地方，例如小时步长的河道水流，通量需要一个动量状态，而耗散定律则变成一个包含动能的能量平衡。

sents.zh: 但这些定律并不受限于日步长，因为定律 1 和定律 3 不依赖于时间步长，而定律 2 在惯性仍可忽略的条件下在更短步长上也成立。

sents.en: Where inertia matters, as may happen for channel flow at hourly steps, a flux needs a momentum state, and the dissipation law becomes an energy balance that includes the kinetic energy.
sents.zh: 在惯性起作用的地方，例如小时步长的河道水流，通量需要一个动量状态，而耗散定律则变成一个包含动能的能量平衡。

paragraphs.en: We asked whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can predict streamflow as accurately as a neural network trained on the same inputs. For single models in gauged catchments the answer is yes on 671 British and 671 US catchments (602 and 593 gauged), and it holds on 561 Australian catchments (505 gauged) whose data played no part in building the structure. Three laws, conservation, dissipation and aggregation, restrict a lumped model to a compartmental system on a flux network driven by potential differences. In this system the flux laws follow from the aggregation of local laws and the unresolved composition enters as memory. Their corollary gives the four operations by which such a model may be refined.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探究了在物理定律下构建的低维系统能否像在同一输入上训练的神经网络一样准确地预测径流。 对于有测站的流域中的单模型，答案在671个英国流域和671个美国流域（其中有测站的分别为602个和593个）上是肯定的，并且在561个澳大利亚流域（其中有测站的为505个）上也成立，而这些流域的数据并未参与该结构的构建。 三条定律——守恒、耗散与聚合——将集总式模型限制为一个由势差驱动的通量网络上的 compartment 系统。 在该系统中，通量定律源自局部定律的聚合，而未解析的组分则以记忆的形式进入。 其推论给出了对此类模型进行精化时可采用的四种操作。

sents.en: We asked whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can predict streamflow as accurately as a neural network trained on the same inputs.
sents.zh: 我们探究了在物理定律下构建的低维系统能否像在同一输入上训练的神经网络一样准确地预测径流。

sents.en: For single models in gauged catchments the answer is yes on 671 British and 671 US catchments (602 and 593 gauged), and it holds on 561 Australian catchments (505 gauged) whose data played no part in building the structure.

sents.en: Three laws, conservation, dissipation and aggregation, restrict a lumped model to a compartmental system on a flux network driven by potential differences.
sents.zh: 三条定律——守恒、耗散与聚合——将集总式模型限制为一个由势差驱动的通量网络上的 compartment 系统。

sents.en: In this system the flux laws follow from the aggregation of local laws and the unresolved composition enters as memory.
sents.zh: 在该系统中，通量定律源自局部定律的聚合，而未解析的组分则以记忆的形式进入。

sents.en: Their corollary gives the four operations by which such a model may be refined.
sents.zh: 其推论给出了对此类模型进行精化时可采用的四种操作。

paragraphs.en: A parsimonious model consistent with the laws, CaRT with 11 parameters per catchment, was refined in an iterative loop. The loop diagnoses deficits from the observations and derives each refinement from a stated fine-scale assumption with one of the four operations. In most cases the refinement nests the previous model, and it is tested against the observations over several seeds. AI agents helped execute the loop under the laws. The result, CaRT + , has fourteen states and 35 parameters per catchment, with one structure for both continents. As a single model it matches a stateful LSTM and an EA-LSTM trained on the same inputs, with median NSE 0.863 against 0.869 and 0.862 on CAMELS-GB and 0.765 against 0.751 and 0.754 on CAMELS-US. It is ahead of CaRT, HBV and the differentiable HBV by a larger margin. However, three-seed LSTM ensembles remain ahead of the CaRT + ensemble by 0.003–0.012. Transferred to CAMELS-AUS with the same structure and settings, CaRT + is the most accurate single model on the gauged catchments (median NSE 0.778) and, among the conceptual models, the closest to the observed volume in dry years. Removing the groups of refinements one at a time shows that runoff generation, quick release and evaporation carry most of the gain.
paragraphs.zh: 一个与定律一致、每个流域仅有11个参数的简约模型CaRT在一个迭代循环中得到了精炼。 该循环从观测数据中诊断缺陷，并根据明确陈述的精细尺度假设通过四种操作之一推导出每一次精炼。 在大多数情况下，精炼后的模型嵌套了之前的模型，并在多个随机种子下对照观测数据进行检验。 AI智能体在定律约束下帮助执行了该循环。 其结果CaRT+包含14个状态和每流域35个参数，并且在两个大洲使用同一结构。 作为单一模型，它与在相同输入上训练的有状态LSTM和EA-LSTM相当，在CAMELS-GB上的中位NSE为0.863，对比0.869和0.862；在CAMELS-US上为0.765，对比0.751和0.754。 它以更大的优势领先于CaRT、HBV和可微分HBV。 然而，三种子LSTM集成模型仍比CaRT+集成模型领先0.003–0.012。 在以相同结构和设置迁移到CAMELS-AUS后，CaRT+是有测站流域上最精确的单一模型（中位NSE为0.778），并且在概念模型中最接近干旱年份的观测水量。 逐一移除各组精炼表明，径流生成、快速释放和蒸发贡献了大部分收益。

paragraphs.en: In response to Dooge [1986] , who asked whether there are hydrological laws at the catchment scale, this work supports their existence as laws of form. The three laws say what a catchment model must be and how it may be changed, and in this sense they define the admissible topologies of a catchment model. One structure built under the three laws and their corollary describes 1342 catchments on two continents and carries over unchanged to 561 catchments on a third, with the same constitutive families in every catchment. But the parameters remained each catchment’s own and had to be learned, so the uniqueness of place resides in the parameters, which one network maps from the catchment attributes.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 Dooge [1986] 提出的“是否存在流域尺度的水文定律”这一问题，本工作支持其存在，表现为形态定律。 这三条定律说明了流域模型必须是什么以及它可以如何被改变，从这个意义上说，它们定义了流域模型的可容许拓扑。 在这三条定律及其推论下构建的一个结构，描述了两个大陆上的 1342 个流域，并原封不动地延续到第三个大陆上的 561 个流域，且每个流域中本构族都相同。 但参数仍属于每个流域自身，必须通过学习得到，因此场所的独特性体现在参数之中，而这些参数由一个网络从流域属性映射得到。

sents.en: But the parameters remained each catchment’s own and had to be learned, so the uniqueness of place resides in the parameters, which one network maps from the catchment attributes.
sents.zh: 但参数仍属于每个流域自身，必须通过学习得到，因此场所的独特性体现在参数之中，而这些参数由一个网络从流域属性映射得到。

paragraphs.en: The work thus provides evidence that catchment dynamics have a low-dimensional structure. Models with this structure are constructed systematically under physical constraints and match state-of-the-art neural networks in accuracy as single models. These models are dynamical systems of the class ( 14 ) with finite states, whose equations are written in closed form. The laws and their corollary are a basis for two lines of work. Better process models can be sought within them by the four operations, tested against streamflow and against the internal states and fluxes that streamflow alone does not constrain. In parallel, the catchment can be studied with the analytical methods of dynamical systems, opening the questions of stability, memory and equifinality to direct mathematical analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这项工作提供了证据表明流域动态具有低维结构。 具有这种结构的模型在物理约束下被系统地构建，作为单一模型其精度可与最先进的神经网络相媲美。 这些模型是具有有限状态的（14）类动力系统，其方程以封闭形式写出。 这些定律及其推论是两条研究路线的基础。 可以通过四种运算在其中寻找更好的过程模型，并用径流以及仅凭径流无法约束的内部状态和通量加以检验。 与此同时，可以运用动力系统的分析方法研究流域，使稳定性、记忆和等同终态性问题得以直接进行数学分析。

paragraphs.en: CAMELS-GB is available from the UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology [ Coxon et al., 2020 ] ; CAMELS-US [ Newman et al., 2015 , Addor et al., 2017 ] from the National Center for Atmospheric Research. The CAMELS-US forcing used here is Daymet version 4 [ Thornton et al., 2021 ] , averaged over the CAMELS basin polygons, with USGS daily discharge extended to 2019 from the National Water Information System. CAMELS-AUS version 2 [ Fowler et al., 2025 ] is available from Zenodo ( https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.12575680 , release 2.03), and its forcing and attributes are used as distributed. Model code (CaRT, CaRT + , the dHBV, HBV and LSTM implementations and the fused daily kernels with their adjoints) and the model input files, with a list of the data sources and links, are available at https://github.com/xiaxilin/cartplus .

paragraphs.en: The appendix combines exact statements with three expansions, each in its own small quantity. The decomposition ( 18 ), the elimination ( 20 ), the conditional mean, the realisation by modes ( 25 ), exact lumping, the two reservoirs and the stop operator ( 33 ) hold without approximation. The expansion in the amplitude of the composition, of order ε \varepsilon for units in parallel, yields ( 10 ), the moment equations ( 21 )–( 23 ) and the kernel ( 24 ), which is exact in two linear cases. The expansion in the ratio ζ \zeta of the slow to the fast rates gives the reduction by a spectral gap, ( 26 )–( 29 ). The expansion in frequency, for input that varies slowly over the travel times, gives ( 31 ) and ( 32 ). The three conditions are distinct, since a small spread implies neither a spectral gap nor slowly varying input.
paragraphs.zh: 附录将精确结论与三种展开结合在一起，每种展开各有一小部分内容。 分解（18）、消元（20）、条件均值、按模式的实现（25）、精确集总、两个库以及停止算子（33）均无需近似即成立。 关于复合振幅的展开，对并联单元而言为 ε \varepsilon 阶，给出（10）、矩方程（21）–（23）以及核（24），该核在两种线性情形下是精确的。 关于慢速率与快速率之比 ζ \zeta 的展开给出通过谱隙的约化，（26）–（29）。 关于频率的展开，针对在渡越时间内缓慢变化的输入，给出（31）与（32）。 这三个条件彼此不同，因为小的展宽既不意味着谱隙，也不意味着缓慢变化的输入。

paragraphs.en: The composition can therefore be kept as a state, through ( 18 ), or replaced by a functional of the history of the aggregates and the forcing plus the contribution of its initial value, through ( 20 ). Whether that contribution fades is a question of stability, taken up below, since 𝒚 ˙ = 𝟎 \dot{\bm{y}}=\bm{0} would keep it indefinitely. The two descriptions are the same equations in different coordinates, which is the statement of Law 3 . The threshold laws of this paper are of two kinds. Excess laws ( v − c ) + (v-c)_{+} and their powers are continuous and keep ( 18 ) locally Lipschitz. For units that fill to a capacity and spill, the reference state fills the units whose capacity lies below a common level and holds the others at that level. This reference state thus stays within the capacities, and the fine system is a sweeping process with a unique solution [ Brokate and Sprekels, 1996 ] . In both cases the composition is a functional of the history, and ( 20 ) holds.

paragraphs.en: Whether the initial term fades depends on the full system. Suppose that each flux depends only on the storages of the two volumes it connects and on conditional variables held fixed, and that it has the monotonicity stated in Section 2.1 , as on a K-orthogonal finest partition (Section 2.1 ) with conductances that are taken from the source and grow with its storage. The Jacobian of 𝒇 \bm{f} is then a compartmental matrix, with non-negative off-diagonal entries and column sums equal to minus the sensitivity of the outflow to the exterior. The logarithmic norm of this matrix in the water-volume norm is non-positive, so two fine trajectories under the same forcing do not move apart in water volume. They converge where, in addition, the rates are bounded uniformly in time and each volume has a path to the exterior along which the outflow sensitivities are bounded away from zero. For a single store they converge where the cumulative sensitivity ∫ ∂ q / ∂ x ​ 𝑑 t \int\partial q/\partial x\,\mathrm{d}t diverges [ Jacquez and Simon, 1993 ] . However, a flux modulated by a third storage, such as the quick release whose connectivity rises with the groundwater store (Section 4.2 ), adds off-diagonal entries of the opposite sign, and the fading of the full model is then a property of the fitted system. For 𝝌 \bm{\chi} the drainage is replaced by a contracting balance of its own, the condition of Appendix A.2 , as in ( 41 ). The full fine state forgets its initial value where, in addition, the conditional variables act on the stores in a cascade, driven by some stores and modulating others that do not drive them. In CaRT + the surface layer drives the wetness, and the wetness modulates the quick release. The initial composition is part of the initial state and is forgotten with it. The stability of ( 18 ) alone, for a prescribed trajectory of 𝒛 \bm{z} , is a separate question, settled here for the two heterogeneous reservoirs and the linear networks of Appendix A.2 and for the balance of the hillslope wetness in ( 41 ).
paragraphs.zh: 初始项是否消失取决于整个系统。 假设每个通量只依赖于它所连接的两个容器的储量以及保持固定的条件变量，并且它具有第 2.1 节所述的单调性，例如在一个 K-正交最细划分（第 2.1 节）上，其导水率取自水源并随其储量增长。 于是 𝒇 的雅可比矩阵是一个隔室矩阵，其非对角元非负，且各列元素之和等于流出对外的敏感度的负值。 该矩阵在水体积范数下的对数范数非正，因此在相同强迫下两条精细轨迹在水体积上不会相互分离。 此外，在速率随时间一致有界、且每个容器都存在一条到外部的路径使得沿途流出敏感度有下界的情形下，它们收敛。 对于单一储库，当累积敏感度 ∫ ∂q/∂x dt 发散时它们收敛 [ Jacquez and Simon, 1993 ]。 然而，由第三个储量调制的通量，例如其连通性随地下水储量上升的快速释放（第 4.2 节），会加入符号相反的非对角元，此时完整模型的消失便是拟合系统的性质。 对于 𝝌，排水由其自身的收缩平衡所取代，即附录 A.2 的条件，如 ( 41 ) 所示。 完整的精细状态会遗忘其初始值的条件是：此外，条件变量以级联方式作用于各储库，即由某些储库驱动并调制那些不驱动它们的储库。 在 CaRT + 中，表层驱动湿度，湿度调制快速释放。 初始组分是初始状态的一部分，并随之被遗忘。 对于给定的 𝒛 轨迹，( 18 ) 本身的稳定性是另一个问题，这里针对两个非均质水库与附录 A.2 的线性网络以及 ( 41 ) 中山坡湿度的平衡加以解决。

paragraphs.en: With the coefficients frozen at the current mean, the three equations are linear in the moments. The two covariances do not depend on the variance, so the matrix of the system is triangular, with − f s -f_{s} on the diagonal for each covariance and − 2 ​ f s -2f_{s} for the variance, and for f s > 0 f_{s}>0 the lag decays with the rates f s f_{s} and 2 ​ f s 2f_{s} . For f = a ​ s p f=as^{p} the rate f s f_{s} equals p p times the inverse f / s f/s of the residence time s / f s/f . The spread therefore remembers the inputs over a time of order 1 / f s 1/f_{s} , a fraction 1 / p 1/p of the residence time and the whole residence time for linear units. This is the statement in Section 2.3 that the moments are not functions of the current mean, and it is why the closure can be written either with the moments as extra states or as a memory of the forcing. Since the aggregate flux depends on the moments through ( 10 ) and the moments evolve by ( 21 ), ( 22 ) and ( 23 ), the aggregate flux carries a memory of the forcing. This is the concrete form of ( 20 ) for units in parallel to second order in the spread.
paragraphs.zh: 在系数固定于当前均值的情况下，这三个方程对矩而言是线性的。 两个协方差不依赖于方差，因此该系统的矩阵是三角矩阵，每个协方差的对角元为 − f s -f_{s}，方差的对角元为 − 2 ​ f s -2f_{s}，并且当 f s > 0 f_{s}>0 时，滞后分别以速率 f s f_{s} 和 2 ​ f s 2f_{s} 衰减。 对于 f = a ​ s p f=as^{p}，速率 f s f_{s} 等于 p p 乘以驻留时间 s / f s/f 的倒数 f / s f/s。 因此，展布会在约 1 / f s 1/f_{s} 的时间尺度上记住输入，这一时间对于线性单元而言是驻留时间的 1 / p 1/p 比例，即整个驻留时间。 这就是第 2.3 节中所述的矩不是当前均值的函数的论断，这也是为什么闭包既可以写成把矩作为额外状态，也可以写成对强迫的记忆。 由于聚合通量通过 ( 10 ) 依赖于矩，而矩通过 ( 21 )、( 22 ) 和 ( 23 ) 演化，聚合通量携带着对强迫的记忆。 这就是 ( 20 ) 对于展布二阶精度并联单元的具体形式。

paragraphs.en: The closed law ( 7 ) is the conditional mean of the right-hand side of ( 20 ) for given aggregates and forcing, taken over the distribution of the composition that the forced system visits. We take this to be the occupation distribution of a bounded trajectory under stationary forcing, the time fraction that the trajectory spends at each composition, and assume that it exists and is unique. This is the assumption behind the phrase “weighted by how often it occurs”. Boundedness is a further assumption, met where the net loss of the total storage has a positive lower bound at large storage. The part of ℛ \mathcal{R} due to the composition is the departure of Δ ​ 𝑭 ​ ( 𝒛 , 𝒴 t ​ [ 𝒚 ⁡ ( 0 ) ; 𝒛 , 𝒖 ] , 𝒖 ) \Delta\bm{F}\big(\bm{z},\mathcal{Y}_{t}[\bm{y}(0);\bm{z},\bm{u}],\bm{u}\big) from the conditional mean E [ Δ 𝑭 ∣ 𝒛 , 𝒖 ] \mathrm{E}[\Delta\bm{F}\mid\bm{z},\bm{u}] and has zero conditional mean by construction. Forcing whose pattern over the units changes from event to event adds to ( 18 ) a term that the aggregates and their history do not determine. The fine system then also depends on this pattern and on the fluxes that people control, and the elimination ( 20 ) holds for their given history. Where the local laws are linear with identical rates this term cancels in the sum. Where they are nonlinear or heterogeneous it is the part of ℛ \mathcal{R} of Section 2.2 that no lumped structure recovers.
paragraphs.zh: 闭式律（7）是在受迫系统所经历的组分的分布上，取（20）右端在给定聚合量与外力作用下的条件均值。 我们将其取为有界轨迹在平稳外力作用下的驻留分布，即轨迹在每个组分上所花费的时间比例，并假定它存在且唯一。 这就是“按其出现频率加权”这一说法背后的假设。 有界性是一个进一步的假设，在总储存量的净损失于大储存量时具有正下界的情形下即满足该假设。 ℛ \mathcal{R} 中由组分引起的部分是 Δ ​ 𝑭 ​ ( 𝒛 , 𝒴 t ​ [ 𝒚 ⁡ ( 0 ) ; 𝒛 , 𝒖 ] , 𝒖 ) \Delta\bm{F}\big(\bm{z},\mathcal{Y}_{t}[\bm{y}(0);\bm{z},\bm{u}],\bm{u}\big) 相对于条件均值 E [ Δ 𝑭 ∣ 𝒛 , 𝒖 ] \mathrm{E}[\Delta\bm{F}\mid\bm{z},\bm{u}] 的偏差，并且在构造上其条件均值为零。 其在各单元上的模式随事件而变化的外力作用，会向（18）添加一个不由聚合量及其历史所决定的项。 这样，细粒度系统还依赖于这一模式以及人们控制的通量，而消去式（20）对它们的给定历史成立。 当局部律为线性且速率相同时，该项在求和中抵消。 当局部律为非线性或非齐次时，它就是 2.2 节中 ℛ \mathcal{R} 的没有任何集总结构能够再现的那一部分。

sents.en: Forcing whose pattern over the units changes from event to event adds to ( 18 ) a term that the aggregates and their history do not determine.
sents.zh: 其在各单元上的模式随事件而变化的外力作用，会向（18）添加一个不由聚合量及其历史所决定的项。

sents.en: The fine system then also depends on this pattern and on the fluxes that people control, and the elimination ( 20 ) holds for their given history.
sents.zh: 这样，细粒度系统还依赖于这一模式以及人们控制的通量，而消去式（20）对它们的给定历史成立。

sents.en: Where the local laws are linear with identical rates this term cancels in the sum.

The three terms have the roles of the Markov, memory and noise terms of the Mori–Zwanzig decomposition for the projection onto the reference state 𝒚 = 𝟎 \bm{y}=\bm{0} , whose Markov term is 𝑭 0 \bm{F}_{0} . Where the coefficients depend on the state, the orthogonal dynamics of that decomposition, which act on observables, differ from Φ \Phi . The conditional-expectation projection moves E [ Δ 𝑭 ∣ 𝒛 , 𝒖 ] \mathrm{E}[\Delta\bm{F}\mid\bm{z},\bm{u}] into the Markov term, which then equals the closed law 𝒇 ¯ \bar{\bm{f}} of ( 7 ). The memory and noise terms of this projection together equal the part of ℛ \mathcal{R} due to the composition, with zero conditional mean [ Zwanzig, 1973 , Chorin et al., 2002 ] . Equation ( 24 ) is exact in two cases of this paper, in which the composition enters linearly. In the first, the two heterogeneous reservoirs of Appendix B with ε ≠ 0 \varepsilon\neq 0 have 𝒚 = h \bm{y}=h , 𝑨 = − r 0 ​ m ​ ( W ) \bm{A}=-r_{0}m(W) and 𝒃 = r 0 ​ m ​ ( W ) ​ W \bm{b}=r_{0}m(W)W . The kernel acts on the history of W W with weights that decay over the residence time, and the initial imbalance is forgotten once the cumulative drainage ∫ r 0 ​ m ​ ( W ) ​ 𝑑 t \int r_{0}m(W)\,\mathrm{d}t diverges. In the second, a linear network of stores has constant 𝑨 \bm{A} , so Φ \Phi depends on t − s t-s only. The kernel acting on the history of 𝒛 \bm{z} and 𝒖 \bm{u} is then a sum of exponentials where 𝑨 \bm{A} is diagonalisable, which become damped oscillations where the rates are complex, as the modal decomposition below shows.

paragraphs.en: Equation ( 20 ) is a functional of the history because the composition was eliminated from ( 18 ). Representing the functional in ( 20 ) by states means choosing functions of the history which themselves obey ordinary differential equations driven by 𝒛 \bm{z} and 𝒖 \bm{u} , so that the model integrates them instead of storing the history. A history functional is carried exactly by finitely many states when it is the output of a finite-dimensional system, and approximately otherwise. The composition is the output of such a system, since it obeys the finite set of equations ( 18 ) driven by 𝒛 \bm{z} and 𝒖 \bm{u} , and retaining all of it represents its memory exactly. Retaining all of it can, however, return most of the fine state to the model. The question is therefore which parts of the composition must be kept to reproduce its effect on the aggregates. This is the Markov embedding of Section 2.3 and Appendix C . Each case below names the state and its equation and explains why it reproduces the functional.
paragraphs.zh: 方程 ( 20 ) 是历史的泛函，因为该组合量已从 ( 18 ) 中被消去。 用状态来表示 ( 20 ) 中的泛函，意味着选取一些历史的函数，这些函数本身服从由 𝒛 \bm{z} 和 𝒖 \bm{u} 驱动的常微分方程，从而模型只需对它们进行积分，而不必存储历史。 当一个历史泛函是有限维系统的输出时，它可以被有限多个状态精确携带；否则只能近似携带。 该组合量正是这样一个系统的输出，因为它服从由 𝒛 \bm{z} 和 𝒖 \bm{u} 驱动的有限方程组 ( 18 )，因此完整保留它就能精确表示其记忆。 然而，完整保留它可能会把大部分精细状态重新交还给模型。 因此问题在于：必须保留组合量的哪些部分，才能重现它对聚合量的影响。 这就是第 2.3 节和附录 C 中的马尔可夫嵌入。 下面每种情形都给出相应的状态及其方程，并解释为什么它能重现该泛函。

sents.en: Equation ( 20 ) is a functional of the history because the composition was eliminated from ( 18 ).
sents.zh: 方程 ( 20 ) 是历史的泛函，因为该组合量已从 ( 18 ) 中被消去。

sents.en: Representing the functional in ( 20 ) by states means choosing functions of the history which themselves obey ordinary differential equations driven by 𝒛 \bm{z} and 𝒖 \bm{u} , so that the model integrates them instead of storing the history.
sents.zh: 用状态来表示 ( 20 ) 中的泛函，意味着选取一些历史的函数，这些函数本身服从由 𝒛 \bm{z} 和 𝒖 \bm{u} 驱动的常微分方程，从而模型只需对它们进行积分，而不必存储历史。

sents.en: A history functional is carried exactly by finitely many states when it is the output of a finite-dimensional system, and approximately otherwise.
sents.zh: 当一个历史泛函是有限维系统的输出时，它可以被有限多个状态精确携带；否则只能近似携带。

sents.en: The composition is the output of such a system, since it obeys the finite set of equations ( 18 ) driven by 𝒛 \bm{z} and 𝒖 \bm{u} , and retaining all of it represents its memory exactly.
sents.zh: 该组合量正是这样一个系统的输出，因为它服从由 𝒛 \bm{z} 和 𝒖 \bm{u} 驱动的有限方程组 ( 18 )，因此完整保留它就能精确表示其记忆。

sents.en: Retaining all of it can, however, return most of the fine state to the model.
sents.zh: 然而，完整保留它可能会把大部分精细状态重新交还给模型。

sents.en: The question is therefore which parts of the composition must be kept to reproduce its effect on the aggregates.
sents.zh: 因此问题在于：必须保留组合量的哪些部分，才能重现它对聚合量的影响。

sents.en: This is the Markov embedding of Section 2.3 and Appendix C .
sents.zh: 这就是第 2.3 节和附录 C 中的马尔可夫嵌入。

sents.en: Each case below names the state and its equation and explains why it reproduces the functional.
sents.zh: 下面每种情形都给出相应的状态及其方程，并解释为什么它能重现该泛函。

paragraphs.en: Where rates repeat, 𝑨 \bm{A} may lack enough independent eigenvectors to separate the composition into independent modes. paragraphs.en: Decay of the modes. Under Law 2 and the conditions stated below, the modes of a linear network relax, so that the memory of its composition fades. For a linear network lumped into one aggregate, 𝑨 \bm{A} acts on the compositions, the vectors with 𝚷 ​ 𝒚 = 𝟎 \bm{\Pi}\bm{y}=\bm{0} , as 𝑴 = ( 𝑰 − D ​ 𝝃 ¯ ​ 𝚷 ) ​ 𝑵 \bm{M}=(\bm{I}-\mathrm{D}\bar{\bm{\xi}}\,\bm{\Pi})\bm{N} does. Here 𝑵 = ∂ 𝝃 𝒇 \bm{N}=\partial_{\bm{\xi}}\bm{f} is the network matrix and 𝝍 = D ​ 𝝃 ¯ \bm{\psi}=\mathrm{D}\bar{\bm{\xi}} holds the shares in which the reference state distributes a change of the aggregate, proportional to d ​ x i / d ​ H i \mathrm{d}x_{i}/\mathrm{d}H_{i} and summing to one. Every unit is taken to lie between its bounds at the reference state, so that each ψ i \psi_{i} is positive. On a K-orthogonal finest partition with the monotonicity stated in Section 2.1 , the off-diagonal entries of 𝑵 \bm{N} are non-negative, and so is − 𝚷 ​ 𝑵 -\bm{\Pi}\bm{N} , the increase of the outflow to the exterior per unit storage of each unit. The off-diagonal entries of 𝑴 = 𝑵 − 𝝍 ​ 𝚷 ​ 𝑵 \bm{M}=\bm{N}-\bm{\psi}\,\bm{\Pi}\bm{N} are then non-negative, and its columns sum to zero, since 𝚷 ​ 𝝍 = 1 \bm{\Pi}\bm{\psi}=1 . By the Gershgorin theorem applied to its columns, each eigenvalue of 𝑴 \bm{M} lies in a disc centred at a non-positive diagonal entry with a radius equal to that entry’s magnitude, so it has a non-positive real part and reaches the imaginary axis only at zero. The zero column sums give 𝑴 \bm{M} a zero eigenvalue, which belongs to the aggregate, since 𝑴 \bm{M} leaves the aggregate unchanged. The term − 𝝍 ​ 𝚷 ​ 𝑵 -\bm{\psi}\,\bm{\Pi}\bm{N} links every unit with an outflow to every unit, since each ψ i \psi_{i} is positive. Where each unit has a path to the exterior, all units are then connected with one another and 𝑴 \bm{M} is irreducible, so its zero eigenvalue is simple by the Perron–Frobenius theorem [ Jacquez and Simon, 1993 ] . The relaxation rates λ j \lambda_{j} , the negatives of the other eigenvalues, therefore have positive real parts. For linear exchange in both directions, with constant conductances and linear relations between storage and potential, 𝑨 \bm{A} , the restriction of 𝑴 \bm{M} to the compositions, is self-adjoint in the inner product weighted by d ​ H i / d ​ x i \mathrm{d}H_{i}/\mathrm{d}x_{i} , and the rates are real. Decay leaves the number of states unchanged, and an exact representation keeps one state for each component of the composition.

sents.en: Decay of the modes.
sents.zh: 各模态的衰减。

sents.en: Under Law 2 and the conditions stated below, the modes of a linear network relax, so that the memory of its composition fades.
sents.zh: 在定律 2 及下述条件下，线性网络的模态会弛豫，使其组成的记忆逐渐消退。

sents.en: For a linear network lumped into one aggregate, 𝑨 \bm{A} acts on the compositions, the vectors with 𝚷 ​ 𝒚 = 𝟎 \bm{\Pi}\bm{y}=\bm{0} , as 𝑴 = ( 𝑰 − D ​ 𝝃 ¯ ​ 𝚷 ) ​ 𝑵 \bm{M}=(\bm{I}-\mathrm{D}\bar{\bm{\xi}}\,\bm{\Pi})\bm{N} does.
sents.zh: 对于归并为一个聚合体的线性网络，𝑨 \bm{A} 作用于各组成（即满足 𝚷 ​ 𝒚 = 𝟎 \bm{\Pi}\bm{y}=\bm{0} 的向量），其作用方式如同 𝑴 = ( 𝑰 − D ​ 𝝃 ¯ ​ 𝚷 ) ​ 𝑵 \bm{M}=(\bm{I}-\mathrm{D}\bar{\bm{\xi}}\,\bm{\Pi})\bm{N}。

sents.en: Here 𝑵 = ∂ 𝝃 𝒇 \bm{N}=\partial_{\bm{\xi}}\bm{f} is the network matrix and 𝝍 = D ​ 𝝃 ¯ \bm{\psi}=\mathrm{D}\bar{\bm{\xi}} holds the shares in which the reference state distributes a change of the aggregate, proportional to d ​ x i / d ​ H i \mathrm{d}x_{i}/\mathrm{d}H_{i} and summing to one.
sents.zh: 这里 𝑵 = ∂ 𝝃 𝒇 \bm{N}=\partial_{\bm{\xi}}\bm{f} 是网络矩阵，而 𝝍 = D ​ 𝝃 ¯ \bm{\psi}=\mathrm{D}\bar{\bm{\xi}} 给出各份额，参考态按这些份额将聚合体的变化分摊到各单元，份额与 d ​ x i / d ​ H i \mathrm{d}x_{i}/\mathrm{d}H_{i} 成正比且总和为一。

sents.en: Every unit is taken to lie between its bounds at the reference state, so that each ψ i \psi_{i} is positive.
sents.zh: 假定每个单元在参考态都处于其界限之内，因而每个 ψ i \psi_{i} 均为正。

sents.en: On a K-orthogonal finest partition with the monotonicity stated in Section 2.1 , the off-diagonal entries of 𝑵 \bm{N} are non-negative, and so is − 𝚷 ​ 𝑵 -\bm{\Pi}\bm{N} , the increase of the outflow to the exterior per unit storage of each unit.
sents.zh: 在具有第 2.1 节所述单调性的 K-正交最细划分上，𝑵 \bm{N} 的非对角元非负，− 𝚷 ​ 𝑵 -\bm{\Pi}\bm{N}（每个单位存储对应的外流增量）亦然。

sents.en: The off-diagonal entries of 𝑴 = 𝑵 − 𝝍 ​ 𝚷 ​ 𝑵 \bm{M}=\bm{N}-\bm{\psi}\,\bm{\Pi}\bm{N} are then non-negative, and its columns sum to zero, since 𝚷 ​ 𝝍 = 1 \bm{\Pi}\bm{\psi}=1 .

sents.en: By the Gershgorin theorem applied to its columns, each eigenvalue of 𝑴 \bm{M} lies in a disc centred at a non-positive diagonal entry with a radius equal to that entry’s magnitude, so it has a non-positive real part and reaches the imaginary axis only at zero.

sents.en: The zero column sums give 𝑴 \bm{M} a zero eigenvalue, which belongs to the aggregate, since 𝑴 \bm{M} leaves the aggregate unchanged.

sents.en: Where each unit has a path to the exterior, all units are then connected with one another and 𝑴 \bm{M} is irreducible, so its zero eigenvalue is simple by the Perron–Frobenius theorem [ Jacquez and Simon, 1993 ] .

We assume a spectral gap, Re ⁡ λ q + 1 ≫ Ω s \operatorname{Re}\lambda_{q+1}\gg\Omega_{s} , with the first q q rates slow and the others fast and with a complex pair kept or dropped as a whole. paragraphs.en: The error of the reduced system ( 27 ) remains of this order over long times where its slow dynamics damp perturbations at a uniform exponential rate, which we assume together with the gap and with couplings 𝒄 j \bm{c}_{j} that stay bounded as the fast rates grow. The damping has a physical basis in dissipation, since a store that drains or evaporates more when it holds more water forgets a perturbation of its storage at the rate ∂ L / ∂ S \partial L/\partial S at which the losses L L grow with the storage S S . For a lumped store this holds at the reference state of Section 2.2 , where the losses are those of units at one potential, and a flux modulated by a third store can break it (Appendix A.1 ). A snowpack, whose melt follows the energy supply, and a store below its spill threshold lose no more water when they hold more, and keep a perturbation until they melt out or spill, as do the units of the rate-independent case.
paragraphs.zh: 约化系统 ( 27 ) 的误差在很长时间内保持在这一量级，其慢动力学以一致的指数速率衰减扰动，我们连同谱隙以及随快速速率增长而保持有界的耦合 𝒄 j \bm{c}_{j} 一起作出这一假设。 这种衰减在耗散中有物理基础，因为一个储水单元持有的水越多，其排水或蒸发就越多，它会以损失 L L 随储量 S S 增长的速率 ∂ L / ∂ S \partial L/\partial S 忘却其储量的扰动。 对于集总储水单元，这在 2.2 节的参考状态下成立，此时损失是处于同一势能的单元的损失，而由第三个储水单元调制的通量可能破坏这一点（附录 A.1 ）。 积雪包的融化遵循能量供给，而低于溢流阈值的储水单元在持有更多水时不会流失更多水，它们会保持扰动直到融尽或溢流，速率无关情形中的单元也是如此。

paragraphs.en: The reduction is exact in two cases. In the first, a mode can be dropped because the aggregates do not see it ( 𝒄 j = 0 \bm{c}_{j}=0 ) or because nothing drives it and it starts at zero ( β j = 0 \beta_{j}=0 and a j ​ ( 0 ) = 0 a_{j}(0)=0 ). An undriven mode that starts away from zero fades at the rate Re ⁡ λ j \operatorname{Re}\lambda_{j} , and the error of dropping it decays at that rate. The same holds for a nonlinear 𝒈 \bm{g} where the reference state is invariant, so that the forcing creates no differences between the units, and where dissipation removes the differences that exist at a rate at least proportional to their size. The approximation holds where the forcing varies slowly over the whole travel-time distribution, which a long tail makes much longer than T T , and the next term carries the third moment of h h and p ¨ \ddot{p} . For stores in parallel the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality gives σ ≥ T \sigma\geq T , and the coefficient is of second order in the spread of the rates, as in ( 10 ). For two stores in series with k f ≫ k s k_{f}\gg k_{s} the coefficient ( σ 2 − T 2 ) / ( 2 T ) ≈ − 1 / k f (\sigma^{2}-T^{2})/(2T)\approx-1/k_{f} is a fraction of order k s / k f k_{s}/k_{f} of T T , the order of the error of the reduction by a spectral gap. A chain with one slow store therefore reduces to that store either way. A chain of similar stores keeps its stores, which hold the water in transit, or is closed in terms of z z with the first-order correction of ( 32 ), which adds no state but holds only for input that varies slowly compared with T T , which daily rain does not for the quick flow. The travel-time distribution acts on the input p p and includes the delay of the resolved store itself, whereas the composition kernel of ( 24 ) acts on the history of z z and p p . paragraphs.en: A threshold law can make 𝒈 \bm{g} non-differentiable at the threshold, and two cases differ. Where the units share the variable that drives a threshold law, or lateral exchange brings them to share it (Appendix C ), the aggregation ( 8 ) is exact in that variable and as smooth as the local law and the threshold distribution allow, continuously differentiable for an excess law and a continuous distribution. The memory then sits in the driving variable, a single relaxing mode that remains after the reduction by a spectral gap, and its balance is a closure of its own (Appendix C ). Where each unit crosses its threshold with its own state, the set of units above their thresholds defines a regime, within which every unit follows a smooth law. The composition then forms a switching system, whose equations change from one regime to the next as units cross their thresholds, and it relaxes at the rates of the regime it is in. Within a regime that has a spectral gap and lasts longer than the fast relaxation, it is reduced by that gap. A regime without drainage does not relax, as for units that store between two bounds, and neither a gap nor an expansion in frequency applies there.
paragraphs.zh: 阈值定律会使 𝒈 \bm{g} 在阈值处不可微，两种情况各有不同。 当各单元共享驱动阈值定律的变量，或通过侧向交换趋于共享该变量时（附录 C），聚合式（8）在该变量上是精确的，并且其光滑程度由局部定律和阈值分布决定；对于超额定律和连续分布，它是连续可微的。 此时记忆存在于驱动变量之中，即经过谱隙约化后仍保留的单一弛豫模式，其平衡本身构成一个封闭（附录 C）。 当每个单元依据自身状态跨越其阈值时，处于阈值之上的单元集合定义了一个区域（regime），在该区域内每个单元都遵循光滑定律。 此时的复合构成一个切换系统，其方程随单元跨越阈值而从一个区域切换到下一个区域，并以所处区域的速率弛豫。 在一个具有谱隙且持续时间长于快速弛豫的区域内部，系统经由该谱隙被约化。 没有排出的区域不会弛豫，例如在两个界限之间储存的单元；此时谱隙与频率展开都不适用。

paragraphs.en: so that every unit with a capacity larger than E E has the same deficit E − P w E-P_{w} and, where the capacities span E E , the deficit distribution takes a shape that a shift or scaling of the capacity distribution does not give in general. The two numbers E E and P w P_{w} are the state, and after repeated reversals the state is the current value of U U together with the list of its turning points in the order they occurred. Each reversal adds to the end of the list the value of U U at which the forcing turns. When U U later falls below a minimum in the list, or rises above a maximum in it, that entry and all entries after it are deleted, because every unit whose deficit depended on them has been emptied or filled again. Drying to − 30 -30 mm, wetting to − 20 -20 mm and drying to − 26 -26 mm produces the list ( − 30 , − 20 , − 26 ) (-30,-20,-26) , and drying on below − 30 -30 mm deletes all three. Along the list that remains the minima rise and the maxima fall, and a complete filling or emptying deletes the whole list. Keeping the last one or two levels is a truncated embedding with an error that depends on the discarded entries. Where evaporation depends on the storage, the state follows the paths of accumulated rain and accumulated demand separately, and no longer the single net forcing U U . The memory still ignores how fast these paths are travelled, but rain and demand now act in an order that U U does not record, so the turning points of U U only approximate the state.
paragraphs.zh: 使得每个容量大于 E E 的单元都具有相同的亏缺量 E − P w E-P_{w} ，并且当容量跨越 E E 时，亏缺量的分布呈现出一种容量分布经平移或缩放一般不会得到的形状。 这两个数 E E 和 P w P_{w} 就是状态，在反复的转向之后，状态就是 U U 的当前值连同其转向点按发生顺序排列的列表。 每次转向都会把强迫发生转变时的 U U 值追加到列表末尾。 当 U U 后来跌破列表中的某个极小值，或升破列表中的某个极大值时，该条目及其后的所有条目都会被删除，因为亏缺量依赖于它们的每个单元都已被重新排空或填满。 干燥到 − 30 -30 mm，湿润到 − 20 -20 mm，再干燥到 − 26 -26 mm，产生列表 ( − 30 , − 20 , − 26 ) (-30,-20,-26) ，而继续干燥跌破 − 30 -30 mm 则会删除全部三个条目。 沿着保留下来的列表，极小值上升，极大值下降，而一次完全的填满或排空会删除整个列表。 只保留最后一级或两级是一种截断的嵌入，其误差取决于被丢弃的条目。 当蒸发依赖于蓄水量时，状态分别沿累积降雨和累积需求的路径演化，而不再沿单一的净强迫 U U 演化。 记忆仍然忽略这些路径被行进的快慢，但降雨和需求现在以一种 U U 无法记录的顺序发挥作用，因此 U U 的转向点只能近似地表示状态。

paragraphs.en: CaRT + uses part of these results. The conditional variables are area means 𝝌 ¯ \bar{\bm{\chi}} of local conditional variables, to which the split ( 5 ) and the elimination ( 20 ) apply as to the stores (Appendix C , operation d). One state carries the hillslope wetness θ \theta (Appendix C ). It does so exactly on the synchronised state 𝒚 = 𝟎 \bm{y}=\bm{0} , which attracts the units under the shared forcing by ( 41 ), and otherwise under a spectral gap, ( 28 ) and ( 29 ). The scalar modes of ( 25 ) with a constant rate yield the exponential moving averages ω \omega and v v . The threshold aggregation ( 8 ) with a shared driving variable leads to the connected fraction A ⁡ ( θ ) A(\theta) and the infiltration capacities scaled by ω \omega . The travel-time memory of ( 31 ) is kept as water in transit in the unit hydrographs. The depressions keep no turning points, because their aggregation ( 9 ) assumes the deficits reached by filling from empty, a state without turning points, and is exact while they fill (Section 2.2 ). The fading of the initial composition underlies the spin-up (Appendix D ). The outlet weights and the moment equations ( 21 )–( 23 ) support the statements of Section 2.3 on the order and the time scale of the memory and do not enter CaRT + as states.

paragraphs.en: The hillslope wetness θ \theta , the near-surface wetness ω \omega and the vegetation activity v v , three of the fourteen states of CaRT + , carry no water and follow the forcing with a lag. They are conditional variables of operation (d) of Corollary 1 , area means 𝝌 ¯ \bar{\bm{\chi}} of local conditional variables (Section 2.2 ), and they carry the memory form of Law 3 . The construction of θ \theta uses every element of that law, an aggregation over thresholds, a memory of the forcing and a multiplier. This appendix follows it from the hypothesis on the hillslope units to the daily update, while the other two variables follow the same template with simpler choices. In Table 2 , θ \theta is the shared driving variable of a threshold aggregate.
paragraphs.zh: 山坡湿度 θ \theta 、近地表湿度 ω \omega 和植被活动度 v v 是 CaRT + 的十四个状态中的三个，它们不携带水量，而是带滞后地跟随强迫。 它们是推论 1 中操作 (d) 的条件变量、局地条件变量（第 2.2 节）的区域均值 𝝌 ¯ \bar{\bm{\chi}}，并且它们承载定律 3 的记忆形式。 θ \theta 的构造使用了该定律的每一个要素：跨阈值的聚合、对强迫的记忆以及一个乘数。 本附录从山坡单元上的假设出发，一路追踪到逐日更新，而另外两个变量遵循相同的模板，只是选择更简单。 在表 2 中，θ \theta 是阈值聚合的共享驱动变量。
