paragraphs.en: This is the state form of ( 25 ) with a single mode δ ​ θ \delta\theta of rate λ = 1 / τ eff \lambda=1/\tau_{\rm eff} and with the weighted net-input anomaly over C θ C_{\theta} as its drift. The anomaly δ ​ θ \delta\theta is therefore τ eff \tau_{\rm eff} times an exponential moving average of the drift, with time constant 1 / λ 1/\lambda , plus a decaying initial anomaly. With the learned parameters, at the equilibrium under the mean forcing, τ eff \tau_{\rm eff} has a median of 4.5 d on CAMELS-GB and 19 d on CAMELS-US, with the central 80 % of the catchments between 2.7 and 55 d and between 3.9 and 78 d, respectively. Away from the mean the rate is λ ⁡ ( θ ) \lambda(\theta) of ( 39 ), which changes with θ \theta and with the day’s forcing. The state is still the single number θ \theta , with a kernel that depends on the path, as for the two reservoirs with m ⁡ ( W ) ≠ 1 m(W)\neq 1 (Appendix B ). paragraphs.en: Near-surface wetness. The near-surface wetness ω \omega scales the infiltration capacities. A wetness shared by all points that scales every local capacity by the same factor keeps the capacities exponentially distributed, so the infiltration excess of Section 4.2 stays exact, and points with the same linear balance under the same input converge to one wetness by the argument of step 3. The model’s ω \omega , an exponential moving average of the water leaving the surface layer with a time constant of 3 days, is the exact daily solution of that balance. But the scale function in F = P ∗ e − g F ω / ω ¯ F=P^{*}e^{-g_{F}\omega/\bar{\omega}} is heuristic (Supporting Information S2).
paragraphs.zh: 近地表湿度。 近地表湿度 ω \omega 用于缩放下渗能力。 若所有点共享同一湿度，并以同一因子缩放每个局地能力，则这些能力仍保持指数分布，因此第 4.2 节的超渗结果保持精确，且在相同输入下具有相同线性平衡的点会依据第 3 步的论证收敛到同一湿度。 模型的 ω \omega 是离开表层水分的指数移动平均，时间常数为 3 天，正是该平衡的逐日精确解。 但 F = P ∗ e − g F ω / ω ¯ F=P^{*}e^{-g_{F}\omega/\bar{\omega}} 中的尺度函数是启发式的（Supporting Information S2）。

paragraphs.en: Vegetation activity. The vegetation activity v v is the active fraction of patches that switch between activity and dormancy at a common rate, depending on whether the air temperature exceeds their threshold. Each patch obeys a linear equation, so the area average relaxes exactly towards the threshold distribution at the day’s temperature, and with a logistic distribution its daily solution is the exponential moving average of the model. Averaging the demand of active and dormant patches gives E dem = PET ⁡ [ 1 − κ ⁡ ( 1 − v ) ] E_{\rm dem}=\mathrm{PET}[1-\kappa(1-v)] (Supporting Information S2).
paragraphs.zh: 植被活动性。 植被活动性 v v 是在各斑块之间以共同速率切换于活动与休眠状态的活跃斑块比例，具体取决于气温是否超过其阈值。 每个斑块服从一个线性方程，因此面积平均恰好向当日温度对应的阈值分布松弛，且当采用逻辑斯谛分布时，其每日解即为该模型的指数移动平均。 对活跃与休眠斑块的需求取平均得到 E dem = PET ⁡ [ 1 − κ ⁡ ( 1 − v ) ] E_{\rm dem}=\mathrm{PET}[1-\kappa(1-v)]（支持信息 S2）。

paragraphs.en: The operators of a day are applied in sequence as in GR4J: snow, surface layer, infiltration excess, production and near-stream zone, depressions, groundwater, routing, quick store with exchange, and channel loss (Supporting Information S1.2). State- or forcing-dependent coefficients are evaluated once per day and held fixed (Section 3.1 ), including the release multiplier and shape factor of the quick store, evaluated at the storage after the day’s inflow, and the uptake rate of the groundwater store. Stores with a closed-form law use the exact one-day solution, while the surface layer, the filling of the depressions and the exchange use explicit steps from the storage at the start of the day. Integrating all processes simultaneously would give a slightly different model [ Santos et al., 2018 ] . The energy bound of Law 2 is applied flux by flux. The evaporation of the surface layer, root zone, near-stream zone and depressions and the groundwater uptake draw on one demand in sequence. Sublimation and the melt term are computed from the potential evaporation of the day without being taken from that demand, so on snow-covered days the phase-change fluxes together can exceed it. The wetness θ \theta and the near-stream zone use the closed-form daily solutions of ( 17 ) (Riccati on days with net input, Bernoulli on days with net demand, checked against a fourth-order Runge–Kutta integration to 10 − 14 10^{-14} ). The daily recursions are implemented as fused GPU kernels with adjoint recursions, verified against automatic differentiation of the unrolled loop (Supporting Information S1.7).
paragraphs.zh: 一天内的各算子按顺序应用，与 GR4J 相同：积雪、表层、超渗产流、产流与近河带、洼地、地下水、汇流、带交换的快速水库以及河道损失（Supporting Information S1.2）。 依赖状态或强迫的系数每天评估一次并保持固定（Section 3.1），包括快速水库的释放乘数和形状因子（在当天入流后的储量处评估）以及地下水水库的吸取速率。 具有闭式解规律的水库使用精确的单日解，而表层、洼地的填充以及水分交换则从当天开始时的储量出发采用显式步长计算。 若同时积分所有过程，则会得到一个略有不同的模型 [ Santos et al., 2018 ] 。 规律 2 的能量上界按通量逐一施加。 表层、根区、近河带和洼地的蒸发以及地下水吸取按顺序共同消耗一个需求。 升华和融雪项根据当天的潜在蒸发计算，但不从该需求中扣除，因此在有积雪覆盖的日子，相变通量之和可能超过该潜在蒸发。 湿度 θ \theta 与近河带使用 ( 17 ) 的闭式单日解（净输入日采用里卡蒂解，净需求日采用伯努利解，并与四阶 Runge–Kutta 积分对比校验至 10 − 14 10^{-14} ）。 单日递归以融合 GPU 内核及伴随递归的形式实现，并通过展开循环的自动微分加以验证（Supporting Information S1.7）。

paragraphs.en: The EA-LSTM follows the configuration of Kratzert et al. [2019b] , with 256 units, dropout 0.4, the NSE ∗ loss and its learning-rate schedule, except for input sequences of 365 days instead of 270. Its dynamic inputs are the daily precipitation, mean air temperature and potential evaporation that the conceptual models receive, in place of the five Maurer forcing variables of the original study, so that every model has the same information. Training runs for 30 epochs with batches of 256, each epoch a random draw of 1.75 million training samples (the size of an epoch in the original study), with an initial forget-gate bias of 5, and the epoch with the highest median NSE over the selection period is kept. The configuration of the stateful LSTM is based on our own hyperparameter tuning. It has 256 units, output dropout 0.3 and an initial forget-gate bias of 3, and it is trained with the NSE ∗ loss by truncated back-propagation through time on 180-day chunks for groups of 151 catchments at a constant learning rate, for at most 300 epochs with early stopping on the selection period. dHBV is trained with Adam (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} ) for 6000 iterations on batches of 100 two-year windows, the first year of which spins up the states. Its median NSE over the selection period is evaluated every 500 iterations, and the best checkpoint is kept. The LSTM of dHBV has 256 units and dropout 0.5. dHBV receives the static attributes without the band elevations, and its snow routine works on the catchment-mean temperature, as in the original. In evaluation its static parameters are the LSTM output on the last day of the training period. All three benchmarks are trained with Adam, starting from a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and clip the gradient norm at 1. CaRT, CaRT + and the regionalised HBV were trained with one fixed configuration throughout. We rebuilt the CAMELS-US forcing from Daymet version 4 rather than extending the version distributed with CAMELS because the two differ in their day convention. Version 4 corrects the time of observation of the precipitation gauges so that a daily value covers the calendar day [ Thornton et al., 2021 ] , whereas in the CAMELS version most of a day’s rain is recorded on the following day. A model trained on one version and run on the other loses about 0.2 in median NSE from this shift alone, with a loss of 0.006–0.009 once the shift is removed.
paragraphs.zh: EA-LSTM 遵循 Kratzert 等人的配置。 [2019b]，使用 256 个单元、dropout 0.4、NSE ∗ 损失及其学习率调度，但输入序列为 365 天而非 270 天。 其动态输入是概念模型所接收的日降水量、平均气温和潜在蒸发量，以取代原始研究中的五个 Maurer 强迫变量，从而使每个模型拥有相同的信息。 训练运行 30 个 epoch，批次大小为 256，每个 epoch 随机抽取 175 万个训练样本（即原始研究中一个 epoch 的大小），初始遗忘门偏置为 5，并保留在选择期内中位数 NSE 最高的那个 epoch。 有状态 LSTM 的配置基于我们自己的超参数调优。 它有 256 个单元、输出 dropout 0.3 和初始遗忘门偏置 3，使用 NSE ∗ 损失，通过时间截断反向传播在 180 天的分块上、以恒定学习率对每组 151 个流域进行训练，最多训练 300 个 epoch 并在选择期上早停。dHBV 使用 Adam（学习率 10 − 3 10^{-3}）在由 100 个两年窗口组成的批次上训练 6000 次迭代，其中第一年用于预热状态。 每 500 次迭代在选择期上评估一次其中位数 NSE，并保留最佳检查点。 dHBV 的 LSTM 有 256 个单元，dropout 为 0.5。dHBV 接收除带状高程之外的静态属性，其积雪模块作用于流域平均温度，与原始研究一致。 在评估时，其静态参数为训练期最后一天 LSTM 的输出。 所有三个基准模型均使用 Adam 训练，初始学习率为 10 − 3 10^{-3}，并将梯度范数裁剪为 1。 CaRT、CaRT + 和区域化 HBV 在整个训练过程中使用同一个固定配置。 我们基于 Daymet 第 4 版重建了 CAMELS-US 强迫数据，而不是直接沿用 CAMELS 附带的版本，因为二者在日期约定上有所不同。 第 4 版修正了降水观测仪器的观测时间，使一个日值对应一个日历日 [ Thornton et al., 2021 ]，而在 CAMELS 版本中，一天的降水大部分被记录在次日。 仅由这一偏移造成的影响，在一个版本上训练、在另一个版本上运行的模型，其中位数 NSE 会损失约 0.2；消除该偏移后，损失为 0.006–0.009。

sents.en: The EA-LSTM follows the configuration of Kratzert et al.
sents.zh: EA-LSTM 遵循 Kratzert 等人的配置。

sents.en: [2019b] , with 256 units, dropout 0.4, the NSE ∗ loss and its learning-rate schedule, except for input sequences of 365 days instead of 270.
sents.zh: [2019b]，使用 256 个单元、dropout 0.4、NSE ∗ 损失及其学习率调度，但输入序列为 365 天而非 270 天。

sents.en: Its dynamic inputs are the daily precipitation, mean air temperature and potential evaporation that the conceptual models receive, in place of the five Maurer forcing variables of the original study, so that every model has the same information.
sents.zh: 其动态输入是概念模型所接收的日降水量、平均气温和潜在蒸发量，以取代原始研究中的五个 Maurer 强迫变量，从而使每个模型拥有相同的信息。

sents.en: Training runs for 30 epochs with batches of 256, each epoch a random draw of 1.75 million training samples (the size of an epoch in the original study), with an initial forget-gate bias of 5, and the epoch with the highest median NSE over the selection period is kept.
sents.zh: 训练运行 30 个 epoch，批次大小为 256，每个 epoch 随机抽取 175 万个训练样本（即原始研究中一个 epoch 的大小），初始遗忘门偏置为 5，并保留在选择期内中位数 NSE 最高的那个 epoch。

sents.en: The configuration of the stateful LSTM is based on our own hyperparameter tuning.
sents.zh: 有状态 LSTM 的配置基于我们自己的超参数调优。

sents.en: It has 256 units, output dropout 0.3 and an initial forget-gate bias of 3, and it is trained with the NSE ∗ loss by truncated back-propagation through time on 180-day chunks for groups of 151 catchments at a constant learning rate, for at most 300 epochs with early stopping on the selection period. dHBV is trained with Adam (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} ) for 6000 iterations on batches of 100 two-year windows, the first year of which spins up the states.
sents.zh: 它有 256 个单元、输出 dropout 0.3 和初始遗忘门偏置 3，使用 NSE ∗ 损失，通过时间截断反向传播在 180 天的分块上、以恒定学习率对每组 151 个流域进行训练，最多训练 300 个 epoch 并在选择期上早停。dHBV 使用 Adam（学习率 10 − 3 10^{-3}）在由 100 个两年窗口组成的批次上训练 6000 次迭代，其中第一年用于预热状态。

sents.en: Its median NSE over the selection period is evaluated every 500 iterations, and the best checkpoint is kept.
sents.zh: 每 500 次迭代在选择期上评估一次其中位数 NSE，并保留最佳检查点。

sents.en: The LSTM of dHBV has 256 units and dropout 0.5. dHBV receives the static attributes without the band elevations, and its snow routine works on the catchment-mean temperature, as in the original.
sents.zh: dHBV 的 LSTM 有 256 个单元，dropout 为 0.5。dHBV 接收除带状高程之外的静态属性，其积雪模块作用于流域平均温度，与原始研究一致。

sents.en: In evaluation its static parameters are the LSTM output on the last day of the training period.
sents.zh: 在评估时，其静态参数为训练期最后一天 LSTM 的输出。

sents.en: All three benchmarks are trained with Adam, starting from a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and clip the gradient norm at 1.
sents.zh: 所有三个基准模型均使用 Adam 训练，初始学习率为 10 − 3 10^{-3}，并将梯度范数裁剪为 1。

sents.en: CaRT, CaRT + and the regionalised HBV were trained with one fixed configuration throughout.
sents.zh: CaRT、CaRT + 和区域化 HBV 在整个训练过程中使用同一个固定配置。

sents.en: We rebuilt the CAMELS-US forcing from Daymet version 4 rather than extending the version distributed with CAMELS because the two differ in their day convention.
sents.zh: 我们基于 Daymet 第 4 版重建了 CAMELS-US 强迫数据，而不是直接沿用 CAMELS 附带的版本，因为二者在日期约定上有所不同。

sents.en: Version 4 corrects the time of observation of the precipitation gauges so that a daily value covers the calendar day [ Thornton et al., 2021 ] , whereas in the CAMELS version most of a day’s rain is recorded on the following day.
sents.zh: 第 4 版修正了降水观测仪器的观测时间，使一个日值对应一个日历日 [ Thornton et al., 2021 ]，而在 CAMELS 版本中，一天的降水大部分被记录在次日。

sents.en: A model trained on one version and run on the other loses about 0.2 in median NSE from this shift alone, with a loss of 0.006–0.009 once the shift is removed.
sents.zh: 仅由这一偏移造成的影响，在一个版本上训练、在另一个版本上运行的模型，其中位数 NSE 会损失约 0.2；消除该偏移后，损失为 0.006–0.009。

paragraphs.en: Here i e i_{e} , d d and d z d_{z} are infiltration excess and the saturation excess of the root and near-stream zones, all of which enter the depressions V V . The exchange j ext j_{\rm ext} with the exterior (inflow J J and dissipative loss together) is applied with weight 0.9 to R R and 0.1 to the direct path to the outlet. The exchange on the direct path and the channel loss connect two boundary nodes and have no store entry. Merging U U , S ~ \tilde{S} , Z ~ \tilde{Z} and V V maps every internal flux (row) onto a flux of CaRT ( 𝚷 ′ ​ 𝑩 ′ = 𝑩 ​ 𝑲 \bm{\Pi}^{\prime}\bm{B}^{\prime}=\bm{B}\bm{K} ). The near-stream drainage to the outlet, the evaporation of the depressions and the groundwater uptake are the boundary fluxes that CaRT lacks. The exterior inflow and the channel loss use connections that CaRT already has and change the laws of those fluxes. paragraphs.en: Supporting Information for: From hydrological laws to catchment models: A process-based model matches deep-learning accuracy on three continents
paragraphs.zh: 支持信息：从水文定律到流域模型：基于过程的模型在三大洲上达到与深度学习相当的精度

paragraphs.en: Summary. Section S1 gives the complete specification of CaRT and CaRT + including the numerical implementation, parameter ranges and initial values. It also documents initial states and spin-up, the static-attribute neural network and its training, and the water-balance bookkeeping. Section S2 derives each refinement of CaRT + from its fine-scale assumption and states the nested limit and the origin of the derivation. References cited in this Supporting Information are listed in the reference list of the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要。 第 S1 节给出 CaRT 与 CaRT + 的完整技术规范，包括数值实现、参数范围和初始值。 该节还记录了初始状态与启动过程、静态属性神经网络及其训练，以及水量平衡核算。 第 S2 节从其细尺度假设出发推导 CaRT + 的每一项改进，并说明嵌套极限以及推导的来源。 本支持信息中引用的参考文献列于正文的参考文献列表中。

paragraphs.en: The continuous laws of the main text are implemented as discrete daily operations. This section specifies the operations as they were trained and evaluated, including where they differ from the continuous laws (operator splitting, clamps, the bounded release multiplier).
paragraphs.zh: 正文的连续定律被实现为离散的每日操作。 本节按照训练和评估时所使用的方式规定这些操作，包括它们与连续定律不同的地方（算子拆分、截断、有界释放乘数）。

paragraphs.en: A store written without a mark is its value at the start of the day. A subscript m m marks its value after the inflow of the day, primes mark further values within the day, and a superscript + + marks the value at the end of the day, which is the start value of the next day. Where a store is integrated exactly over the day, z 0 z_{0} and z 1 z_{1} are its scaled values at the start and the end of the day. A subscript t t marks the value of a series on day t t , that is, the forcing of the day, a coefficient computed for the day or the end-of-day value of a state or conditional variable ( s t = S + / C s_{t}=S^{+}/C , W t = W + W_{t}=W^{+} , θ t \theta_{t} , v t v_{t} ). The wetness index ω t \omega_{t} enters day t t and is computed from the input up to day t − 1 t-1 . How each daily update relates to the continuous law is stated at the end of Sections S1.3 and S1.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 未加标记的储存量表示其在当日开始时的值。 下标 m m 表示其在当日入流之后的值，撇号表示当日内的后续值，上标 + + 表示当日结束时的值，即次日的起始值。 当某储存量在当日被精确积分时，z 0 z_{0} 和 z 1 z_{1} 分别表示其在当日开始和结束时的缩放值。 下标 t t 表示某序列在第 t t 天的值，即当日的强迫、为当日计算的系数，或某状态变量或条件变量的日终值（ s t = S + / C s_{t}=S^{+}/C 、W t = W + W_{t}=W^{+} 、θ t \theta_{t} 、v t v_{t} ）。 湿度指数 ω t \omega_{t} 进入第 t t 天，并由截至第 t − 1 t-1 天的输入计算得出。 每个每日更新与连续规律之间的关系在 S1.3 和 S1.4 节的末尾说明。

sents.en: A subscript m m marks its value after the inflow of the day, primes mark further values within the day, and a superscript + + marks the value at the end of the day, which is the start value of the next day.
sents.zh: 下标 m m 表示其在当日入流之后的值，撇号表示当日内的后续值，上标 + + 表示当日结束时的值，即次日的起始值。

sents.en: Where a store is integrated exactly over the day, z 0 z_{0} and z 1 z_{1} are its scaled values at the start and the end of the day.
sents.zh: 当某储存量在当日被精确积分时，z 0 z_{0} 和 z 1 z_{1} 分别表示其在当日开始和结束时的缩放值。

sents.en: A subscript t t marks the value of a series on day t t , that is, the forcing of the day, a coefficient computed for the day or the end-of-day value of a state or conditional variable ( s t = S + / C s_{t}=S^{+}/C , W t = W + W_{t}=W^{+} , θ t \theta_{t} , v t v_{t} ).
sents.zh: 下标 t t 表示某序列在第 t t 天的值，即当日的强迫、为当日计算的系数，或某状态变量或条件变量的日终值（ s t = S + / C s_{t}=S^{+}/C 、W t = W + W_{t}=W^{+} 、θ t \theta_{t} 、v t v_{t} ）。

sents.en: The wetness index ω t \omega_{t} enters day t t and is computed from the input up to day t − 1 t-1 .
sents.zh: 湿度指数 ω t \omega_{t} 进入第 t t 天，并由截至第 t − 1 t-1 天的输入计算得出。

sents.en: How each daily update relates to the continuous law is stated at the end of Sections S1.3 and S1.4 .
sents.zh: 每个每日更新与连续规律之间的关系在 S1.3 和 S1.4 节的末尾说明。

paragraphs.en: Per catchment and day the forcing is precipitation P P , daily mean air temperature T T and potential evapotranspiration E E , all three distributed with the dataset. On CAMELS-GB E E is the dataset PET with interception correction. On CAMELS-US T T is the mean of the Daymet daily maximum and minimum, and E E is the Priestley–Taylor PET from the Daymet forcing. On CAMELS-AUS P P and T T are those of the Australian Gridded Climate Data, with T T the mean of the daily maximum and minimum, and E E is the Morton wet-environment PET of SILO. The record runs from 3 December 1988 (CAMELS-GB) or 1 January 1980 (CAMELS-US and CAMELS-AUS) to 31 December 2019. Each simulation starts on the first day of the record and runs continuously to its end. The days before the training period are simulated but do not enter the loss (Section S1.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个流域每天（catchment-day）的驱动数据为降水量 P P、日平均气温 T T 和潜在蒸散量 E E，三者均随数据集一同分发。 在 CAMELS-GB 上，E E 为该数据集经截留校正后的 PET。 在 CAMELS-US 上，T T 为 Daymet 日最高与最低气温的平均值，E E 为基于 Daymet 驱动数据的 Priestley–Taylor PET。 在 CAMELS-AUS 上，P P 和 T T 取自澳大利亚网格化气候数据（Australian Gridded Climate Data），其中 T T 为日最高与最低气温的平均值，E E 为 SILO 的 Morton 湿润环境 PET。 记录时段从 1988 年 12 月 3 日（CAMELS-GB）或 1980 年 1 月 1 日（CAMELS-US 和 CAMELS-AUS）开始，到 2019 年 12 月 31 日结束。 每次模拟均从记录的第一天开始，并连续运行至记录结束。 训练期之前的各天会被模拟，但不计入损失（第 S1.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Both models use K = 5 K=5 elevation bands with elevations h k h_{k} and area fractions a k a_{k} . On CAMELS-GB, a k = 1 / 5 a_{k}=1/5 and h k h_{k} is the elevation at the 10, 30, 50, 70 and 90 % points of the hypsometric curve, which is interpolated linearly through the minimum, 10 %, 50 %, 90 % and maximum elevations of the topographic attributes. On CAMELS-US, the 100 m bands of the dataset with positive area are sorted by elevation. Band i i is assigned to group min ⁡ { ⌊ ( cumulative area up to and including ​ i − 10 − 9 ) / 0.2 ⌋ , 4 } \min\{\lfloor(\text{cumulative area up to and including }i-10^{-9})/0.2\rfloor,4\} (a band that ends exactly at 20, 40, 60 or 80 % of the area stays in the lower group). The group elevation h k h_{k} is the area-weighted mean of its bands and a k a_{k} is its area, which is renormalised so that ∑ k a k = 1 \sum_{k}a_{k}=1 , with a k = 0 a_{k}=0 for empty groups. Because a single 100 m band often covers more than a fifth of a basin, the groups are generally not equal-area and some are empty. Of the 671 CAMELS-US basins, 446 have at least one empty group, and 93 have a single non-empty group (44 of them a single 100 m band). Among basins with two or more groups, the median ratio of the largest to the smallest group area is 3.1. CAMELS-AUS distributes no band elevations, so its five bands have a k = 1 / 5 a_{k}=1/5 and h k h_{k} at the 10, 30, 50, 70 and 90 % quantiles of a normal hypsometry truncated at the lowest and highest elevation of the catchment. The distribution has a standard deviation of 0.17 times the elevation range (the median ratio of the CAMELS-US bands) and a centre chosen so that the mean of the truncated distribution equals the mean elevation. The elevation offsets Δ ​ h k = ( h k − ∑ j a j ​ h j ) / 1000 \Delta h_{k}=(h_{k}-\sum_{j}a_{j}h_{j})/1000 are in km.
paragraphs.zh: 两个模型均使用 K = 5 K=5 个高程带，其高程为 h k h_{k}，面积占比为 a k a_{k}。 在 CAMELS-GB 上，a k = 1 / 5 a_{k}=1/5，而 h k h_{k} 取自高程曲线（hypsometric curve）上 10%、30%、50%、70% 和 90% 处的高程，该曲线通过对地形属性中的最低、10%、50%、90% 和最高高程进行线性插值得到。 在 CAMELS-US 上，将数据集中面积为正的 100 m 高程带按高程排序。 第 i i 个高程带被分配到组 min ⁡ { ⌊ ( cumulative area up to and including ​ i − 10 − 9 ) / 0.2 ⌋ , 4 } \min\{\lfloor(\text{cumulative area up to and including }i-10^{-9})/0.2\rfloor,4\}（恰好终止于面积 20%、40%、60% 或 80% 处的高程带留在较低组中）。 组高程 h k h_{k} 是其各高程带的面积加权平均值，a k a_{k} 是其面积，并经过重新归一化使得 ∑ k a k = 1 \sum_{k}a_{k}=1，空组的 a k = 0 a_{k}=0。 由于单个 100 m 高程带常常覆盖超过流域面积的五分之一，各组通常并非等面积，且有些组为空。 在 671 个 CAMELS-US 流域中，446 个至少有一个空组，93 个只有单一非空组（其中 44 个仅由单个 100 m 高程带构成）。 在拥有两个或更多组的流域中，最大组面积与最小组面积之比的中位数为 3.1。 CAMELS-AUS 不提供高程带数据，因此其五个高程带取 a k = 1 / 5 a_{k}=1/5，h k h_{k} 则取在流域最低与最高高程处截断的标准高程分布的 10%、30%、50%、70% 和 90% 分位数。 该分布的标准差为高程范围的 0.17 倍（即 CAMELS-US 高程带的中位比值），其中心经过选取，使得截断分布的均值等于平均高程。 高程偏移 Δ ​ h k = ( h k − ∑ j a j ​ h j ) / 1000 \Delta h_{k}=(h_{k}-\sum_{j}a_{j}h_{j})/1000 的单位为 km。

paragraphs.en: Table S1 lists the stores and the conditional variables, which carry no water.
paragraphs.zh: 表S1列出了这些商店及条件变量，而这些条件变量并无实际意义（站不住脚）。

paragraphs.en: Each per-catchment parameter p p with range ( p lo , p hi ) (p_{\rm lo},p_{\rm hi}) is an output of the static-attribute network (Section S1.7 ),
paragraphs.zh: 每个流域参数 p p 具有取值范围 ( p lo , p hi ) (p_{\rm lo},p_{\rm hi})，是静态属性网络（第 S1.7 节）的输出，

paragraphs.en: where 𝒉 \bm{h} is the last hidden layer of the network. Parameters marked “log” in Tables S2 – S3 are mapped in this way in ln ⁡ p \ln p . At initialisation 𝒘 p = 𝟎 \bm{w}_{p}=\bm{0} and b p = logit ⁡ [ ( p 0 − p lo ) / ( p hi − p lo ) ] b_{p}=\mathrm{logit}[(p_{0}-p_{\rm lo})/(p_{\rm hi}-p_{\rm lo})] , with ln ⁡ p \ln p in place of p p for the log-mapped parameters, so that all catchments start at the initial value p 0 p_{0} . Because of the logistic function the range is open, and a bound is approached but never attained. The global constants (Table S4 ) are unbounded scalars, with scale constants learned as logarithms.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 𝒉 \bm{h} 是网络的最后一个隐藏层。 表 S2 – S3 中标记为“log”的参数以这种方式映射到 ln ⁡ p \ln p 中。 在初始化时 𝒘 p = 𝟎 \bm{w}_{p}=\bm{0}，b p = logit ⁡ [ ( p 0 − p lo ) / ( p hi − p lo ) ] b_{p}=\mathrm{logit}[(p_{0}-p_{\rm lo})/(p_{\rm hi}-p_{\rm lo})]，对于按对数映射的参数，用 ln ⁡ p \ln p 代替 p p，从而所有流域都从初始值 p 0 p_{0} 出发。 由于逻辑斯蒂函数的存在，该范围是开区间，边界只能被逼近但永远不会达到。 全局常数（表 S4）是无界标量，其尺度常数以对数形式学习得到。

(3) Unit hydrographs: 0.9 ​ D → x 9 0.9D\to x_{9} (UH1) and 0.1 ​ D → x 1 0.1D\to x_{1} (UH2). (4) Quick store with exchange: ( x 9 , x 1 ) → ( Q r , Q d ) (x_{9},x_{1})\to(Q_{r},Q_{d}) . (5) Groundwater store: G → q s G\to q_{s} . (6) Outlet: ( Q r , Q d , q s ) → Q (Q_{r},Q_{d},q_{s})\to Q .

paragraphs.en: Stores with a closed-form law use the exact one-day solution, while the surface layer, the filling of the depressions and the exchange use explicit steps from the storage at the start of the day. Any coefficient that depends on the state or the forcing is evaluated once and held fixed over the day. Explicit steps evaluate a flux from the storage at the start of the day and hold it over the day, so on some days the flux can exceed the water present. For example, the share 0.1 ​ j 0.1j of the exchange loss that the direct flow carries exceeds that flow on days without direct runoff. Such a flux is limited to the water available by ( ⋅ ) + (\cdot)_{+} or min ⁡ { ⋅ } \min\{\cdot\} . The relative storages s s and s d s_{d} and the activity v v are also limited to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , which rounding could otherwise move slightly outside. These limits are the clamps referred to below, and the water balance uses the fluxes after them (Section S1.8 ).

paragraphs.en: Each store with a spin-up is first run over the first n n days of the record from the initial state in Table S5 , without gradient. The simulation then restarts on the first day of the record, using the final spin-up state as its initial state. The surface layer, the infiltration excess, the root zone, the near-stream zone and the wetness θ \theta are spun up as a chain in which each store is driven by the spin-up output of the stores above it. The depressions and the quick store are spun up with the inputs of the simulation itself. With records starting on 3 December 1988 (CAMELS-GB) and 1 January 1980 (CAMELS-US and CAMELS-AUS), the training period (from 1 January 1989) is preceded by 29 days and by nine years of simulation, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 每个带预热（spin-up）的储水体首先从表 S5 中的初始状态开始在记录的前 n 天上运行，且不带梯度。 随后模拟在记录的第一天重新启动，使用最终的预热状态作为其初始状态。 表层、超渗水量、根区、近河区以及湿度 θ \theta 作为一条链条进行预热，其中每个储水体由其上方储水体的预热输出驱动。 洼地和快速储水体则用模拟本身的输入进行预热。 由于记录分别始于 1988 年 12 月 3 日（CAMELS-GB）和 1980 年 1 月 1 日（CAMELS-US 和 CAMELS-AUS），训练期（自 1989 年 1 月 1 日起）之前分别有 29 天和九年的模拟。

sents.en: The simulation then restarts on the first day of the record, using the final spin-up state as its initial state.
sents.zh: 随后模拟在记录的第一天重新启动，使用最终的预热状态作为其初始状态。

sents.en: The surface layer, the infiltration excess, the root zone, the near-stream zone and the wetness θ \theta are spun up as a chain in which each store is driven by the spin-up output of the stores above it.
sents.zh: 表层、超渗水量、根区、近河区以及湿度 θ \theta 作为一条链条进行预热，其中每个储水体由其上方储水体的预热输出驱动。

sents.en: The depressions and the quick store are spun up with the inputs of the simulation itself.
sents.zh: 洼地和快速储水体则用模拟本身的输入进行预热。

sents.en: With records starting on 3 December 1988 (CAMELS-GB) and 1 January 1980 (CAMELS-US and CAMELS-AUS), the training period (from 1 January 1989) is preceded by 29 days and by nine years of simulation, respectively.
sents.zh: 由于记录分别始于 1988 年 12 月 3 日（CAMELS-GB）和 1980 年 1 月 1 日（CAMELS-US 和 CAMELS-AUS），训练期（自 1989 年 1 月 1 日起）之前分别有 29 天和九年的模拟。

paragraphs.en: CAMELS-GB uses 21 attributes, standardised with the mean and standard deviation over the 604 catchments that are not held out as ungauged. The attributes are area, median elevation, sand, silt and clay fractions, porosity, hydraulic conductivity, soil depth, deciduous and evergreen woodland, crop and urban fractions, reservoir capacity, mean precipitation, mean PET, precipitation seasonality, snow fraction, and the frequency and duration of high- and low-precipitation days. CAMELS-US uses the 27 attributes of Kratzert et al. [2019b] (climate indices, mean elevation and slope, area, forest fraction, leaf-area and green-vegetation indices, soil depth, porosity, conductivity, water content and texture, carbonate fraction, permeability), standardised over the 671 basins. CAMELS-AUS uses 27 attributes that cover the same properties and are standardised over the 561 catchments, with the seasonal amplitude of net primary productivity in place of that of leaf area. The band elevations are used only by the snow store. During training, Gaussian noise of standard deviation 0.1 is added to every standardised attribute of every catchment, drawn anew at each iteration, and no noise is used for selection or evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: CAMELS-GB 使用 21 个属性，并在未作为无资料剔除的 604 个流域上用均值和标准差进行标准化。 这些属性包括面积、中位海拔、砂粒、粉粒和黏粒比例、孔隙度、水力传导度、土壤深度、落叶林和常绿林、耕地和城市比例、水库库容、平均降水量、平均 PET、降水季节性、降雪比例，以及高降水日和低降水日的频率和持续时间。 CAMELS-US 使用 Kratzert et al. [2019b] 的 27 个属性（气候指数、平均海拔和坡度、面积、森林比例、叶面积指数和绿色植被指数、土壤深度、孔隙度、传导度、含水量和质地、碳酸盐比例、渗透率），并在 671 个流域上进行标准化。 CAMELS-AUS 使用涵盖相同性质的 27 个属性，并在 561 个流域上进行标准化，其中用净初级生产力的季节振幅替代叶面积的季节振幅。 高程带仅被积雪库使用。 在训练过程中，每个流域的每个标准化属性都会加入标准差为 0.1 的高斯噪声，每次迭代都重新生成，且在模型选择或评估时不使用任何噪声。

paragraphs.en: The network has three fully connected hidden layers of 128 units with the (exact, error-function) GELU activation ϕ \phi . The hidden representation is 𝒉 = ϕ ⁡ ( 𝑾 3 ​ ϕ ​ ( 𝑾 2 ​ ϕ ​ ( 𝑾 1 ​ 𝒂 + 𝒃 1 ) + 𝒃 2 ) + 𝒃 3 ) \bm{h}=\phi(\bm{W}_{3}\phi(\bm{W}_{2}\phi(\bm{W}_{1}\bm{a}+\bm{b}_{1})+\bm{b}_{2})+\bm{b}_{3}) and is followed by linear heads and the logistic map ( S1 ). CaRT has one head of 11 outputs, whereas CaRT + has one head of 28 outputs (rain–runoff, snow and the refinements other than the quick release) and another one of 7 (the quick-release parameters A min , C θ , τ θ , λ , λ W , k , a F A_{\min},C_{\theta},\tau_{\theta},\lambda,\lambda_{W},k,a_{F} ). The heads are initialised with zero weights and with biases that give the initial values, while the hidden layers use the default uniform initialisation of the framework. For CaRT the network has 37 259 37\,259 weights (CAMELS-GB) and 38 027 38\,027 (CAMELS-US and CAMELS-AUS, which have the same number of attributes), and for CaRT + 40 355 40\,355 and 41 123 41\,123 , in addition to the seven global constants. The parameters are static, computed once per catchment and applied throughout the record.
paragraphs.zh: 该网络包含三个各含128个单元的全连接隐藏层，并使用（精确的、误差函数形式的）GELU激活函数 ϕ \phi 。 隐藏表示为 𝒉 = ϕ ⁡ ( 𝑾 3 ​ ϕ ​ ( 𝑾 2 ​ ϕ ​ ( 𝑾 1 ​ 𝒂 + 𝒃 1 ) + 𝒃 2 ) + 𝒃 3 ) \bm{h}=\phi(\bm{W}_{3}\phi(\bm{W}_{2}\phi(\bm{W}_{1}\bm{a}+\bm{b}_{1})+\bm{b}_{2})+\bm{b}_{3}) ，其后接线性输出头以及逻辑映射（式 S1 ）。 CaRT 有一个包含11个输出的头，而 CaRT + 则有一个包含28个输出的头（径流、雪以及除快速释放之外的精化项）和另一个包含7个输出的头（快速释放参数 A min , C θ , τ θ , λ , λ W , k , a F A_{\min},C_{\theta},\tau_{\theta},\lambda,\lambda_{W},k,a_{F} ）。 各输出头以零权重以及能给出初始值的偏置进行初始化，而隐藏层则使用该框架的默认均匀初始化。 对于 CaRT，该网络有 37 259 37\,259 个权重（CAMELS-GB）和 38 027 38\,027 个权重（CAMELS-US 和 CAMELS-AUS，二者具有相同数量的属性），而对于 CaRT + 则分别为 40 355 40\,355 和 41 123 41\,123 ，此外还有七个全局常数。 这些参数是静态的，每个流域仅计算一次，并在整个记录期间保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Each iteration simulates all catchments jointly over the record from its first day to 31 December 2010. The loss is the mean of 1 − NSE 1-\mathrm{NSE} over the gauged catchments with more than 730 observed days in the training period. Each NSE is computed over the observed days from 1 January 1989 to 31 December 2008. The optimiser is AdamW ( β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} on all trained quantities, including the global constants). It uses a one-cycle learning-rate schedule with maximum 2 × 10 − 3 2\times 10^{-3} , 5 % warm-up, cosine annealing, initial and final rates 2 × 10 − 3 / 25 2\times 10^{-3}/25 and 2 × 10 − 3 / ( 25 × 10 4 ) 2\times 10^{-3}/(25\times 10^{4}) , and the momentum cycling of the schedule ( β 1 \beta_{1} between 0.95 and 0.85). Training runs for 5000 iterations, each of which is one full-batch step, with gradients clipped to a global norm of 1 and steps skipped if the loss or gradient is non-finite. The steady storage W ss W_{\rm ss} is treated as a constant in the gradient (stop-gradient), in the initial state and wherever it enters the daily update (in the half-saturation of the uptake and in W t / W ss W_{t}/W_{\rm ss} of the connected fraction). The gradient passes through the training-mean recharge g ¯ \bar{g} into a g = 1 / ( g ¯ ​ τ 2 ) a_{g}=1/(\bar{g}\tau^{2}) . Three seeds (0, 1, 2) set the initial weights and the attribute noise.

paragraphs.en: Every 50 iterations and at the last iteration the model is evaluated without noise. We keep the network with the largest median NSE over 1 January 2009 to 31 December 2010, taken over the gauged catchments with more than 365 observed days in that period. The selected network is then run over the whole record, with the same periods on all three datasets (training 1989–2008, selection 2009–2010 and test 2011–2019). In each dataset, 10 % of the catchments (67 on CAMELS-GB, 68 on CAMELS-US and 56 on CAMELS-AUS) are ungauged and, although simulated, never enter the loss or the selection. Two further CAMELS-GB catchments are excluded because they lack usable discharge.

paragraphs.en: No operation feeds back on an earlier one in this sequence, so the models are computed stage by stage over the whole record, and the result is identical to that of a daily loop in the order of Section S1.2 . However, the groundwater coefficient depends on the mean recharge g ¯ \bar{g} over the training period (1 January 1989 to 31 December 2008) of the same simulation (Section S1.3 ). A daily-loop implementation therefore needs a first pass of steps (1)–(8) (CaRT: (1)–(2)) to obtain g ¯ \bar{g} . The lower bound F min F_{\min} of the infiltration capacity on CAMELS-AUS prevents an underflow of the capacity in single precision in the driest catchments, which made the gradients undefined. All daily recursions of the stores are implemented as fused GPU kernels (Triton) with adjoint recursions run backwards over the stored states. These recursions are either hand-written or generated from the one-day step by automatic differentiation of a single day. Every kernel was verified against float64 automatic differentiation of the unrolled loop (the largest relative gradient error in the maximum norm was below 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} over the tested sequences and states). The fused kernels made the ablations 26–40 times faster than a compiled daily loop. The vegetation activity and the near-surface wetness, which are moving averages with kernels of 2048 and 36 days, are computed as convolutions in PyTorch, the former by FFT. Below x = 10 − 3 x=10^{-3} , 1 − e − x 1-e^{-x} is evaluated as x − x 2 / 2 x-x^{2}/2 in the infiltration excess and the channel loss and as x − x 2 / 2 + x 3 / 6 x-x^{2}/2+x^{3}/6 in the groundwater uptake.
paragraphs.zh: 在此序列中没有任何操作反馈到更早的操作，因此模型在整个记录上逐阶段计算，其结果与按第 S1.2 节顺序的逐日循环完全相同。 然而，地下水系数取决于同一模拟训练期（1989 年 1 月 1 日至 2008 年 12 月 31 日）的平均补给量 g ¯ \bar{g}（第 S1.3 节）。 因此，逐日循环实现需要先执行一遍步骤 (1)–(8)（CaRT：(1)–(2)）以获得 g ¯ \bar{g}。 CAMELS-AUS 上入渗能力的下界 F min F_{\min} 防止了最干旱流域中单精度下容量下溢，因为该下溢会导致梯度未定义。 所有蓄水体的逐日递归均以融合 GPU 内核（Triton）实现，其伴随递归在存储的状态上反向运行。 这些递归要么是手工编写的，要么是通过对单日步骤进行自动微分从一日步生成的。 每个内核都针对展开循环的 float64 自动微分进行了验证（在被测试的序列和状态上，最大范数中的最大相对梯度误差低于 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5}）。 融合内核使消融实验比编译的逐日循环快 26–40 倍。 植被活动和近地表湿度是核长度分别为 2048 天和 36 天的滑动平均，它们在 PyTorch 中以卷积方式计算，前者使用 FFT。 当 x = 10 − 3 x=10^{-3} 以下时，1 − e − x 1-e^{-x} 在超渗和河道损失中被计算为 x − x 2 / 2 x-x^{2}/2，在地下水摄取中被计算为 x − x 2 / 2 + x 3 / 6 x-x^{2}/2+x^{3}/6。

sents.en: No operation feeds back on an earlier one in this sequence, so the models are computed stage by stage over the whole record, and the result is identical to that of a daily loop in the order of Section S1.2 .
sents.zh: 在此序列中没有任何操作反馈到更早的操作，因此模型在整个记录上逐阶段计算，其结果与按第 S1.2 节顺序的逐日循环完全相同。

sents.en: However, the groundwater coefficient depends on the mean recharge g ¯ \bar{g} over the training period (1 January 1989 to 31 December 2008) of the same simulation (Section S1.3 ).
sents.zh: 然而，地下水系数取决于同一模拟训练期（1989 年 1 月 1 日至 2008 年 12 月 31 日）的平均补给量 g ¯ \bar{g}（第 S1.3 节）。

sents.en: A daily-loop implementation therefore needs a first pass of steps (1)–(8) (CaRT: (1)–(2)) to obtain g ¯ \bar{g} .
sents.zh: 因此，逐日循环实现需要先执行一遍步骤 (1)–(8)（CaRT：(1)–(2)）以获得 g ¯ \bar{g}。

sents.en: The lower bound F min F_{\min} of the infiltration capacity on CAMELS-AUS prevents an underflow of the capacity in single precision in the driest catchments, which made the gradients undefined.
sents.zh: CAMELS-AUS 上入渗能力的下界 F min F_{\min} 防止了最干旱流域中单精度下容量下溢，因为该下溢会导致梯度未定义。

sents.en: All daily recursions of the stores are implemented as fused GPU kernels (Triton) with adjoint recursions run backwards over the stored states.

sents.en: These recursions are either hand-written or generated from the one-day step by automatic differentiation of a single day.

sents.en: Every kernel was verified against float64 automatic differentiation of the unrolled loop (the largest relative gradient error in the maximum norm was below 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} over the tested sequences and states).

paragraphs.en: exact : the aggregate of the stated fine-scale assumptions;
paragraphs.zh: exact : 所述细粒度假设的集合；

paragraphs.en: asymptotic : an aggregate that holds only in a limit;
paragraphs.zh: asymptotic（渐近的）：仅在极限情况下才成立的一种聚合；

paragraphs.en: postulated : a form chosen by analogy with a known law, including a new state and its balance;
paragraphs.zh: 假设性的：通过与已知定律类比而选定的一种形式，包括一个新状态及其平衡；

paragraphs.en: heuristic : a functional form with the expected sign and bounds.

paragraphs.en: Under operation (d) a conditional variable modulates the boundary fluxes to the atmosphere, with the limit κ = 0 \kappa=0 . The aggregate is exact under V1–V3, and the common rate for activation and dormancy closes it in v v . The switching law and the logistic distribution are postulated and are motivated by the seasonal lag of transpiration behind air temperature [ Oudin et al., 2005 , Chuine, 2000 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在运行方式 下，一个条件变量对向大气的边界通量进行调制，且取极限 κ = 0 \kappa=0 。 该聚合在 V1–V3 下是精确的，且激活与休眠的共同速率使其在 v v 中封闭。 该切换规律与逻辑斯蒂分布为假设所得，其依据是蒸腾滞后于气温的季节性延迟 [ Oudin et al., 2005 , Chuine, 2000 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A snowpack is a volume inserted on the precipitation (operation a) that loses water to the atmosphere through sublimation (operation b). Because snow accumulation has a temperature threshold, the spread of temperature with elevation is an O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) heterogeneity, and the store is split into five elevation bands with temperatures T k = T − Γ ​ Δ ​ h k T_{k}=T-\Gamma\Delta h_{k} (operation a). In each band the degree-day law of HBV [ Bergström, 1995 , Seibert and Vis, 2012 ] accumulates snowfall below T T T_{T} and melts c m ​ ( T k − T T ) c_{m}(T_{k}-T_{T}) above it. Sublimation u k = min ⁡ ( κ s ​ E , N k , m ) u_{k}=\min(\kappa_{s}E,N_{k,m}) , with N k , m N_{k,m} the pack after the day’s snowfall, removes snow to the atmosphere at a fraction of the demand. This loss is absent from the degree-day store, and on the prairies it removes a large part of the pack as blowing snow [ Pomeroy et al., 1993 ] . The store is postulated and has no nested limit because it is already present in CaRT, whereas sublimation vanishes for κ s → 0 \kappa_{s}\to 0 .
paragraphs.zh: 雪盖是一个插入到降水（操作 a）之后的水体，它通过升华（操作 b）向大气损失水分。 由于积雪累积存在温度阈值，而温度随海拔的变化是 O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) 的异质性，因此该蓄水体被划分为五个海拔带，其温度为 T k = T − Γ ​ Δ ​ h k T_{k}=T-\Gamma\Delta h_{k}（操作 a）。 在每个海拔带内，HBV 的度日法 [ Bergström, 1995 , Seibert and Vis, 2012 ] 在温度低于 T T T_{T} 时累积降雪，在温度高于 T T T_{T} 时融化 c m ​ ( T k − T T ) c_{m}(T_{k}-T_{T}) 的雪量。 升华 u k = min ⁡ ( κ s ​ E , N k , m ) u_{k}=\min(\kappa_{s}E,N_{k,m}) （其中 N k , m N_{k,m} 为当日降雪后的雪盖量）以需求量的一定比例将雪移除至大气。 这一部分损失不计入度日蓄水体中，而在草原上，它以吹雪的形式移除了雪盖的很大一部分 [ Pomeroy et al., 1993 ] 。 该蓄水体是假设性的，且没有嵌套限制，因为它已经存在于 CaRT 中；而当 κ s → 0 \kappa_{s}\to 0 时升华消失。

paragraphs.en: Assumptions. (M1) The degree-day factor represents the surface energy balance. (M2) In spring the melt energy rises with radiation faster than with air temperature. (M3) Being the only energy variable among the inputs, the potential evapotranspiration serves as an index of the available energy. Adding an energy term to the degree-day law gives M k = min ⁡ { N k ′ , c m ​ ( T k − T T ) + r p ​ E } M_{k}=\min\{N_{k}^{\prime},c_{m}(T_{k}-T_{T})+r_{p}E\} , with N k ′ N_{k}^{\prime} the pack after sublimation, on days with T k ≥ T T T_{k}\geq T_{T} (operation d), in the form of temperature-index models with a radiation term [ Hock, 2003 , Kustas et al., 1994 , Pellicciotti et al., 2005 ] . For a given melt, a larger energy term lowers the temperature sensitivity of the store, because ∂ M k / ∂ T k = c m \partial M_{k}/\partial T_{k}=c_{m} and the degree-day factor then carries a smaller part of the melt. r p → 0 r_{p}\to 0 is the degree-day law. The energy argument M1–M2 is physical, while the additive form and the use of PET as the energy index are heuristic.
paragraphs.zh: 假设。 (M1) 度日因子代表地表能量平衡。 (M2) 春季，融雪能量随辐射上升的速度快于随气温上升的速度。 (M3) 作为输入中唯一的能量变量，潜在蒸散发可作为可利用能量的指标。 在度日律中加入一个能量项，得到 M k = min ⁡ { N k ′ , c m ​ ( T k − T T ) + r p ​ E } M_{k}=\min\{N_{k}^{\prime},c_{m}(T_{k}-T_{T})+r_{p}E\} ，其中 N k ′ N_{k}^{\prime} 为升华后的积雪量，在 T k ≥ T T T_{k}\geq T_{T} 的日子（操作 d），其形式为带辐射项的温度指数模型 [ Hock, 2003 , Kustas et al., 1994 , Pellicciotti et al., 2005 ] 。 对于给定的融雪量，较大的能量项会降低该储量对温度的敏感度，因为 ∂ M k / ∂ T k = c m \partial M_{k}/\partial T_{k}=c_{m} ，此时度日因子只承担融雪中较小的部分。 r p → 0 r_{p}\to 0 即为度日律。 能量论证 M1–M2 是物理性的，而加性形式以及将 PET 用作能量指标则是启发式的。

paragraphs.zh: 该损失是从出口到外部的一种通量 [ Shanafield and Cook, 2014 ]，这种连接是钙交换（CaRT）的交换在直接路径上已经使用的，其规律通过对阈值进行聚合（操作 c）而得到。 L c → 0 L_{c}\to 0 是不含它的模型，且该结果在 L1–L3 下是精确的。

paragraphs.en: Within a day the stores are advanced in sequence, with coefficients held at their value after the day’s inflow (quick release, uptake) or at the start of the day (exchange, depressions). The quick-store update is the exact solution of the bounded law only for k = 0 k=0 and m t m_{t} constant over the day, whereas for k > 0 k>0 it is the exact solution for the coefficient frozen at R m R_{m} . This regularised, operator-split model is the one that was trained and evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 在一天之内，各储量按顺序向前推进，其系数保持在当日入流之后取值（快速释放、吸收）或当日开始时取值（交换、洼地）的水平。 快速储量的更新仅在 k = 0 k=0 且 m t m_{t} 在一天内保持常数时才是有界律的精确解，而当 k > 0 k>0 时，它是系数冻结在 R m R_{m} 处的精确解。 这个经过正则化、算子分裂的模型就是被训练和评估的模型。
